【原文 English Original】
Artificial Intelligence
Chinese startup DexForce trains humanoid robots using simulated, or synthetic, data to cut costs and improve efficiency. The Shenzhen-based firm says the approach could accelerate progress toward "physical artificial general intelligence", and it is backed by major conglomerates and state funds.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 16:19 HKT · 2 min read

Chinese startup DexForce is using simulated training to teach humanoid robots a wide range of real-world tasks, an approach it says is faster and cheaper than collecting data from human workers. The Shenzhen-based company displayed a screen showing a virtual robot repeatedly placing objects on a table while the angle of its arms, the colour of the table and the objects themselves changed.

Chief Executive Jia Kui told Reuters that relying on synthetic data generated in virtual environments could more quickly power a breakthrough in robot capability, similar to the one ChatGPT triggered after its 2022 release helped propel generative AI into the mainstream. "Trying to achieve 'physical artificial general intelligence' purely through real-world data collection would require 10 trillion samples ... manual (data) collection for infinite human tasks is fundamentally inefficient," he said, referring to a milestone where a humanoid can complete new tasks in an unfamiliar environment on command.

China has developed humanoids capable of outperforming humans in running and jumping, but the harder commercial test lies in whether they can reliably carry out useful work in factories, offices and the home. Many Chinese robot makers are trying to meet that challenge by collecting large volumes of data from human workers repeatedly performing tasks in the real world. DexForce, however, develops AI software designed to simulate physical environments and models intended to predict how objects move and interact. It creates a digital version of a workplace or task, trains a robot in the simulation and then transfers that learning to physical machines.

The company says the process is faster and cheaper than collecting data from human trainers, who may need to repeat a movement more than 100 times to generate precise examples. Dozens of humanoid robot data training centres are currently being built nationwide at great expense, and are often heavily reliant on government subsidies. Most Chinese robot makers use a combination of simulated and real-world data, and many say access to high-quality training data remains a key bottleneck.

Jia, a machine-learning professor at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, founded DexForce in 2021. The roughly 500-employee startup is backed by Lenovo Capital, the investment arm of Lenovo, and Lens Technology, as well as several state-owned funds. It raised 1 billion yuan ($147 million) in a recent Series B funding round at a valuation of more than 10 billion yuan. Bloomberg reported it was considering a Hong Kong IPO, but Jia declined to comment.

The firm's software is used in industrial settings by Chinese and foreign manufacturers including Toyota, Samsung, Panasonic, Foxconn, Haier, and Hisense, while its humanoid robots make coffee and serve customers at malls and tourist sites in more than 15 cities nationwide.

title: Hong Kong unveils land sale plan for 3,845 private flats in Sha Tin and beyond
zh_title: 香港公布沙田及其他地区3,845个私人单位的卖地计划
summary: 香港政府当局宣布了一项新的土地出售计划，提供约3,845个私人住宅单位，其中包括沙田的960个单位的地块和市区重建局的1,050个住宅单位的项目。前三季度供应15,680套，超额完成全年目标12,600套。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:37 HKT · 2 分钟阅读政府公布了最新的季度土地出售计划，
content:
政府
香港当局宣布了一项新的土地出售计划，提供约 3,845 个私人住宅单位，其中包括沙田地块的 960 个单位和市区重建局项目的 1,050 个住宅单位。前三季度供应15,680套，超额完成全年目标12,600套。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:37 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港政府公布最新季度卖地计划，以招标方式推出沙田石门住宅用地，预计可提供约960个私人房屋单位。根据周四的公告，市区重建局还将在土瓜湾道推出重建项目，提供约1,050个单位。

私人土地发展及重建方面，有七个项目预计于第三季完成地契修改或换地，提供约1,835个单位。该计划下的所有项目总共将供应约 3,845 个单位。
发展局局长林汉海表示，加上本财政年度首两季，首三季将提供约15,680个私人房屋单位，超额完成全年供应目标12,600个单位。她强调，该目标不是一个硬性指标，因为年度住房供应数据可能会因宏观经济状况和政府协调之外的私人项目而波动，并补充说当局从广泛的角度评估总体供应趋势。

林恩表示，一些政府协调的项目，包括北部大都市的项目、铁路房地产开发和城市更新计划，都遵循与政策需求和地区发展相关的具体时间表。她表示，“政府不会仅仅因为达到了数字目标就放慢脚步。”她指出，今年市场情绪依然乐观，开发商对前景持乐观态度，成熟社区对地块的需求稳定。

当被问及第四季度是否继续出售土地时，林恩表示，政府将在发布公告之前审查市场和经济状况。关于粉岭北地区的招标，她表示，当局正在寻求城市规划委员会的重新分区批准，将住宅产量从2,000个单位增加到4,000个单位，并建议更改该地区的工业用地，目标是在年底前启动招标。
除住宅用地外，政府亦会在沙田小沥源提供一幅地块兴建大专学生宿舍，提供约600个床位。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Government
Hong Kong authorities announced a new land sale programme offering about 3,845 private residential units, including a Sha Tin plot for 960 flats and an Urban Renewal Authority project for 1,050 homes. The first three quarters will supply 15,680 units, exceeding the annual target of 12,600.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 16:37 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong government has unveiled its latest quarterly land sale programme, offering a residential site in Shek Mun, Sha Tin, by tender, expected to supply about 960 private housing units. The Urban Renewal Authority will also launch a redevelopment project on To Kwa Wan Road, providing roughly 1,050 units, according to an announcement on Thursday.

For private land development and redevelopment, seven projects are set to complete land lease modifications or land exchanges in the third quarter, contributing about 1,835 units. In total, all projects under the programme will supply approximately 3,845 units.

Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn Hon-hoi said that combined with the first two quarters of the current financial year, the first three quarters will provide about 15,680 private housing units, surpassing the annual supply target of 12,600 units. She stressed that the target is not a rigid indicator, as annual housing supply figures may fluctuate due to macroeconomic conditions and private projects outside government coordination, adding that authorities assess overall supply trends from a broad perspective.

Linn said some government-coordinated projects, including those in the Northern Metropolis, railway property developments and urban renewal schemes, follow specific timelines tied to policy needs and district development. "The government will not slow down purely because the numerical target has been met," she said, noting that market sentiment remains positive this year and developers are optimistic about prospects, with steady demand for sites in mature communities.

Asked whether land sales would continue in the fourth quarter, Linn said the government would review market and economic conditions before making an announcement. On the Fanling North area tender, she said authorities are seeking rezoning approval from the Town Planning Board to increase residential output from 2,000 to 4,000 units, and are also proposing changes for industrial land in the area, with a target to launch the tender by the end of the year.

Apart from residential sites, the government will also offer a plot in Siu Lek Yuen, Sha Tin, for the construction of a tertiary student hostel providing about 600 bed spaces.

# Hong Kong security chief exposes phone scam in viral video

Security Secretary Chris Tang shared a video of himself confronting a phone fraudster impersonating a government official, urging the public to stay vigilant. He stressed that the Security Bureau never demands assistance, money or account transfers over the phone.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 17:35 HKT · 1 min read

Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung has warned the public against phone scams after releasing a video of himself handling a fraudulent call from someone claiming to be a Security Bureau official.

In the video posted on Thursday, the scammer told Tang he was suspected of breaching mainland law and instructed him to report immediately to the 10th floor of the Central Government Offices to verify his identity and assist in an investigation.

Tang responded by asking which unit of the Security Bureau the caller belonged to, noting that he was already on the 10th floor and inviting the caller to come and find him instead.

# 李四川：落實「青春山海線2.0」 創造坪林商機

2026/10/15 16:31（10/15 16:56 更新）

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 21](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

請同意我們的隱私權規範，才能啟用聽新聞的功能。

中國國民黨新北市長參選人李四川（前右4）15日出席坪林區競選總部成立大會，近400名鄉親、里長到場力挺，場面熱烈。（李四川競辦提供）中央社記者曹亞沿傳真 115年10月15日

（中央社記者[曹亞沿](https://cna.com.tw/author/0192/)、黃旭昇新北15日電）中國國民黨新北市長參選人李四川今天說，將落實「青春山海線2.0」政策，以周遊券整合大眾運輸、景點、住宿、美食及消費優惠，串聯各地特色景點，創造坪林區商機。

李四川上午出席坪林競選總部成立大會表示，這樣可讓遊客一券暢遊新北，促進在地就業，讓更多年輕人留家鄉工作，而坪林孕育的茶葉是新北重要特色農產，如果當選，將整合交通、觀光及行銷資源積極推廣，讓新北好茶走向國際。

[![Image 23](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/ad300x223.jpg)](https://lin.ee/tPtHlLQ)

至於台北市長選戰近日為科技廊帶政見交鋒，李四川接受媒體聯訪表示，民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋不熟市政，如果民進黨新北市長參選人蘇巧慧也有相同認知，可能會讓國外大廠不敢投資雙北。

他說，交通與土地是人工智慧（AI）產業投資主要條件，有聚落才能聚集人才、建立平台，也才能讓國外大廠願投資。（編輯：李明宗）1151015

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) The U.S. dollar rose against the Taiwan dollar Thursday, gaining NT$0.192 to close at NT$32.265.

Turnover totaled US$7.030 billion during the trading session.

The greenback opened at the day's low of NT$32.110, and peaked at NT$32.452 during trading.

# 湾区 9月27日 牛腾宇妈妈 作品展

By:[Lili Hu](https://www.zyd1998.com/archives/author/lili-hu)

Date:

2026年9月26日

7251

【周日下午活动】｜牛腾宇妈妈 作品展

🕟 4:30–6:30 PM

现场将展出牛腾宇妈妈的画作，并邀请她和大家交流。我们将有机会听她亲自讲述牛腾宇案的相关情况及狱中生活近况，也听她分享作品背后的故事，以及一路走来面对困境、坚持抗争的经历与心声。

这不仅是一次作品的展示，也是两场关于人生选择、女性成长、困境与坚持、爱与生命力量的真诚交流。

有人经历风雨，依然选择热爱生活；

有人身处困境，依然选择坚持和发声。

期待这个周末与大家在Los Altos Public Library相见。一起看作品、听故事、聊人生，在真实的生命经历中，看见彼此，也获得一些温暖与力量。

# 接獲「保安局官員」來電說涉犯案 香港保安局長：你過來找我

2026-10-15 16:25 聯合報／ 香港特派員[李春](https://udn.com/news/reporter/MDM4NjY=)／即時報導  香港

港府保安局局長鄧炳強在社交平台上傳短片，說他接獲疑似詐騙電話。圖／截自[鄧炳強FB](https://www.facebook.com/reel/1787925009114917)

[](https://udn.com/news/story/7332/9817057# "分享FB")[](https://udn.com/news/story/7332/9817057# "分享Line")[](https://www.threads.com/intent/post?text=%E6%8E%A5%E7%8D%B2%E3%80%8C%E4%BF%9D%E5%AE%89%E5%B1%80%E5%AE%98%E5%93%A1%E3%80%8D%E4%BE%86%E9%9B%BB%E8%AA%AA%E6%B6%89%E7%8A%AF%E6%A1%88+%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E4%BF%9D%E5%AE%89%E5%B1%80%E9%95%B7%EF%BC%9A%E4%BD%A0%E9%81%8E%E4%BE%86%E6%89%BE%E6%88%91&url=https%3A%2F%2Fudn.com%2Fnews%2Fstory%2F7332%2F9817057 "分享Threads")

[**香港**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF)電話詐騙多，案發數剛創下單月新高，又新增一紀錄，是港府保安局長接獲聲稱「保安局官員」的電話詐騙。

港府保安局局長鄧炳強在[社交平台上傳短片](https://www.facebook.com/reel/1787925009114917)，說他接獲疑似[**詐騙電話**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E8%A9%90%E9%A8%99%E9%9B%BB%E8%A9%B1)，對方聲稱是保安局人員，又說「你涉嫌觸犯了內地法律，現在立刻過來政府總部10樓，核實身分協助調查。」鄧炳強即時詢問對方屬於保安局哪一組，又說自己正身處10樓，叫對方過去找他。

鄧炳強說，香港保安局不會致電要求市民協助調查，更不會要求交錢轉帳，接到這些電話一定是詐騙。這類假冒政府部門的電話，往往是想套取個人資料，甚至要求轉帳。提醒市民收到可疑電話時，一定要保持冷靜，再三核實，不要上當。

香港電話詐騙案居高不下，警方10月公布今年前8個月罪案數據，說首8個月共錄得2萬9千多宗詐騙案，電話騙案依然是最嚴重的詐騙類別之一，占整體詐騙宗數約27%，8月份已錄得5,100多宗，創歷史單月新高。

香港電話詐騙案也新揭發有黑社會操控，2天前警方宣布搗破黑社會和勝和操控的詐騙及洗黑錢集團，行動中拘捕44人。

在香港，最常見的電話詐騙是假冒平台客服、保冒親友猜猜我是誰、 假冒大陸公安、香港警察或香港入境處等人員實施訛騙。

summary: 香港 香港在其“1+”药品注册机制下批准了一种治疗转移性激素敏感性前列腺癌的新药，使总数达到23种。该药物已获得中国药品监管部门的批准，并经过当地专家的审评。政府的目标是到 2030 年扩大第一层审批。 [![图片 1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日， 15:40 HKT · 2 分钟读 香港在“1+”药品注册机制下批准了另一种新药
content:
香港
香港在“1+”药品注册机制下批准了一种治疗转移性激素敏感性前列腺癌的新药，使总数达到23种。该药物已获得中国药品监管部门的批准，并经过当地专家的审评。政府的目标是到2030年扩大一级审批。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 15:40 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

卫生署周四宣布，香港在“1+”药物注册机制下批准了另一种新药，这次是用于治疗转移性激素敏感性前列腺癌。该药物在根据该机制提交申请之前已获得中国大陆药品监管部门的批准。

药剂业及毒药管理局注册委员会审查申请人的临床数据并咨询当地专家后得出结论，该药物符合规定的安全性、有效性和质量标准。卫生署已将批准结果通知申请人。
随着这项最新批准，自2023年11月1日起，已有23种新药在“1+”机制下注册。其中7种已纳入医院管理局的药物名册，其中6种属于“特殊药物”类别，这意味着合资格的病人只需支付每四个星期20元的标准费用。该局于6月8日成立的创新药物和医疗器械引进办公室正在与卫生部合作，加快新产品的注册速度，将抗癌药物的审查时间从最长150个工作日缩短至100天内。

“1+”机制于2024年11月1日扩大到涵盖包括先进治疗产品在内的所有新药，允许申请人提交一项参考监管批准而不是两项，前提是申请人提供经当地专家认可的合格本地临床数据。该部门已收到超过230家制药公司的920多项查询，并推出了提交前咨询服务和研讨会。

该机制被视为“一级审批”的踏脚石，卫生署于2026年3月31日开始分阶段实施。第一阶段涵盖已在香港注册的药物的扩展，目标是到2030年全面覆盖所有医药产品，让香港能够根据临床数据独立评估和审批新药。
政府表示将继续深化监管改革，并于2026年成立香港药物及医疗器械监管局，旨在根据香港第一个五年计划和2026年施政报告，将香港定位为国际医疗创新中心。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong has approved a new drug for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer under its '1+' drug registration mechanism, bringing the total to 23. The drug was approved by China's drug regulator and reviewed by local experts. The government aims to expand first-layer approval by 2030.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 15:40 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong has approved another new drug under its "1+" drug registration mechanism, this time for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, the Department of Health announced on Thursday. The drug had already been approved by mainland China's drug regulator before its application was submitted under the mechanism.

The Registration Committee of the Pharmacy and Poisons Board reviewed the applicant's clinical data and consulted local experts before concluding that the drug met the required safety, efficacy and quality standards. The Department of Health has notified the applicant of the approval result.

With this latest approval, 23 new drugs have now been registered under the "1+" mechanism since it took effect on 1 November 2023. Seven of these have been included in the Hospital Authority's drug formulary, with six placed under the "special drugs" category, meaning eligible patients pay only the standard fee of $20 every four weeks. The authority's Office for Introducing Innovative Drugs and Medical Devices, established on 8 June, is working with the Department of Health to speed up registration of new products, with review times for cancer drugs cut from a maximum of 150 working days to within 100 days.

The "1+" mechanism, expanded on 1 November 2024 to cover all new drugs including advanced therapy products, allows applicants to submit one reference regulatory approval instead of two, provided they supply qualifying local clinical data endorsed by local experts. The department has received more than 920 enquiries from over 230 pharmaceutical companies and has launched pre-submission consultation services and workshops.

The mechanism is seen as a stepping stone to "first-layer approval", which the Department of Health began implementing in phases on 31 March 2026. The first phase covers extensions of drugs already registered in Hong Kong, with a target of full coverage of all pharmaceutical products by 2030, enabling Hong Kong to independently assess and approve new drugs based on clinical data.

The government said it will continue deepening regulatory reforms and establish a Hong Kong Drug and Medical Device Regulatory Authority within 2026, aiming to position Hong Kong as an international medical innovation hub under the city's first five-year plan and the 2026 policy address.

content:
政府
来自亚太地区的80多名海关官员齐聚香港，出席第36届世界海关组织区域联络会议。刚刚连任世界海关组织亚太区副主席的香港海关主办了此次活动，重点讨论加强合作、分享专业知识和应对全球挑战。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:00 香港时间 · 更新于 10 月 15 日 16:19 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

 图片：[香港特区政府新闻公报](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/15/P2026101500256.htm)

世界海关组织（WCO）第36届亚太区域联络会议于2026年10月15日在香港圆满落幕。来自亚太地区海关当局和WCO区域机构的80多名代表齐聚一堂。

会议议程包括一系列专题报告和讨论，让与会者从多个角度审视海关举措、执法策略和培训经验。目的是深化地区成员之间的相互合作与交流。
香港海关关长陈泽达于10月13日以世界海关组织亚太区副主席身份致开幕词。他表示，香港海关已于今年六月成功连任亚太区副主席，开始新的两年任期。他表示，本组织将继续加强与地区成员、地区机构和国际伙伴的领导层合作，建立互信，共同应对复杂多变的全球挑战。

陈关长还对澳门海关共同主办此次会议表示衷心感谢。他表示，他们的支持不仅促进了区域联系，也凸显了粤港澳大湾区独特的优势互补和密切合作。

此次会议是香港海关连任世界海关组织副主席以来的首次重大活动的圆满结束。未来两年，香港海关将积极举办一系列活动，促进知识共享和协作，进一步增强亚太成员之间的凝聚力。展望未来，香港海关将继续带领会员为区内海关事务的蓬勃发展作出贡献。

【原文 English Original】
Government
Over 80 customs officials from the Asia-Pacific region gathered in Hong Kong for the 36th WCO Regional Contact Meeting. Hong Kong Customs, newly re-elected as WCO Vice-Chair for the region, hosted the event, which focused on enhancing cooperation, sharing expertise, and addressing global challenges.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 16:00 HKT · updated 15 Oct, 16:19 · 2 min read

 Image: [香港特區政府新聞公報](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202610/15/P2026101500256.htm)

The 36th World Customs Organization (WCO) Asia-Pacific Regional Contact Meeting concluded successfully in Hong Kong on October 15, 2026. The event brought together more than 80 representatives from customs administrations and WCO regional bodies across the Asia-Pacific region.

The meeting's agenda featured a series of thematic reports and discussions, allowing participants to examine customs initiatives, enforcement strategies, and training experiences from multiple perspectives. The aim was to deepen mutual cooperation and exchange among regional members.

Hong Kong Customs Commissioner Chen Tse-tat delivered the opening address on October 13 in his capacity as WCO Vice-Chair for the Asia-Pacific region. He noted that Hong Kong Customs had been successfully re-elected as the region's Vice-Chair in June this year, beginning a new two-year term. He said the organisation would continue to strengthen collaboration with regional members, regional bodies, and international partners at the leadership level, building mutual trust to jointly address complex and evolving global challenges.

Commissioner Chen also expressed sincere gratitude to Macau Customs for co-hosting the meeting. He said their support not only fostered regional connections but also highlighted the complementary strengths and close cooperation unique to the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area.

The meeting marked the successful completion of the first major event since Hong Kong Customs assumed its renewed term as WCO Vice-Chair. During the next two years, Hong Kong Customs will actively organise a series of activities to promote knowledge sharing and collaboration, further strengthening cohesion among Asia-Pacific members. Looking ahead, Hong Kong Customs will continue to lead members in contributing to the vibrant development of customs affairs in the region.

title: Hong Kong police bust agarwood investment scam syndicate, arrest six
zh_title: 香港警方破获沉香投资诈骗集团，拘捕六人
summary: 香港警方捣毁了一个与沉香树投资诈骗有关的跨国犯罪集团，逮捕了六人，并扣押了与该计划有关的 1,400 万港元。大部分受害者为长者，损失介乎3万至190万港元。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:08 HKT · 2 分钟阅读香港警方捣毁了一个与沉香树投资骗局有关的跨国犯罪集团，
content:
香港
香港警方捣毁了一个与沉香树投资诈骗有关的跨国犯罪集团，逮捕了六人，并查获了与该计划有关的 1,400 万港元。大部分受害者为长者，损失介乎3万至190万港元。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:08 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港警方捣毁了一个与沉香树投资诈骗有关的跨国犯罪集团，逮捕了六人，并查获了与该计划有关的 1,400 万港元。受害者多为长者，每人损失介乎3万至190万港元。

被捕人士为两男四女，年龄介乎52至66岁，怀疑是负责招募投资者及推广投资计划的核心成员。他们面临包括通过欺骗手段获取财产等指控。警方正在调查每名嫌疑人的角色，并相信该犯罪团伙的主谋是持有外国护照的人。
商业罪案调查科总督察朱明伦表示，自上个月以来，警方已接获21名市民举报。受害者表示，自2017年起，他们参与了当地一家公司“好好集团”提供的投资计划。据称，该公司利用各种借口，逃避按照投资合同约定支付承诺的利息和返还本金。

该公司声称在全球设有办事处，并表示在马来西亚经营多个沉香树种植园，生产和销售装饰品和精油等产品。据称，该公司拥有强大的盈利能力，甚至还安排投资者参观种植园。

过去几年，该公司推出了至少四项投资计划，其中一项投资计划为投资者以1万港元购买一棵沉香树，每月保证回报300港元，三年后可全额偿还本金。去年，该公司推出了一项计划，允许投资者成为授权经销商，拥有推广公司产品的权利和责任，并保证25%的回报。该公司后来推出了自己的加密货币，声称可以将沉香树代币化，但自推出以来该货币已贬值超过 99%。

警方表示，该公司利用各种借口拖延投资者的提款请求，逃避还款义务。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong police have dismantled a transnational syndicate linked to agarwood tree investment fraud, arresting six people and seizing HK$14 million in connection with the scheme. Most victims were elderly, with losses ranging from HK$30,000 to HK$1.9 million.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 16:08 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong police have dismantled a transnational criminal syndicate linked to an agarwood tree investment scam, arresting six people and seizing HK$14 million in connection with the scheme. The victims, mostly elderly, suffered losses ranging from HK$30,000 to HK$1.9 million each.

The arrested individuals, two men and four women aged 52 to 66, are suspected of being core members responsible for recruiting investors and promoting the investment plans. They face charges including obtaining property by deception. Police are investigating the role of each suspect and believe the syndicate's mastermind is a person holding a foreign passport.

Chief Inspector Chu Ming-lun of the Commercial Crime Bureau said police have received reports from 21 citizens since last month. The victims said they had participated in investment plans offered by a local company, "Good Good Group", since 2017. The company allegedly used various excuses to avoid paying promised interest and returning principal amounts as agreed in the investment contracts.

The company claimed to have offices worldwide and said it operated multiple agarwood tree plantations in Malaysia, producing and selling products such as ornaments and essential oils. It allegedly boasted strong profitability and even arranged for investors to visit the plantations.

Over the past few years, the company launched at least four investment plans, including one where investors could buy an agarwood tree for HK$10,000, with a guaranteed monthly return of HK$300 and full principal repayment after three years. Last year, it introduced a plan allowing investors to become licensed distributors, with the right and responsibility to promote the company's products, guaranteeing a 25 per cent return. The company later launched its own cryptocurrency, claiming to tokenise agarwood trees, but the currency has depreciated by more than 99 per cent since its launch.

Police said the company used various excuses to delay investors' withdrawal requests, evading repayment obligations.

title: TSMC's Q3 net profit hits new quarterly high - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 台积电第三季净利润创季度新高 - 焦点台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月15日电 台积电(TSMC)周四公布，受全球人工智能应用需求强劲的推动，第三季度净利润再创新高，但由于采用该公司先进2纳米工艺制造的芯片出货量增加，毛利率环比下降。在投资者会议开始前发布的一份声明中，这家全球最大的代工芯片制造商表示，7-9月净利润为新台币 7,630.6 亿元（合 236.2 亿美元），同比增长 68.7%，同比增长 8.0%
content:
中新社台北10月15日电 台积电(TSMC)周四公布，受全球人工智能应用需求强劲的推动，第三季度净利润再创新高，但由于采用该公司先进2纳米工艺制造的芯片出货量增加，毛利率环比下降。

这家全球最大的代工芯片制造商在投资者会议开始前发布的一份声明中表示，7月至9月期间净利润为新台币7630.6亿元（合236.2亿美元），同比增长68.7%，环比增长8.0%。

台积电表示，第三季度每股收益创新高至新台币29.43元，而去年同期为新台币17.44元，一季度为新台币27.25元。

台积电表示，第三季度在高性能计算设备、智能手机、物联网和汽车电子需求强劲的背景下，其综合销售额也打破了之前的记录，达到467.2亿美元，同比增长41.2%，环比增长16.2%。此外，第三季度销售额超出了该公司此前预期的446亿美元至458亿美元。

该芯片制造商使用新台币32元的汇率来做出第三季度的销售预测。台积电表示，以新台币计算，第三季度合并销售额总计新台币 1.49 万亿元，也超出了预期的新台币 1.427 万亿元至新台币 1.466 万亿元。
由于采用2nm工艺（该公司开始商业化生产的最新技术）制造的芯片数量增加，第三季度毛利率（收入与销售成本之间的差额）为66.4%，比去年同期的59.5%增长6.9个百分点，但比上一季度的67.7%下降1.3个百分点。

不过，台积电表示，第三季度毛利率仍在该公司65.0-67.0%的预测范围内。

台积电表示，第三季度采用2纳米工艺的芯片占其总销售额的8％，高于第二季度的3％，而采用3纳米工艺、5纳米工艺和7纳米工艺的芯片分别占第三季度总收入的33％、28％和10％。

换句话说，这四项先进技术占第三季度总销售额的79%，高于第二季度的77%。

台积电今年前9个月净利润为新台币2.42万亿元，同比增长68.5%，每股收益为新台币78.75元，综合销售额约新台币3.9万亿元，同比增长41.1%。

9个月毛利率为66.8%，较去年同期上升7.8个百分点。

（张建中、黄芳芳摄）

结局/AW

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) on Thursday reported a new quarterly high in net profit in the third quarter, on the back of strong global demand for AI applications, while its gross margin fell from a quarter earlier due to an increase in shipments of chips made using the company's advanced 2 nanometer process.

In a statement released before an investor conference began, the world's largest contract chipmaker said it posted NT$763.06 billion (US$23.62 billion) in net profit in the July-September period, up 68.7 percent from a year earlier and up 8.0 percent from a quarter earlier.

TSMC said its earnings per share for the third quarter stood at a new high of NT$29.43, compared with NT$17.44 a year earlier and NT$27.25 a quarter earlier.

Amid solid demand for high performance computing devices, smartphones, the Internet of Things and automotive electronics in the third quarter, TSMC said, its consolidated sales also smashed previous records to reach US$46.72 billion, up 41.2 percent from a year earlier and up 16.2 percent from the quarter earlier. In addition, third quarter sales beat the company's previous estimate of US$44.6 billion to US$45.8 billion.

The chipmaker used an exchange rate of NT$32 to make the third-quarter sales forecasts. In Taiwan dollar terms, third quarter consolidated sales totaled NT$1.49 trillion, also beating the estimate of NT$1.427 trillion to NT$1.466 trillion, according to TSMC.

Due to an increase in chips made using the 2nm process, the latest technology for which the company began commercial production, the gross margin -- the difference between revenue and cost of goods sold -- stood at 66.4 percent in the third quarter, up 6.9 percentage points from 59.5 percent a year earlier but down 1.3 percentage points from 67.7 percent a quarter earlier.

However, the third quarter gross margin still came within the company's prediction of 65.0-67.0 percent, according to TSMC.

TSMC said chips using the 2nm process accounted for 8 percent of its total sales in the third quarter, up from 3 percent in the second quarter, while chips using the 3nm process, the 5nm process and the 7nm process made up 33 percent, 28 percent and 10 percent, respectively, of total revenue in the third quarter.

In other words, these four advanced technologies accounted for 79 percent of total sales in the third quarter, up from 77 percent in the second quarter.

TSMC posted NT$2.42 trillion in net profit in the first nine months of this year, up 68.5 percent from a year earlier with EPS at NT$78.75 as its consolidated sales totaled about NT$3.90 trillion, up 41.1 percent from a year earlier.

The nine-month gross margin stood at 66.8 percent, up 7.8 percentage points from a year earlier.

(By Chang Chien-chung and Frances Huang)

title: 黄仁勋携外甥女加入清华大学
summary: 清华突然官宣！黄仁勋、苏姿丰同时加入，马斯克、库克、扎克伯格都在！网友：全球科技大佬快凑齐了 清华大学最近公布了一份新名单，结果把全球科技圈最有名的两位芯片大佬都请来了。9月29日，清华大学经济管理学院宣布，英伟达创始人兼CEO黄仁勋、AMD董事长兼CEO苏姿丰，正式加入学院顾问委员会。两个人一个掌管着全球AI芯片市场最炙手可热的英伟达，一个带领AMD从经营困境中翻身，如今又在AI算力市场上正面竞争。 平时只要英伟达或者AMD发布一款新芯片，就能引起科技圈一阵讨论，现在两个人
content: 清华突然官宣！黄仁勋、苏姿丰同时加入，马斯克、库克、扎克伯格都在！网友：全球科技大佬快凑齐了 清华大学最近公布了一份新名单，结果把全球科技圈最有名的两位芯片大佬都请来了。9月29日，清华大学经济管理学院宣布，英伟达创始人兼CEO黄仁勋、AMD董事长兼CEO苏姿丰，正式加入学院顾问委员会。两个人一个掌管着全球AI芯片市场最炙手可热的英伟达，一个带领AMD从经营困境中翻身，如今又在AI算力市场上正面竞争。 平时只要英伟达或者AMD发布一款新芯片，就能引起科技圈一阵讨论，现在两个人却同时出现在清华大学的顾问名单里，难怪消息公布之后，不少网友都跑来围观。 更有意思的是，黄仁勋和苏姿丰还有一层很多人不知道的关系。虽然两个人分别掌管着全球最重要的两家芯片公司，在商业上竞争多年，但他们其实是远房亲戚。 按照此前公开的家族关系，两人的祖辈都与台湾台南的罗氏家族有关，论起辈分，苏姿丰还得管黄仁勋叫一声“表舅”。如今这对芯片行业的老对手，又一起成为清华经管学院的顾问委员，网友看到名单后忍不住调侃，没想到两个人除了在芯片市场上竞争，现在连兼职都找到了同一家。 不过，清华这次邀请的可不只是这两位。与黄仁勋、苏姿丰一同加入的，还有瑞士百达集团的高管百达铭。翻开清华经管学院顾问委员会现有的成员名单，才发现这份名单的阵容远比想象中夸张，苹果CEO库克、特斯拉创始人马斯克、微软CEO纳德拉、Meta创始人扎克伯格，以及摩根大通、贝莱德、桥水基金等全球金融机构的负责人，都曾出现在这个委员会的名单上。现在又加上英伟达和AMD的掌门人，全球最有影响力的科技企业，已经有相当一部分与这个委员会建立了联系。 库克当主席，马斯克、扎克伯格都是委员，清华这个委员会到底什么来头？ 很多人看到新闻之后，第一反应是黄仁勋和苏姿丰是不是要去清华当教授了，甚至有人开始开玩笑，说以后清华学生上课是不是能直接听到英伟达CEO讲AI芯片。实际上，这次任命与大学教授职位没有关系，两人加入的是清华大学经济管理学院顾问委员会，主要为学院的发展、人才培养以及国际交流提供建议，并不意味着他们会定期到学校授课。 这个委员会成立于2000年，已经有二十多年的历史，也是中国商学院较早建立的国际顾问委员会之一。成立之初，清华经管学院就希望通过这个平台，与全球知名企业家、经济学家和管理者保持联系，让学院能够了解国际商业环境的变化，同时邀请这些企业负责人参与学校发展方面的讨论。 说起来，这个委员会的背景确实不一般。2000年委员会成立时，朱镕基担任清华大学经济管理学院院长，同时也是当时的国务院总理。清华经管学院与国际工商界的联系，在那个时期就已经受到相当高的重视。后来随着中国经济和全球商业环境不断变化，委员会的成员也陆续扩大，吸纳了来自科技、金融、制造业、能源以及消费品等多个行业的企业负责人。 根据此次公布的信息，委员会目前共有69位委员，每年通常会在北京召开一次年会，讨论学院发展、管理教育以及全球经济和商业领域的重要变化。现任主席是苹果公司CEO蒂姆·库克，而成员中还有马斯克、纳德拉、扎克伯格、摩根大通CEO杰米·戴蒙、贝莱德CEO拉里·芬克以及桥水基金创始人瑞·达利欧等人。 这份名单放在一起确实有点惊人。平时这些人各自管理着市值数千亿美元甚至数万亿美元的企业，参加一次国际经济论坛，都可能成为媒体争相报道的焦点。如今他们却以顾问委员的身份，与清华经管学院保持联系，也让这个委员会在国际商学院中显得相当特别。 当然，成为顾问委员并不代表这些企业负责人需要参与学校的日常管理，也不意味着他们能够直接决定学院的招生、课程或者研究方向。对于这些平时行程安排极其紧张的企业家来说，顾问委员会更像是一个定期交流的平台，他们可以分享企业管理经验、讨论行业发展，也有机会与来自其他行业的负责人建立联系。 一个英伟达，一个AMD，这对远房亲戚如今掌握着全球AI芯片市场 黄仁勋和苏姿丰同时加入清华顾问委员会，受到这么多关注，与两家公司目前在全球科技行业的地位有很大关系。 先说黄仁勋。过去几年，随着ChatGPT等生成式人工智能产品迅速普及，英伟达几乎成为全球AI热潮中最受关注的企业之一。训练大型人工智能模型需要大量高性能计算芯片，而英伟达凭借GPU、CUDA软件生态以及数据中心产品，在这一领域占据了非常重要的位置。无论是OpenAI、微软、Meta，还是其他正在投入巨额资金建设AI基础设施的科技企业，都与英伟达的产品有着密切联系。 黄仁勋也因此成为全球科技行业最有影响力的企业家之一。英伟达市值在AI热潮中大幅增长，曾突破3万亿美元，黄仁勋本人更是频繁出现在全球科技峰会、企业发布会和各国政商界人士的会面场合。尤其是他那件几乎从不离身的黑色皮衣，已经成为科技圈相当有辨识度的形象。每次英伟达召开新品发布会，全球投资者都会关注他究竟又推出了什么新芯片，以及这些产品会给AI行业带来多大的变化。 苏姿丰的经历则很不一样。2014年，她接任AMD CEO时，公司正面临严重的经营压力，在处理器市场上长期受到英特尔竞争，财务状况也不理想。当时外界甚至有人怀疑AMD还能不能重新站稳脚跟。苏姿丰上任之后，推动公司重新调整产品研发方向，随后推出Zen架构和Ryzen处理器，逐步在个人电脑和服务器市场夺回份额。 经过多年发展，AMD已经重新成为全球半导体行业的重要企业，特别是在数据中心处理器和AI加速芯片领域，正在加大投入，希望从英伟达主导的AI算力市场中争取更多客户。如今不少大型科技企业都在寻找英伟达之外的芯片供应商，AMD也因此获得了更多机会。 黄仁勋和苏姿丰之间的亲戚关系，也一直是科技圈津津乐道的话题。两人都出生于台湾，后来在美国发展事业，最终分别成为两家美国半导体巨头的掌门人。虽然有家族渊源，但他们的职业发展路径完全不同，过去几十年也一直在各自的领域打拼。 随着AI市场竞争越来越激烈，两家公司之间的关系也变得更加微妙。英伟达在AI训练芯片领域拥有强大的市场优势，AMD则希望凭借新一代AI加速器和服务器产品吸引更多大型客户。两家公司每次发布新产品，市场都会拿来比较性能、价格、功耗和软件支持能力。如今两位CEO同时加入清华顾问委员会，也让不少人好奇，未来他们会不会在北京的年会上碰面。 美国限制高端芯片出口中国，两位CEO却同时出现在清华名单上 这次任命还有一个引人关注的背景，就是近几年中美之间不断升级的半导体技术竞争。 从2022年开始，美国政府陆续出台针对先进半导体和人工智能计算芯片的出口管制措施，限制部分高性能芯片及相关技术向中国出口。英伟达和AMD都受到这些政策影响，两家公司面向中国市场销售的部分高端AI产品，需要遵守美国政府的出口许可和技术限制要求。 中国一直是全球重要的半导体市场，也是英伟达和AMD长期经营的市场之一。对于两家公司来说，如何在遵守美国出口管制规定的同时维持中国业务，一直是管理层需要处理的问题。黄仁勋过去也曾多次公开谈到中国市场的重要性，以及出口限制可能对美国科技企业竞争力造成的影响。 苏姿丰同样需要面对类似情况。AMD近年来不断扩大数据中心和AI业务，中国市场的需求以及相关出口政策，也会影响公司的产品销售和长期规划。 两位CEO还都与美国科技政策领域保持联系。根据原文提供的信息，他们均参与美国总统科技顾问委员会相关工作，苏姿丰也担任美国半导体行业协会董事会主席。这样的身份意味着，两人除了管理企业，还会参与有关美国科技发展、半导体产业以及人工智能政策的讨论。 现在，他们又同时加入清华经管学院顾问委员会，难免让外界产生更多联想。毕竟在半导体出口管制持续存在的情况下，两位美国芯片巨头的负责人出现在中国顶尖大学的顾问名单中，本身就容易受到关注。 不过，顾问委员会主要是商学院层面的交流机制，目前没有公开信息表明，两人的加入涉及具体芯片交易、技术合作或者出口政策调整。即使未来参加委员会的活动，他们仍然需要遵守各自企业以及所在国家的相关法律和监管要求。 对于清华经管学院来说，邀请这两位企业负责人加入，也能让学院与当前AI产业的重要参与者保持直接交流。近年来，人工智能已经成为全球企业管理和商业教育中绕不开的话题，从企业如何使用AI提高效率，到AI对就业、产业结构和全球供应链的影响，都与经济管理教育有着密切关系。 清华顾问委员会的名单，也开始出现新的变化 如果仔细观察这次公布的名单，会发现清华经管学院顾问委员会近年来吸纳的企业负责人，已经不局限于传统金融、投资和咨询行业。 早些年，国际商学院的顾问委员会往往会邀请大量银行家、投资机构负责人和跨国企业管理者。这些人在资本市场、企业管理以及全球商业运营方面拥有丰富经验，也能够为商学院提供重要的行业资源。 但随着人工智能、半导体、新能源汽车以及先进制造业不断发展，全球企业的竞争重点也在发生变化。现在一家科技企业的战略决策，可能直接影响全球芯片供应、数据中心建设以及数十亿美元的基础设施投资。大学在培养未来企业管理者时，也需要更多了解这些新兴产业的实际运作方式。 根据原文介绍，2026年新增的顾问委员中，除了黄仁勋和苏姿丰，还包括来自宝马、沃尔玛、可口可乐、bp等大型企业的负责人，涉及汽车制造、零售消费、能源以及科技等不同领域。 这些企业所处的行业虽然不同，但都正在面对数字化和人工智能带来的变化。汽车企业需要投入智能驾驶和电动化技术，零售企业正在使用AI改善库存管理和供应链，能源公司也在研究如何通过新技术降低运营成本。对于商学院来说，能够直接与这些企业的负责人交流，确实有助于了解不同行业正在发生的变化。 而黄仁勋和苏姿丰的加入，也让委员会在半导体和AI基础设施领域拥有了更具代表性的成员。 消息公布后，中文社交平台上的讨论也相当热闹。有人感叹清华顾问委员会的阵容越来越豪华，库克、马斯克、扎克伯格、纳德拉已经在名单里，如今又加上黄仁勋和苏姿丰，全球科技圈最有名的几位CEO几乎都能在这里找到。 还有网友开玩笑，清华以后开顾问委员会年会，光是安排这些企业家的座位就够有意思了，毕竟其中不少公司平时在商业上存在直接竞争关系。 也有人关注另一件事：这些企业家每年究竟会花多少时间参与学院活动？毕竟无论是英伟达还是AMD，两位CEO平时都需要处理大量公司事务，能否亲自出席北京的年度会议，以及未来会参与哪些具体活动，目前还没有详细安排。 清华经管学院此次已经正式公布三位新委员的任命，黄仁勋和苏姿丰也由此进入同一份顾问名单。至于两位芯片行业的老对手会不会在下一次北京年会上同框，甚至一起参与讨论AI产业的发展，接下来还要看学院公布的具体日程。

title: 澳洲进口商今起需缴纳保证金，最高达 73.3%
summary: 澳大利亚国际贸易监察机构发现，中国铝制门窗在澳存在“倾销”行为，大幅压低本地价格，损害了澳大利亚产业。 从今天起，进口这些商品的公司还必须在产品入境时缴纳财务保证金，这引发了关于建筑成本上升和中国可能报复的警告。 在一份初步报告中，澳大利亚贸易救济委员会（前身为反倾销委员会）发现，除一家外，所有中国出口商在2024年7月1日至去年6月30日期间均存在倾销行为。委员会发现，这些商品的倾销幅度为其正常价格的5.3%至70.4%，具体取决于出口商。一些出口商还被发现从中国各级政府获
content: 澳大利亚国际贸易监察机构发现，中国铝制门窗在澳存在“倾销”行为，大幅压低本地价格，损害了澳大利亚产业。 从今天起，进口这些商品的公司还必须在产品入境时缴纳财务保证金，这引发了关于建筑成本上升和中国可能报复的警告。 在一份初步报告中，澳大利亚贸易救济委员会（前身为反倾销委员会）发现，除一家外，所有中国出口商在2024年7月1日至去年6月30日期间均存在倾销行为。委员会发现，这些商品的倾销幅度为其正常价格的5.3%至70.4%，具体取决于出口商。一些出口商还被发现从中国各级政府获得了适度补贴。 委员会发现，中国进口产品对澳大利亚产业“造成了实质性损害”。委员会估计，在调查期间，本地铝制门窗市场价值约28亿澳元。中国进口产品占总销售额的19%，澳大利亚约占79%，其余2%来自其他国家。根据报告，本地制造商的销售量从2021年7月到2025年6月下降了约19%。 与此同时，报告显示，其销售额从2023财年的峰值下降了约14%。委员会发现，其审查的一半招标和报价比预期价格低约30%，而超过四分之一的价格被压低了40%或更多。委员会估计，澳大利亚产业因“来自中国的倾销和/或补贴进口产品”的压价而损失了约3.5亿澳元。 委员会提议建议工业与创新部长Tim Ayres发布针对中国商品的倾销税通知，这将导致对这些进口产品征收关税。根据中澳自由贸易协定，中国制造的铝制门窗目前不面临关税。 Ayres先生的发言人表示，阿尔巴尼斯政府支持自由和公平贸易。“澳大利亚贸易救济委员会根据行业申请，启动严格、基于证据的调查，”他们说。“任何实施的贸易救济措施都完全符合澳大利亚在贸易协定下的义务。” 保证金可能“有效导致价格上涨” 在调查继续进行期间，专员表示需要财务保证金来“防止对澳大利亚产业造成实质性损害”。从今天起，进口商必须提供价值为其产品价值5.3%至73.3%的财务保证金。百分比将取决于出口公司。这些保证金是针对可能 later 应缴关税的财务担保。工业部长将就是否征收任何关税做出最终决定。 新南威尔士大学国际经济法教授Zhou Weihuan表示，关税很可能会被征收，因为委员会初步报告中的结论“很难改变”。他说，保证金可能“有效导致价格上涨”，因为进口商会将其计入定价。“价格影响将包括进口铝制门窗价格上涨，这反过来会推高商业和住宅建筑的建筑成本，”Zhou教授说。 “保护竞争免受不公平贸易影响” 调查于11月25日开始，此前Ventora Group和澳大利亚玻璃与窗户协会（AGWA）提出申请。申请称，本地产业因销售损失和价格抑制而“遭受了实质性损害”。 “我们不是要求政府保护澳大利亚企业免受竞争，”AGWA首席执行官Clinton Skeoch告诉ABC。“我们要求政府保护竞争免受不公平贸易影响。”AGWA对保证金表示欢迎，称这对一个面临倾销进口产品巨大压力的行业来说是“一项重要且积极的进展”。 ABC已联系中国商务部和中国大使馆寻求置评。 Zhou教授表示，中国不太可能报复，因为历史上中国对澳大利亚采取的反倾销和反补贴行动远少于澳大利亚对中国采取的行动。“但这并非不可能，如果中国决定采取行动，农产品出口可能是目标，”他说。 Ventora委托对进口中国窗户进行测试，AGWA公布了结果。委员会表示，其在初步调查结果中没有考虑测试结果或其他关于产品质量或合规性的指控。 澳大利亚建筑商协会（Master Builders Australia）代理首席执行官Melissa Byrne表示，该组织将“仔细审查委员会的调查结果”。“与此同时，任何增加建筑成本的措施都出现在住房可负担性和项目可行性仍面临巨大压力之际，”她说。她说，澳大利亚“绝不能限制高质量、合规的建筑产品和材料的流动”。 最终建议预计不迟于12月16日提交。部长的决定预计在收到建议后30天内做出。最终报告将在部长决定后公布。 最终建议预计不迟于12月16日提交。部长的决定预计在收到建议后30天内做出。最终报告将在部长决定后公布。

title: Taiwan president urges Micron, unions to negotiate 'sincerely' ahead of possible strike
zh_title: 台湾总统敦促美光科技与工会在可能的罢工之前“真诚地”进行谈判
summary: 台湾商界总裁赖清德呼吁美光科技及其台湾员工就可能导致罢工的奖金纠纷进行真诚谈判。他在美光新工厂发表讲话时敦促建立和谐的劳资关系，而美光表示 2027 年产能已售罄。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:44 HKT · 2 分钟阅读台湾总统赖清德周四呼吁美国内存芯片制造商美光科技
content:
商务
台湾总统赖清德呼吁美光科技及其台湾工人就可能导致罢工的奖金纠纷进行真诚谈判。他在美光新工厂发表讲话时敦促建立和谐的劳资关系，而美光表示 2027 年产能已售罄。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:44 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

台湾总统赖清德周四呼吁美国存储芯片制造商美光科技及其工人在该公司台湾工会可能举行罢工之前“真诚地”进行谈判。

上周，代表美光科技工人的台湾工会表示，已获得其成员的授权，可以就该公司奖金计划的争议进行罢工，导致该芯片制造商最大制造中心的劳资冲突升级。美光科技在台湾拥有约 15,000 名员工，并表示其在台湾的投资超过 1.6 万亿新台币（494 亿美元）。
黎智英在台中一家新的美光先进组装和测试工厂的开业典礼上发表讲话时表示，他希望政府和私营部门能够共同努力，促进劳资之间加强沟通。我们也希望劳资双方秉持鱼需要水、水需要鱼的精神，继续真诚协商，凝聚最广泛共识。” “只有营造和谐劳动关系，才能双方共赢，让员工安心工作，让企业走得稳、走得更远。”

赖表示，他赞赏美光科技对台湾的承诺，并希望美光科技继续扩大在台湾的投资，并补充说美光科技已获得政府对高带宽内存（HBM）研发的支持。台湾是美光 DRAM 和 HBM 芯片的重要生产中心，这些芯片用于人工智能服务器。

美光科技总裁兼首席运营官曼尼什·巴蒂亚 (Manish Bhatia) 在赖智发表讲话前不久发表的评论中没有提及可能采取的罢工行动。他表示：“我们已经售出了该工厂将在 2027 年建造的所有产能，我们预计到 2028 年，高带宽内存的增长速度将比 DRAM 行业的其他产品增长得更快。”
美光台中工会告诉路透社，期待该公司与他们进行“更实质性的对话和谈判”。美光及其位于桃园的其他工会都没有立即回应对赖的言论发表评论的请求。

上周，代表美光桃园和台中工厂员工的两个工会表示，希望公司能够为员工提出具体的利润分享提案。与桃园工会的调解于9月未能达成协议，而台中工会仍在谈判中。工会鼓励会员在 10 月 19 日休息一天，参加在台北举行的集会，他们表示这不会是罢工。

Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te called on Micron Technology and its Taiwan workers to negotiate sincerely over a bonus dispute that could lead to a strike. Speaking at a new Micron facility, he urged harmonious labour relations, while Micron said 2027 capacity is already sold out.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 13:44 HKT · 2 min read

Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te called on Thursday for US memory chipmaker Micron Technology and its workers to negotiate "sincerely" ahead of a possible strike by the company's union in Taiwan.

Last week, a Taiwanese union representing workers at Micron said it had secured authorisation from its members to strike over a dispute concerning the company's bonus scheme, escalating a labour conflict at the chipmaker's largest manufacturing hub. Micron employs about 15,000 people in Taiwan and has said it invested more than T$1.6 trillion ($49.4 billion) on the island.

Speaking in Taichung at the opening of a new Micron advanced assembly and testing facility, Lai said he hoped the government and private sector could work together to promote stronger communication between labour and management. "We also hope both labour and management will uphold the spirit that fish need water and water needs fish, continuing to negotiate sincerely and in good faith to build the broadest possible consensus," he added. "Only by creating harmonious labour relations can both sides win, allowing employees to work with peace of mind and businesses to move steadily and go further."

Lai said he appreciated Micron's commitment to Taiwan and hoped it would continue expanding investment on the island, adding that Micron had secured government support for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) research and development. Taiwan is a crucial production hub for Micron's DRAM and HBM chips, which are used in AI servers.

Manish Bhatia, Micron's president and chief operating officer, made no mention of a possible strike action in his comments delivered shortly before Lai's. "We have already sold out all the capacity for 2027 that this factory will build and we expect high-bandwidth memory to grow faster than the rest of the DRAM industry all the way through 2028," he said.

Micron's Taichung union told Reuters that it looked forward to the company engaging in "more substantive dialogue and negotiations" with them. Neither Micron nor its other union, in Taoyuan, immediately responded to requests for comment on Lai's remarks.

Last week, the two unions representing workers at Micron's Taoyuan and Taichung operations said they hoped the company would put forward a concrete profit-sharing proposal for employees. Mediation with the Taoyuan union ended without agreement in September, while the Taichung union remains in negotiations. The unions are encouraging members to take a day off on October 19 to join a rally in Taipei, which they said would not be a strike.

# PetroChina to launch first LNG bunker fuelling in Singapore

PetroChina International will bunker a vessel with liquefied natural gas in Singapore for the first time on Thursday, its chairman said, expanding alternative-fuel options at the world's top refuelling port. The company also completes a methanol bunker vessel acquisition on Friday amid rapid growth

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 14:25 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=PetroChina%20to%20launch%20first%20LNG%20bunker%20fuelling%20in%20Singapore%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/PetroChina-to-launch-first-LNG-bunker-fuelling-in-Singapore-0a457a "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/PetroChina-to-launch-first-LNG-bunker-fuelling-in-Singapore-0a457a&text=PetroChina%20to%20launch%20first%20LNG%20bunker%20fuelling%20in%20Singapore "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/PetroChina-to-launch-first-LNG-bunker-fuelling-in-Singapore-0a457a "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/PetroChina-to-launch-first-LNG-bunker-fuelling-in-Singapore-0a457a&text=PetroChina%20to%20launch%20first%20LNG%20bunker%20fuelling%20in%20Singapore "X")[](mailto:?subject=PetroChina%20to%20launch%20first%20LNG%20bunker%20fuelling%20in%20Singapore&body=PetroChina%20to%20launch%20first%20LNG%20bunker%20fuelling%20in%20Singapore%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/PetroChina-to-launch-first-LNG-bunker-fuelling-in-Singapore-0a457a "Email")

PetroChina International will use liquefied natural gas (LNG) to bunker a vessel in Singapore for the first time on Thursday, Chairman Wu Junli said, widening the alternative-fuel options it can offer shipowners at the world's top refuelling port.

The trading arm of Chinese state major PetroChina (0857) was one of eight firms that received LNG bunkering licences from the Singapore government, and it also has a licence to supply methanol to ships. Wu made the remarks at the Singapore International Bunkering conference.

PetroChina will also complete the acquisition of a methanol bunker vessel on Friday, Wu said. Citing data from Clarksons, he said by the end of 2025, orders globally for alternative-fuel vessels had neared 2,000 ships, including more than 1,200 LNG-fuelled vessels.

"Methanol-fuelled vessels are expanding rapidly, while ammonia-fuelled vessels are beginning to gain momentum," he said. However, infrastructure for emerging marine fuels significantly lags fleet development, he noted, with the number of existing and planned methanol bunkering ports remaining below 50 versus 220 LNG bunker ports worldwide.

PetroChina accounted for about 10 per cent of Singapore bunker sales last year, which exceeded 56 million metric tons. The company sold 7.95 million tons of bunker fuel globally last year and can supply 18 ports with 16 bunker vessels on time charter, he added.

Last year, PetroChina completed its first commercial LNG bunkering operation in Europe and secured methanol bunkering qualification in Rotterdam in the Netherlands. China has the capacity to produce 380,000 tons per year of green methanol, Wu said.

zh_title: 香港金融管理局推出“ART”框架，促进银行业负责任地使用人工智能
summary: 香港金融管理局推出了“ART”框架，指导银行负责任地采用人工智能，重点关注问责制、弹性和信任。措施包括更新监管指南、人工智能培训数据共享平台以及 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 治理咨询 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 10 月 15 日2026 at 14:30 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 香港金融管理局（HKMA）周四（10 月）公布
content:
香港
香港金融管理局推出了“ART”框架，指导银行负责任地采用人工智能，重点关注问责制、弹性和信任。措施包括更新监管指南、人工智能培训数据共享平台以及治理咨询

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 14:30 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港金融管理局（金管局）周四（10月15日）宣布推出“ART”框架，支持银行业负责任地采用人工智能（AI），旨在建立一个负责任、有弹性和值得信赖的人工智能银行生态系统。

金管局表示，随着人工智能系统变得更加自主，可以调动更多数据、工具和工作流程，该框架旨在帮助银行抓住人工智能机遇，同时保持良好的治理和运营弹性。该框架下的具体措施包括发布关于负责任的人工智能应用的最新监管指南，其中纳入了生成人工智能（GenAI）沙箱第二阶段的见解。
金管局还与数码港和香港大学合作建立人工智能培训数据共享平台，以数据质量保证为核心设计原则。此外，“GenA.I.Sandbox++”将进一步测试代理人工智能应用，并将发布关于代理人工智能治理拟议监管框架的讨论文件，探索基于意图的问责安排、重要人工智能代理的登记册和有效的干预机制。

金管局与数码港合办「金融+人工智能」 10月15-16日的论坛，标志着第二阶段GenAI沙盒技术测试圆满结束。超过 60% 的用例涉及探索代理 AI，反映了业界对复杂 AI 系统的积极进步，例如在授权和受控边界内自动规划和执行多步骤任务。

金管局副总裁袁国强表示：“人工智能从生成型向代理型的演变代表了银行业创新的一个重要新阶段。在‘金融科技2030’框架下，金管局推出了‘ART’框架，代表问责制、弹性和信任，为银行负责任地开发和部署人工智能提供明确的基础。通过将创新、明确的问责安排、弹性运营模式和有效的人力监督相结合，银行可以充分利用人工智能的优势，同时保持信任和银行的稳定性。香港的金融体系。”

Hong Kong
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority has launched an 'ART' framework to guide banks in responsibly adopting artificial intelligence, focusing on accountability, resilience and trust. Measures include updated regulatory guidance, an AI training data sharing platform, and a consultation on governance for

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 14:30 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) announced on Thursday (October 15) an "ART" framework to support the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in the banking sector, aiming to build an AI-enabled banking ecosystem that is accountable, resilient and trustworthy.

As AI systems become more autonomous and can mobilise more data, tools and workflows, the HKMA said the framework is designed to help banks seize AI opportunities while maintaining sound governance and operational resilience. Specific measures under the framework include issuing updated regulatory guidance on responsible AI application, which incorporates insights from the second phase of the Generative AI (GenAI) sandbox.

The HKMA is also partnering with Cyberport and the University of Hong Kong to build an AI training data sharing platform, with data quality assurance as a core design principle. In addition, the "GenA.I. Sandbox++" will further test agentic AI applications, and a discussion paper will be published on a proposed regulatory framework for agentic AI governance, exploring intent-based accountability arrangements, a register of significant AI agents, and effective intervention mechanisms.

The HKMA and Cyberport co-hosted the "Finance + A.I." forum on October 15 and 16, marking the successful conclusion of the second-phase GenAI sandbox technical testing. More than 60 per cent of use cases involved exploring agentic AI, reflecting the industry's active advancement of sophisticated AI systems, such as automatic planning and executing multi-step tasks within authorised and controlled boundaries.

Arthur Yuen, Deputy Chief Executive of the HKMA, said: "AI's evolution from generative to agentic represents an important new phase in banking innovation. Under 'Fintech 2030', the HKMA has launched the 'ART' framework, which stands for accountability, resilience and trust, to provide a clear foundation for banks to develop and deploy AI responsibly. By combining innovation, clear accountability arrangements, resilient operating models and effective human oversight, banks can fully harness the benefits of AI while maintaining trust and the stability of Hong Kong's financial system."

韩联社釜山10月15日电 中国留学生涉嫌在韩擅拍军事设施案二审15日宣判，两名被告人均被判有罪，法院维持原审判决。

釜山高等法院刑事审判第一庭当天就上述案件进行宣判，判处被告人A某有期徒刑1年半，判处被告人B某有期徒刑1年、缓刑2年。

A某和B某涉嫌于2023年3月至2024年6月使用中国制造的无人机和手机，未经许可共9次拍摄釜山海军作战司令部，以及为参加作战访韩的美国海军航母“西奥多·罗斯福”号。2024年6月25日，时任总统尹锡悦访问“西奥多·罗斯福”号时，两人使用无人机企图拍摄活动现场。

两名被告人均被指控违反《军事基地及军事设施保护法》，A某还被指控涉嫌一般利敌罪。原审法院认定检方对A某的两大指控均成立，但由于军舰和航母本身不属于军事设施，认定A某拍摄军舰和航母的行为无罪。二审法院指出，综合原审法院判处有罪的依据以及大法院有关一般利敌罪的判例，原审法院判处被告人有罪符合法理。（完）

content:
中央社记者 Zachary Lee

伯利兹总理约翰·布里塞尼奥呼吁通过投资、技术交流和人文联系与台湾深化合作，并表示希望这些联系将为伯利兹的发展做出贡献。

周三，布里塞尼奥在曼谷接受中央社专访时，热情评价了伯利兹与台湾的密切关系，并强调了在虾养殖技术和实用技术交流等领域的潜在合作潜力。

## 伯利兹寻求台湾投资和技术

66 岁的布里塞尼奥表示，伯利兹的年轻人口是技术合作的优势。

“我们有一群年轻人，他们从大专到大学，学得很快。所以这些都是我们可以合作的领域，”他强调说。

布里塞尼奥表示，在人工智能开发领域，与台湾的合作不一定要从最先进的技术开始，而是可以专注于满足伯利兹需求的实用解决方案。

“例如，虾类养殖技术是台湾可以做出贡献的领域之一，”他说。

他还强调了人文交流的价值，称在伯利兹工作的台湾学生可以帮助加强两国之间的关系。

目前，有六名台湾交换生在伯利兹政府部门和其他领域工作。
伯利兹领导人表示，对伯利兹来说，吸引商业投资和建设技术能力是扩大经济机会和提高生活水平的更广泛努力的一部分。

## 伯利兹呼吁更多地考虑小国

布里塞尼奥作为伯利兹财政部长兼世界银行小国论坛主席出席在曼谷举行的国际货币基金组织和世界银行集团 2026 年年会。

他在接受中央社采访时表示，国际金融机构需要考虑到小国有限的行政能力和资源。

他举例说，他的国家在参与世界银行资助的项目以帮助小农增强应对气候变化的能力时面临挑战。

布里塞尼奥表示，当伯利兹完成冗长的申请程序时，已接近截止日期，他不得不请求世界银行延长期限。

## Other challenges faced by small countries

布里塞尼奥说，气候变化是影响小国的问题之一。布里塞尼奥说，目前，加勒比岛国和该地区其他沿海国家正在应对大量涌入的褐马尾藻，这威胁到旅游业的主要经济命脉，并呼吁采取区域解决方案。
总理表示，在伯利兹，鉴于税基有限，另一个重大挑战是为其分布广泛的约 42 万人口提供基本基础设施和服务。

“我们必须不断地思考如何在提供基本服务、供水、供电以及教育和保健方面找到平衡，”他说，并解释说伯利兹有 196 个小社区。

布里塞尼奥说，政府必须平衡居民的需求与有限的资源，同时保持财政可持续性。

## 伯利兹重申支持台湾

布里塞尼奥重申，作为台湾的长期伙伴，伯利兹致力于发展与台湾的关系，并表示中国最近对伯利兹外交部长实施制裁

By Zachary Lee, CNA staff reporter

Belize Prime Minister John Briceño has called for deeper cooperation with Taiwan through investment, technology exchanges, and people-to-people ties, saying that he hopes those links will contribute to his country's development.

In an exclusive interview with CNA in Bangkok on Wednesday, Briceño spoke warmly of Belize's close ties with Taiwan and highlighted areas such as shrimp farming technology and practical technology exchanges for potential cooperation.

## Belize seeks Taiwanese investment and technology

Briceño, 66, said Belize's young population was an advantage for technology cooperation.

"We have a young population, and they go to junior college on to university, and they learn quickly. So these are areas where we can collaborate," he emphasized.

In the field of AI development, cooperation with Taiwan does not necessarily have to begin with the most advanced technologies, but instead could focus on practical solutions that meet Belize's needs, Briceño said.

"For example, shrimp farming technology is one area where Taiwan could contribute," he said.

He also emphasized the value of people-to-people exchanges, saying that Taiwanese students working in Belize could help strengthen ties between the two countries.

Currently, there are six Taiwanese exchange students working in government ministries and other fields in Belize.

For Belize, attracting business investment and building technological capacity are part of a broader effort to expand economic opportunities and improve living standards, according to its leader.

## Belize calls for greater consideration of small states

Briceño is attending the 2026 Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Group in Bangkok as Belize's finance minister and chair of the World Bank's Small States Forum.

In his interview with CNA, he said international financial institutions need to take into account the limited administrative capacity and resources of small countries.

He cited as an example the challenge his country faced in participating in a World Bank-funded project to help small farmers strengthen their resilience to climate change.

Briceño said that by the time Belize had completed the lengthy application procedure, it was close to the deadline, and he had to ask the World Bank to extend the timeframe.

## Other challenges faced by small countries

Climate change is one of the issues affecting small nations, Briceño said. Currently, Caribbean island nations and other coastal countries in the region are dealing with a massive influx of brown sargassum seaweed, which threatens tourism -- a major economic lifeline, Briceño said, calling for regional solutions.

In Belize, another significant challenge is providing basic infrastructure and services to its widely dispersed population of about 420,000, given its limited tax base, the prime minister said.

"We have to constantly see how we can find that balance in providing basic services, access to water, access to electricity, and access to education and health," he said, explaining that Belize has 196 small communities.

The government must balance residents' needs against its limited resources while maintaining fiscal sustainability, Briceño said.

## Belize reaffirms support for Taiwan

As a long-standing partner of Taiwan, Belize is committed to its relations with Taiwan, Briceño reaffirmed, saying China's recent sanctions against Belize's Minister of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade Francis Fonseca will not change that position.

Belize is an independent country with the right to decide which countries it maintains relations with, Briceño said, condemning China's sanctions as unreasonable, unnecessary, wrong and illegal.

That move by China will only serve to strengthen Belize's resolve to support Taiwan, he said.

"We strongly believe in the right to self-determination," he said, arguing that Taiwan's strengths in the economy, technology, artificial intelligence, health care, education and climate research warrant recognition by the United Nations and other international organizations.

Briceño, who began his second term as prime minister in 2025, said he wants Belize to remain a free and democratic country with a vibrant economy capable of providing for its people.

# DEFENSE/Taiwan watching for large-scale PLA drills as peak season nears

China’s Liaoning aircraft carrier. CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) The Ministry of National Defense (MND) said Thursday that it was closely monitoring the possibility of large-scale Chinese military exercises near Taiwan as the traditional peak season for People's Liberation Army (PLA) drills approaches.

At a news conference Thursday, defense officials were asked whether a large-scale exercise encircling Taiwan could take place as the PLA's November-December peak season approaches.

Pan Chun-kuang (潘俊光), an official from the Office of the Deputy Chief of the General Staff for Intelligence, said the MND was using joint intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities to monitor the PLA's latest activities.

The ministry had noticed that China had recently been using propaganda about its military activities to step up its cognitive warfare efforts, Pan said.

"We see this as behavior that disrupts regional stability," he said, adding that the ministry would remain on high alert and respond appropriately to such behavior.

Asked about a naval fleet led by China's Liaoning aircraft carrier, which began what Beijing described as "routine drills" in the western Pacific on Wednesday, Pan said the activities had drawn concern from countries in the region and put them on alert.

The PLA Navy has said the drills were "not directed at any country or target."

The MND would monitor the situation closely and take precautions, Pan said.

China staged a large-scale exercise encircling Taiwan in August 2022, shortly after then-United States House Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taiwan.

Similar exercises have since become a regular occurrence, with at least one held each year from 2023 to 2025.

The PLA has not staged one this year.

(By Sean Lin)

## Details

There are many groups promoting this event.

Our meetup group is participating by promoting this event.

This event is organized by Albert's List.

This is an online event.

Attendees can be located anywhere in the world!

There is a cost to attend this event.
 Our Meetup members get 25% OFF with Code MEETUP

In order to attend, please register here:
[https://www.eventbrite.com/e/3-hours-to-research-intelligence-build-your-first-ai-agent-tickets-2000234969639?discount=MEETUP&keep_tld=true](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/3-hours-to-research-intelligence-build-your-first-ai-agent-tickets-2000234969639?discount=MEETUP&keep_tld=true)
 You're either looking at a company to join, or you're trying to understand what your competitors are doing. Either way, you're researching blind—reading scattered reviews, googling company news, checking LinkedIn. It takes forever and you miss things.
 Stop doing this manually.
 In this workshop, you'll customize and deploy a working AI research agent in 3 hours. Fork an existing competitive intelligence agent, wire in your own data sources (RSS feeds, APIs, whatever's available), and run it. Feed it a company or industry keyword. Get back structured intelligence: recent news, hiring patterns, market positioning, gaps, red flags.
**What you'll actually do:**

*   Clone a working competitive intelligence agent from GitHub
*   Add your own custom data sources (RSS feeds, open APIs, etc.)
*   Test it live on a real company or competitor
*   Walk away with a deployed agent you can run 100+ times

**Two use cases, one agent:**

1.   **Job Seeker Mode** — Research a company before you apply, interview, or accept an offer. Understand growth, hiring, leadership, red flags.
2.   **Competitive Mode** — Understand what competitors are doing, market gaps, hiring trends, strategic moves. For employees and side hustlers.

**What you need before the workshop:**

*   10 min of pre-work (optional, but recommended): Clone the GitHub repo, set up your API key, test it runs
*   A laptop with a browser ([Claude.ai](http://claude.ai/))
*   Basic comfort with Claude—you should already be asking it questions and iterating

**After the workshop:**

*   Post-work recap doc: What you built, how to iterate, advanced techniques, troubleshooting
*   Optional upsell: Advanced agent techniques course (separate paid offering)

**This is NOT:**

*   A tutorial on "how to use AI"
*   A guide to corporate strategy
*   A tool for stalking or privacy violations (we cover ethical guardrails)

**Price:** $17–27 (one-time, includes materials + post-work doc)
**Pre-work is optional.** If you complete it, you'll hit the ground running. If you skip it, no problem—we'll set up during the first 20 minutes.

title: Morning Meditation Wake Up Together with Trina Truong, Wed, Oct 21, 2026, 6:30 AM   | Meetup
summary: **[Wake Up Together](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)**[](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)is an online meditation community that was established in 2020 by Trina Truong and partners. Our mission is to help support individu
content:
**[Wake Up Together](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)**[](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/community)is an online meditation community that was established in 2020 by Trina Truong and partners. Our mission is to help support individuals in maintaining a solid meditation practice through practicing in an accessible and open-minded community. We meet every day, virtually. While we are rooted in the Vipassana-Insight tradition, our approach is also inclusive to all Buddhist meditation practices such as anapanasati (mindfulness of the breath), Metta (loving-kindness), body scans, Zen, ton glen, and others.

The space that our meditators come to know is one that expresses itself as welcoming and embodying all views and interpretations of spirituality.

We hold the commitment to remain humble and vulnerable in our role as the door openers to the individual's inner journey. We aspire to shape the experience for participants to experience serenity, clear-seeing and profound understanding of the mind, and the [no] self through the practices, the guidance, the teachings, and the reflections offered in group sharing.

To solidify this spiritual aspiration is to make a commitment to sit in community with a predetermined frequency or as often as you can.
 We welcome you to join our beloved community!
**[Register to Join](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdJF26i6aTbMKLzw53MiwlehbsGaJG5qmVBPQEWwQ6WCOirKg/viewform)**

These guided meditations are offered daily and given freely. There
 are no up-front fees. Wake Up Together is 100% donation based,
 relying on your support and generosity.
**[100% Donation Base](https://www.wakeuptogether.org/giving)**

All are welcome to be a part of our evening service. Experience not necessary. Those of any faith or lack thereof are welcome. *   Check in. (How you’re doing.)
*   Silent meditation, seated on cushion, chair, or one of the pews.

content: 作者：呉祚來 央廣 Rti  2026-10-14 韌性是一種綿軟的力量，或者說是難以脆斷的內在生命力，前總統蔡英文在美西時間 8 日出席史丹佛大學胡佛研究所舉辦的論壇，以「新聞標題之外的臺灣：臺灣如何用民主建構韌性」為題發表演說，在蔡英文看來，臺灣的韌性，來自民主制度的保障、社會團結的力量、務實的安全防衛、創新的經濟基礎，以及持續自我更新的能力。臺灣的韌性，是人民選擇自由，並在挑戰中不斷前行的力量。 而哥倫比亞大學教授黎安友二十多年前提出的威權韌性理論，曾經揭示中共制度化改革對於政權延續的重要意義。今天，隨著最高權力重新集中、接班慣例弱化、社會自主空間收縮，一個新的問題出現了：當原先支撐威權韌性的制度化機制受到削弱，政權還能在多大程度上依靠組織控制和行政動員應對新的危機？高度集中的權力能夠迅速作出決策，但如果缺乏真實的資訊反饋與有效的糾錯機制，也可能使局部錯誤演變為全局風險。 本文將就上述話題分別綜述與分析，以比照民主體制與威權體制社會的韌性及其可持續性。 臺灣的韌性：民主社會面對挑戰的力量 蔡英文在演講中分析了臺灣的韌性究竟是什麼？它不僅是面對外部威脅時的抵抗能力，更是一個民主社會在危機中保持自由、凝聚共識、維護安全並不斷發展的綜合能力。 蔡英文認為民主有時顯得吵雜與混亂，然而在真正關鍵的時刻，人們願意保持彈性、放下分歧、形成共同力量並尋找共識，這正是所謂的「民主韌性」。她同時強調，臺灣不希望外界僅因所面對的危險或外部威脅而認識自己，而是希望世界看見臺灣人民共同建立的社會。面對網路攻擊、假訊息操作、供應鏈中斷等日益複雜的挑戰，臺灣持續參與世界、為世界做出貢獻的決心不會動搖。 在兩岸關係上，蔡英文表示，處理相關問題需要充分準備與必要的克制。臺灣社會已形成「維持兩岸現狀、避免不必要挑釁、保護自身民主與安全」的廣泛共識；民主的韌性也要靠軍事實力維繫，蔡英文提到：「在我擔任總統的 2016 到 2024 年之間，臺灣也從不同面向強化韌性。國防支出增加超過八成，同一期間 GDP 成長將近四成；我們也投入更多資源，強化不對稱戰力以及關鍵基礎設施。」以強大的實力平衡兩岸關係，使臺灣和平不至於因武統力量的強大而被破壞。 她進一步提到，臺灣提供給世界的不僅是半導體與科技，更是一個有豐富經驗、有能力與他人分享的夥伴。她呼籲民主國家結合各自優勢，共同打造更具韌性的合作體系，讓安全、產業與民主得以相互支撐。 我認同蔡英文的演講觀點，要補充的是，臺灣民主韌性，不僅來自制度，也來自沒有割裂傳統人文道德倫理精神，我多次到臺灣參觀考察時，既能感受到民間社會的自由隨意，也能感受到特有的人情良善，傳統德性與現代政治體現了完美融合，臺灣不僅有現代政治文明帶來的自由平等紅利，也有傳統文化多元，社會高親善度的深厚背景。 地緣政治與國際政治上，臺灣與美國、日本等民主國家親善，形成文明國家共同體，保障了臺灣在戰略上的安全，臺灣不僅是臺灣人民的臺灣，也是第一島鏈居核心地位的軍事要津，並關乎印太特別是南中國海的航行安全。 本文還要進一步強調，臺灣制度的韌性，在外交領域也表現卓異，中共利用金元外交，使許多中小國家與臺灣斷交，但臺灣卻表現出不凡的外交智慧，既強化印太區域合作，與制度相同的國家、國家利益一致的國家形成合力，又與歐美文明國家議會或社會各界合作，使臺灣議題得以提升與關注。 無論政治、經濟、外交還是軍事位置，臺灣憑藉自身的制度韌性、經濟實力、國際合作及重要戰略位置，不僅增強了自身應對危機的能力，也成為影響印太地區安全與全球經濟穩定的重要力量。 中共政權的威權韌性是否依舊？ 中共政權是不是也有制度性的韌性？美國哥倫比亞大學政治學者黎安友（ Andrew J. Nathan ）於 2003 年發表《威權韌性》一文，黎安友最初認為，中共具備韌性是因為它擺脫了毛澤東時代的個人獨裁，走向了「制度化威權」 —— 包括建立有規律的高層接班機制、黨內規範化協商、功能專業化的官僚體系，以及有限度的社會表達空間。 黎安友對習近平時代的分析指出，中共高層政治在集權化進程中發生了顯著變化。習近平上台後打破了許多此前相對制度化的安排，將大量權力收歸自身，通過強化集中領導和政治紀律壓縮公民社會空間，並把反腐與黨紀整頓轉變為由最高層直接掌控的垂直體系。從組織與紀律角度看，官僚機器因此顯得更為嚴密強大；但高壓環境也帶來資訊上的脆弱，基層與官員因畏懼而不敢如實反映情況，最高決策層難以準確掌握公眾與民間的真實想法，增加了決策脫離現實的風險。（美國之音 2018 年 2 月 28 日） 有限任期的修憲改變進一步放大了這種不確定性：國家主席任期限制被廢除、終身化執政格局形成後，高層政治失去了可預測的接班規則，潛在的權力鬥爭與不穩定性隨之上升，這也使最高權力交接面臨新的不確定性。在經濟與政權存亡的關係上，黎安友並不認同簡單的「經濟崩潰論」，國際層面，習近平領導下的中共仍通過經濟、外交與軍事等手段積極擴大影響力。 我認同黎安友教授上述精闢的分析，我想進一步強調，在鄧、江、胡時代，政權的韌性主要依賴經濟的高速增長，而這與美國、歐洲對華政策相關。中國加入世界貿易組織，與美國及歐洲主要經濟體的市場開放、國際資本和全球產業鏈的深度參與密切相關。世界資本主義的血不僅使經歷文革大潰敗的中國獲得了生機，同時也成長為紅色巨龍，這是當年中共強有力韌性的前提條件。 當時中共內部不成文的規則：「七上八下」的高層退出機制與「隔代指定」的最高領導繼位方式的確立，使高層權力過渡平穩有序，也保證了高層的派系平衡。相比毛的終身制與習的修憲後連任，它使中共內政有了韌性，難以脆斷。 我們再看經濟，中共政權在兩個層面上均已失去韌性：一是國內經濟依賴的人口與地產紅利盡失，地方政府正在失去經濟支撐；二是世界工廠優勢的外向出口，因歐美相關進口關稅，使大量企業外移，隨著歐美強化關稅管控、甚至在高端技術與產品上實施禁運，為了經濟安全一步步與中共脫鉤，即便中共經濟一時不會脆斷，但已失去可持續發展的內外動力，原有的經濟韌性，也隨之弱化。 還有就是中共體制性的脆弱性：體制內與體制外、城市與鄉村、發達地區與邊遠不發達區域，貧富分化加劇，使中國社會極易產生不穩定因素，一旦經濟或政治危機爆發，社會就會劇烈動盪，政權極易更替。 結語：真正的韌性，是制度能夠糾正自身的錯誤 比較臺灣與中國大陸的制度韌性，我們發現一個值得深思的政治現象：威權體制可以擁有強大的組織動員能力，能夠集中資源、控制社會、維持政權運轉；民主社會則通過權力競爭、公民參與、社會自治和公開討論，形成另一種制度適應能力。威權體制無法遏制通過集權走向極權的危境，可以說，集權度越高，剛性越強，韌性越弱，而這極大增加了威權體制的脆斷風險。 臺灣的經驗則提供了另一種觀察視角：民主政治不保證沒有爭吵、失誤和危機，但它允許人民批評政府、通過選舉更換領導人，並借助公民社會的自主力量參與公共事務。臺灣的民主韌性還與傳統人文倫理、現代經濟創新和國際合作相互聯繫，使政治制度之外的社會資源能夠參與危機應對，所以臺灣的韌性背後有更多的力量維繫與支撐，安全上有文明世界的協力、協防，政治上有更多的互信、互動，經濟上有更多的互利、互補。這使得臺灣的韌性是網狀的，而非集權政治韌性的單線模式（黨政一體）。 因此，判斷一種制度是否具有韌性，不能只看它維持了多少年的統治，也不能只看國家機器擁有多強的控制能力。我們還需要追問：面對錯誤，誰有權提出批評？面對危機，社會能否自主行動？面對權力失誤，制度能否實現和平糾正？   作者》 吳祚來   獨立學者，專欄作家。

孫中山先生誕辰紀念日11月將到來，港澳地區已經開始有預熱活動，圖為澳門12日舉辦的座談會。圖／取材自澳門政府官網

紀念[**孫中山**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E5%AD%AB%E4%B8%AD%E5%B1%B1)誕辰160周年，港澳兩地相繼舉辦舉辦座談會、書畫展等活動，[**香港**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF)特首[**李家超**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E6%9D%8E%E5%AE%B6%E8%B6%85)14日於座談會表示，孫中山先生一生以革命為己任，立志救國救民，為中華民族作出了彪炳史冊的貢獻，要學習和繼承孫中山先生熱愛祖國的崇高精神、振興中華的偉大志向，把愛國愛港的價值觀化為具體行動，為以中國式現代化全面推進強國建設、實現中華民族偉大復興貢獻香港力量。

綜合新華社、大公文匯網報導，孫中山誕辰是11月12日，紀念活動在兩地連番登場，「紀念孫中山先生誕辰160周年座談會」12日率先於澳門科學館舉行，全國人大常委會副委員長鄭建邦出席並呼籲海內外中華兒女堅定反「獨」促統，澳門特區政府社會文化司司長柯嵐則表示將從傳承中山精神、發揮平台優勢及引導青年三方面推展工作。

此外，由香港金紫荊書畫院主辦的「天下為公．薪火相傳紀念孫中山誕辰160周年書畫邀請展」13日在港開幕，展出兩岸暨港澳近200位藝術家共200多幅作品，參展作品涵蓋書法、篆刻、國畫、油畫等多個門類，既保留了傳統書畫的深厚底蘊，也融入了當代藝術的創新表達。

孫中山先生後人、中國和平統一促進會香港總會常務副會長孫偉勇表示，孫中山先生一生追求理想，根源就是愛國。紀念孫中山旨在接過「振興中華」接力棒，讓年輕人走近其故事與精神。

報導指出，李家超於14日座談會指出，香港是孫中山先生孕育革命思想和求學的重要地方，與其革命生涯有深厚歷史淵源，孫中山先生曾在港就學，更曾憶述「我之此等思想發源地即為香港」，他其後在中環成立香港興中會總會及同盟會期間，均以香港為起義策源地和籌款樞紐。這段歷史淵源，為今天香港推動愛國主義教育提供了珍貴教材。

特區政府「愛國主義教育工作小組」成立兩年多來積極推進相關工作，上月公布的「香港第一個五年規劃」已明確提出深化愛國主義教育、國民教育及國家安全教育等目標，2026年「施政報告」亦提出具體施政重點。

除推廣校園大使計畫與設立延安教育基地外，當局亦將設立新博物館介紹國家輝煌成就，並持續支持同鄉社團推廣家鄉文化及於中華文化節推出展現優秀傳統文化的項目。

# Hang Seng Index falls below 24,000 as tech shares weigh

Hong Kong shares fell sharply by noon on 15 October, with the Hang Seng Index dropping 1.47 per cent to 23,955 points. The decline was led by tech shares, as the Hang Seng Tech Index slid 2.94 per cent and mainland indices also fell.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 15 Oct 2026 at 12:08 HKT · 1 min read

Hong Kong shares saw losses widen by the midday break on Thursday, weighed down by tech shares. The benchmark Hang Seng Index dropped 358 points, or 1.47 per cent, to 23,955 points by noon, according to The Standard.

The half-day market turnover was HK$113.7 billion. The Hang Seng Tech Index slid 2.94 per cent to 4,051 points at noon, underscoring the drag from technology stocks.

In the mainland, the Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index decreased 1.98 per cent to 3,692 points, and the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Component Index declined 2.78 per cent to 11,773 points.

英国国家核聚变项目首席执行官表示，西方正在与中国竞相开发核聚变能源，他补充说，这项新兴技术的商业化可以说是“有史以来最重要的地缘政治事件之一”。

九月份就任英国原子能管理局（UKAEA）首席执行官的丹尼斯·怀特教授表示，英国拥有世界领先的核聚变项目，但[中国](https://www.ft.com/china)也在快速发展技术和供应链。

他在接受英国《金融时报》采访时表示：“一场新兴的竞赛已经出现，目前看来，这场竞赛本质上是中国与西方或与西方结盟的国家之间的竞赛。”

“我想说，根据我们所看到的情况，这实际上是一场相当不错的比赛。中国在令人惊讶的短时间内建立了一系列令人印象深刻的能力。”

怀特领导了麻省理工学院的核科学与工程系，并与他人共同创立了私营核聚变公司 Commonwealth Fusion Systems，该公司得到了比尔·盖茨的投资基金 Breakthrough Energy Ventures 的支持。
加拿大在核聚变发展的关键时刻承担了英国原子能机构的角色，核聚变涉及核聚变，将质量转化为能量，然后释放大量能量，用于驱动涡轮机发电。

卡勒姆的桅杆升级融合机© Tom Pilston/FT

这项技术已经发展了数十年，但由于产生和维持聚变所需的 1 亿摄氏度温度和高压的挑战（包括能源需求），一直难以走出实验室阶段。

在取得突破性进展后，它现在吸引了创纪录的资金，人们希望反应能够持续，并且核聚变可以在十年或更短时间内用于商业规模的发电。然而，这种乐观情绪因有关进展和有一天发电的价格是否被夸大的问题而受到影响。

怀特表示，例如，美国劳伦斯利弗莫尔国家实验室的国家点火装置在 2022 年达到的[净能量增益里程碑](https://www.ft.com/content/4b6f0fab-66ef-4e33-adec-cfc345589dc7?syn-25a6b1a6=1) 令人兴奋，当时他们的聚变反应产生的能量比发送的能量还要多直接影响核聚变，以及超导磁体的发展，这意味着聚变反应堆运行所需的电力更少。
工作人员正在为桅杆升级融合机接线© Tom Pilston/FT

他说：“我们正在谈论试图满足聚变能源的价格点，这本身就是我们领域的一个新启示。”他强调，在世界各国都在努力应对不断增长的能源需求和对能源安全的担忧之际，这一巨大的回报正在发挥作用。

他说，当核聚变在经济上变得可行时，“很难不说这是有史以来最重要的地缘政治事件之一，因为它以一种与其他能源非常不同的方式释放能源”。

据英国原子能机构称，与燃烧化石燃料相比，聚变每公斤燃料释放的能量大约高出 1000 万倍。

UKAEA 在 8 月份表示，科学

The west is in a race with China to develop nuclear fusion energy, according to the chief executive of the UK’s state fusion programme, who added that commercialising the nascent technology would arguably be “one of the most important geopolitical events ever”.

Professor Dennis Whyte, who became chief executive of the UK Atomic Energy Authority (UKAEA) in September, said the UK has world-leading fusion programmes but that [China](https://www.ft.com/china) was also rapidly developing both technology and supply chains.

“There is an emerging race which has occurred, and at this point it looks to be essentially the race is between China and the west, or western-aligned nations,” he told the FT in an interview.

“It is actually a pretty good race, I would say, based on what we’ve seen. China has an impressive set of capabilities that they have built up in a surprisingly short period of time.”

Whyte led the nuclear science and engineering department at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and co-founded the private nuclear fusion company Commonwealth Fusion Systems, which is backed by Bill Gates’s investment fund Breakthrough Energy Ventures.

The Canadian has taken on the UKAEA role at a key moment for the development of nuclear fusion, which involves fusing nuclei to convert mass into energy, enormous amounts of which are then unleashed and can be used to drive a turbine to produce electricity.

The Mast Upgrade fusion machine in Culham© Tom Pilston/FT

The technology has been in development for decades but has struggled to get out of the laboratory stages due to the challenges — including energy demand — of creating and sustaining the required 100mn degrees Celsius temperatures and high pressures for fusion to take place.

It is now attracting record funding following breakthroughs that have raised hopes reactions can be sustained and fusion could be used to produce electricity at commercial scale within a decade or sooner. However, such optimism has been tempered by questions over whether progress and the price at which electricity could one day be produced are being overhyped.

Whyte said there was reason to be excited by, for example, the [net energy gain milestone](https://www.ft.com/content/4b6f0fab-66ef-4e33-adec-cfc345589dc7?syn-25a6b1a6=1) reached by the US’s National Ignition Facility at the Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in 2022, when their fusion reaction produced more energy than had been sent directly to the nuclei being fused, as well as the development of superconducting magnets, which mean fusion reactors need less electricity to run.

Staff work on the wiring of the Mast Upgrade fusion machine© Tom Pilston/FT

“The mere fact that we’re talking about trying to meet price points for fusion energy is itself a new revelation in our field,” he said, highlighting the huge prize at play at a time when nations around the world are grappling with rising energy demand and concerns over energy security.

When fusion becomes economically viable, “it’s hard not to argue that it’s one of the most important geopolitical events ever because it unlocks energy in a way which is just very different from other kinds of energy sources”, he said.

Fusion can release roughly 10mn times more energy per kilogramme of fuel compared with burning fossil fuels, according to the UKAEA.

The UKAEA said in August that scientists had made breakthroughs in the pressure they could achieve inside its Mast Upgrade fusion machine in Culham, Oxfordshire.

The organisation’s subsidiary UK Fusion Energy, meanwhile, is aiming to develop by 2040 a prototype fusion power plant on the site of a former coal-fired power plant in West Burton, Nottinghamshire.

UKAEA is also working on challenges beyond just creating the fusion reaction, Whyte said, pointing to separate programmes to develop robotics to help maintain fusion reactors, reducing downtime, and to reuse scarce tritium fuel.

Scientists are also using artificial intelligence to help solve the technology’s challenges, he said, such as parsing the billions of permutations of different types of alloys that can help materials survive conditions inside the reactor.“Being able to use these tools is revolutionary,” he added.

The 17th Cognitive Infocommunications Conference (CogInfoCom 2026) was held from 12 to 15 October at Hong Kong Science Park, marking its first appearance in China and the Greater Bay Area.

Co-hosted by the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), its Shenzhen Research Institute (SZRI), the InnoHK Centre for Perceptual and Interactive Intelligence (CPII), and Corvinus University of Budapest (CUB), the event brought together international experts to discuss advances in artificial intelligence, cognitive science, and information technology.

Launched in 2010, CogInfoCom has previously been held in Europe and Asia. This year marks its debut in China, symbolising the region's growing prominence in AI and cognitive research, according to the organisers.

The opening ceremony featured academic and industry leaders from Hong Kong, mainland China, and overseas. Distinguished guests included CUHK's pro-vice-chancellor Anthony Chan Tak-cheung, SZRI director Yam Yeung, CPII director Helen Meng Mei-ling, and Péter Baranyi of CUB, along with other scholars and industry partners.

Chan highlighted CUHK's commitment to interdisciplinary and international collaboration, describing the conference as a bridge for global academic and innovation exchange. Yam stressed the importance of hosting the event in the region, emphasising its role in fostering cooperation in AI and cognitive infocommunications.

The hybrid event covered topics including the integration of cognitive science with information technology and the development of AI systems that augment human abilities. Highlights included keynote speeches, expert presentations, and exhibitions showcasing the latest research in AI, machine learning, and human-AI interaction.

The conference also reinforced Sino-Hungarian collaboration, following recent strategic agreements between the host institutions and the launch of joint research projects.

title: Second Guangzhou-Shenzhen high-speed rail to link Hong Kong under three route options
zh_title: 第二条广深高铁连接香港 分三条线路选择
summary: 香港当局正在审查广深高铁第二条南延线的三条初步路线，以连接香港北部都会区。该线路预计在“十五五”期间开工建设，将减少广州至 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:30 香港时间 · 2 分钟阅读 第二条广深高铁开工建设
content:
香港
当局正在审查广深高铁第二条南延线的三条初步路线，以连接香港北部都会区。该线路预计在“十五五”期间开工建设，将减少广州至广州之间的出行。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:30 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

据当地媒体报道，第二条广深高铁预计将在“十五五”期间开始建设，当局目前正在评估其南延伸至香港北部都会区的三条初步路线选择。

报道称，深圳市发展和改革委员会去年8月启动了前期规划招标，正在评估南支线如何与北部城市融合。根据初步规划，正线起于广州北站，途经广州白云国际机场、广州黄埔、东莞市中心南城，终点为深圳机场东。
规划文件称，该铁路建成后，将实现广州与深圳核心城区之间30分钟直达，实现空铁联运无缝衔接，充分释放穗莞深港走廊一体化潜力。

对于南部延伸线，当局正在评估多条初步路线以及涵盖跨境通道、边境管制设施、客运量和项目成本的可行性评估。第一个方案是将高铁延伸至前海，旅客可在此转乘港深西铁跨境路段前往北方都会区。

第二个方案是南延线与港深西铁共享一条隧道走廊，两个系统在同一线路的不同轨道上运行，而新的高速支线则以洪水桥站为终点。第三条线路规划从深圳机场东向南延伸，经前海，然后通过地下隧道过境，到达北方都市的新高铁站。
香港特别行政区路政署表示，全长18.1公里的港深西铁将全在地下建设，包括长7.3公里的香港段和长10.8公里的深圳段。香港段设有洪水桥、厦村和流浮山三个车站，深圳段则设有深圳湾口岸和前海湾。

待筹备工作进展顺利后，香港段的招标工作可于明年展开，预计于2035年通车。立法会议员耀明建议，西铁线应探索向南延伸至香港国际机场，同时向北连接深圳宝安国际机场，形成空铁一体化网络。

Hong Kong
Authorities are reviewing three preliminary alignments for the southern extension of the second Guangzhou-Shenzhen high-speed railway to connect with Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis. The line, expected to start construction during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, would cut travel between Guangzhou an

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 13:30 HKT · 2 min read

Construction of the second Guangzhou-Shenzhen high-speed railway is expected to begin during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, with authorities now assessing three preliminary route options for its southern extension to link with Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis, according to local media reports.

The Shenzhen Municipal Development and Reform Commission launched pre-planning tender invitations last August and is evaluating how the southern spur can integrate with the Northern Metropolis, the reports said. The main line will start at Guangzhou North Station, pass through Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport, Guangzhou Huangpu and Nancheng in central Dongguan, and terminate at Shenzhen Airport East, according to the preliminary planning.

Upon completion, the railway will provide a 30-minute direct connection between the core urban areas of Guangzhou and Shenzhen, enable seamless air-rail intermodal transfers, and unlock the full integration potential of the Guangzhou-Dongguan-Shenzhen-Hong Kong corridor, the planning document stated.

For the southern extension, authorities are evaluating multiple preliminary routes alongside feasibility assessments covering cross-boundary passages, border control facilities, passenger volumes and project costs. The first option would extend the high-speed line to Qianhai, where travellers could interchange onto the cross-boundary segment of the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link to access the Northern Metropolis.

A second proposal would see the southern extension share a tunnel corridor with the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link, with the two systems running on separate tracks within the same alignment and the new high-speed spur terminating at Hung Shui Kiu station. The third routing plan extends south from Shenzhen Airport East through Qianhai, then crosses the border via an underground tunnel to a new high-speed rail station in the Northern Metropolis.

The Highways Department of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region said the 18.1-kilometre Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link will be built entirely underground, comprising a 7.3-kilometre Hong Kong section and a 10.8-kilometre Shenzhen section. The Hong Kong section will feature three stations at Hung Shui Kiu, Ha Tsuen and Lau Fau Shan, while the Shenzhen section will include stops at Shenzhen Bay Port and Qianhaiwan.

Subject to preparatory progress, tendering works for the Hong Kong section may begin next year, with the line targeted to open in 2035. Lawmaker Yiu Ming suggested that the Western Rail Link should explore extending southward to Hong Kong International Airport while also connecting northward to Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport to form an integrated air-rail network.

title: Five Guangdong yachts to make first entry into HK under new southbound scheme
zh_title: 五艘广东游艇将根据新南向计划首次进入香港
summary: 香港海事处表示，根据新的南行游艇计划，五艘广东注册的游艇将于周五成为首批进入香港水域的游艇。海事处处长黄世发概述了监测、锚地和停泊安排，并驳回了对中国船舶影响的担忧 [![图 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:36 香港时间 · 2 分钟阅读 五艘广东注册游艇将率先入驻
content:
香港
海事处表示，根据新南行游艇计划，五艘在广东注册的游艇将于周五首批进入香港水域。海事处处长黄世发概述了监测、锚地和停泊安排，并驳斥了对中国船舶影响的担忧。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:36 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

海事处表示，五艘在广东注册的游艇将于周五根据新南行游艇计划首批进入香港水域，标志着香港向大湾区游艇拥有者开放的重要一步。

海事处处长黄世发周四在电台节目中表示，五艘游艇已通过部门的电子商业系统成功注册。他补充说，已有23名操作员通过该系统注册，近300名大陆船长已通过所需的评估。
该计划要求申请人指定其锚地。动态跟踪系统将监控游艇的移动，该系统会向误入限制区域或自动识别系统发生故障的船只发出警报，以确保安全。我们会在五个指定碇泊处加强巡逻和执法：赤柱、大潭、浅水湾、西贡三噚湾和大澳。

黄说，有足够的停泊空间供预计抵达的旅客使用，无需限制每日访问。如果锚地已满，来访的游艇将被引导至其他地点。目前的锚地预计可容纳约115艘长度达40米的游艇。

虽然香港的游艇泊位总数约为 4,000 个，远低于该市 10,000 多艘游艇，但黄指出，并非所有游艇都需要立即停泊。目前正计划在红磡、南丫岛和机场附近增设泊位。

尽管这五个锚地缺水缺电，但来访的游艇将可以使用该市的七个售水亭和八个指定加油站。海事服务提供商和当地船只也可以提供补给。该部门将分发传单并在网上发布参观游艇的详细信息。
在回应对该计划对中华白海豚栖息地影响的担忧时，黄指出该地区已经有大量船只活动，并相信该计划对生态和交通的影响很小。海事局长强调，本地和来访的游艇将受到同等对待，任何违反法律的行为都将采取执法行动。

Hong Kong
Five Guangdong-registered yachts will become the first to enter Hong Kong waters on Friday under the new southbound yacht scheme, the Marine Department said. Director of Marine Wong Sai-fat outlined monitoring, anchorage and berthing arrangements, and dismissed concerns about the impact on Chinese w

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 13:36 HKT · 2 min read

Five Guangdong-registered yachts are set to become the first to enter Hong Kong waters under the new southbound yacht scheme on Friday, marking a significant step in opening the city to yacht owners from the Greater Bay Area, the Marine Department said.

Speaking on a radio programme on Thursday, Director of Marine Wong Sai-fat said the five yachts had been successfully registered through the department's Electronic Business System. He added that 23 operators had registered via the system and nearly 300 mainland captains had passed the required assessment.

The scheme requires applicants to specify their anchorage. Yacht movements will be monitored by a dynamic tracking system, which ensures safety by alerting vessels that stray into restricted areas or whose automatic identification systems fail. Enhanced patrols and enforcement will be carried out at the five designated anchorages: Stanley, Tai Tam, Repulse Bay, Three Fathoms Cove in Sai Kung and Tai O.

Wong said there is enough berthing space for the expected arrivals and no need to limit daily visits. If an anchorage is full, visiting yachts will be directed to alternative sites. The current anchorage areas are expected to accommodate about 115 yachts of up to 40 metres in length.

While Hong Kong's total yacht berths number around 4,000, well below the city's more than 10,000 yachts, Wong noted that not all need berthing at once. Plans are underway for additional berths in Hung Hom, Lamma Island and near the airport.

Although the five anchorages lack water and electricity, visiting yachts will be able to use the city's seven water-selling kiosks and eight designated fuel stations. Marine service providers and local vessels can also supply provisions. The department will distribute leaflets and post details online for visiting yachts.

Responding to concerns over the scheme's effect on Chinese white dolphin habitats, Wong noted the area already had plenty of vessel activity, believing the scheme's ecological and traffic impact would be low. Stressing that local and visiting yachts would be treated alike, the marine chief said any breaches of the law would draw enforcement action.
