title: Moab and Arches National Parks Hiking Weekend, Thu, Oct 15, 2026, 7:00 AM   | Meetup
summary: ## Moab Booty Buster Bust your booty on the best trails in Canyonlands and Arches National Parks. We squeeze a week of activity into a long weekend on this 4 day women’s hiking trip to Moab, Utah. Your weekend has been carefully curated and
content:
## Moab Booty Buster

Bust your booty on the best trails in Canyonlands and Arches National Parks. We squeeze a week of activity into a long weekend on this 4 day women’s hiking trip to Moab, Utah.

Your weekend has been carefully curated and “in the field” tested by your Explorer Chick team! We’ve spent YEARS playing in this outdoor mecca in the desert. You’ll squeeze in some serious ground over the course of a long weekend working on those hiker booty gains.

Explore six arches in one hiking trail to discover the namesake of Arches National Park. Witness the power of wind as you trek among iconic red rock formations where over 2,000 arches have been documented. Descend down layers of red, pink, brown, and white sandstone to enjoy a well-earned lunch on the White Rim of the Colorado River.

Wander through red rock slot canyons, among sandstone hoodoos, and across wind-eroded plains in the Needles District of Canyonlands National Park. Feel like you’re on a desert planet as you admire the vast and desolately beautiful landscapes.

Catch an unforgettable sunrise at Deadhorse Point State Park as you sip your coffee and munch on your breakfast. Next, gear up and hit the trail in Canyonlands to conquer the steepest trail in the park. (You’ve got this!)

You better believe we wouldn’t let you miss this! Your reward after a brief hike? One of the most famous geological structures in the world. Gaze in awe at some of Mama Nature’s best work before taking your turn to pose in the photo op sweet spot.

Every day, expect to be challenged by a new trail, and a new horizon, and new friends. Your thighs will sing every day as you walk a new hiking trail, admire a new desert horizon, and conquer a new national park!

Your heart will swoon every night as you kick off your dusty hiking boots, share bad jokes, and enjoy fresh-made meals in the Explorer Chick lodging. We’ll enjoy the occasional meal out and even squeeze in some time for you to meander and shop in the funky town of Moab. Your weekend of epic Moab hikes begins with an easy rendezvous at a Salt Lake City airport hotel—we take care of all the transportation from there!

(Phew, did we mention this is all going down in four days?!)

content:
Your salt lamp is trying its best to inspire but sometimes, you need the real thing. Escape into the russet vistas and sublime arches of this 4-day women’s multisport adventure in stunning Moab, Utah. This is your golden ticket to lace up those hiking boots and leave real life behind as we explore both Arches and Canyonlands National Parks. Marvel at the colossal swoops of sandstone that frame the breathtaking landscapes like a picture. Summon your inner mountain goat as you scramble up slick rock and skip across sand dunes. Escape the crowds to discover an otherworldly quiet no meditation app can inspire.

Slip into a realm that seems plucked from another dimension, brimming with rock dunes, fins, and hidden slot canyons. Suit up, tie in, and prepare to rappel over 100 feet to the secret canyon floor below. Then do it all over again (AND AGAIN) on a beginner-friendly canyoneering adventure. You’ll scramble, downclimb, and maybe even wade through gorgeous, remote slot canyons. End the day with a stunning sunset hike to the most iconic spot in all of Utah.

Show off those sick carpool skills as you climb into the driver’s seat of an off-road vehicle. Let the sand slap your face and the wind tangle your hair as you become one with ancient desert lore. Unearth ancient relics and dinosaur bones while navigating tunnels, ravines, hills, and arches.

We’ll explore the unique town of Moab and check out the funky shops, food truck park, and restaurants all tucked in between two National Parks. Every day is a new adventure followed by the promise of the best night’s sleep of your life.

Your unforgettable Moab Multisport Weekend starts with a breezy rendezvous at an airport hotel in Salt Lake City followed by a 3 night stay in our private Explorer Chick House. Hop in the SHE-nanigan Shuttle and let your guides handle the rest.

title: Jordan and Petra Ultimate Adventure, Tue, Oct 20, 2026, 7:00 AM   | Meetup
summary: Enjoy a women-only adventure by camping under the desert stars on our Ultimate Jordan and Petra Tour! Over the course of 8 days and 7 nights, you’ll hike portions of the Jordan Trail, ride camels in Wadi Rum, float in the Dead Sea, and glam
content:
Enjoy a women-only adventure by camping under the desert stars on our Ultimate Jordan and Petra Tour! Over the course of 8 days and 7 nights, you’ll hike portions of the Jordan Trail, ride camels in Wadi Rum, float in the Dead Sea, and glamp under desert stars. Yep! Your Jordan Adventure will channel every ounce of your inner Indiana Jane! Cue the theme song and sing it enthusiastically as you read on about your Jordan adventure.

**KING’S HIGHWAY CANYON EXPLORING AND SWIMMING**

Your adventure kicks off along the King’s Highway, which you’ll travel before exploring one of the most beautiful canyons on earth. Swim through milky blue waters beneath towering basalt canyon walls. Then cozy up with your new Explorer Chick besties at an eco-lodge within the boundaries of Dana Nature Reserve.

**JORDAN TRAIL HIKING AND GLAMPING**

The following morning, you’ll wake to trek 5 miles along one of the most scenic sections of the Jordan Trail to arrive at Little Petra. En route, you’ll be able to see into Israel and learn about the biblical significance of the trail by our local guide. That night, you’ll relax under the stars at an authentic Bedouin camp in a comfortable glamping site with a bed and mattress.

**PETRA TOUR**

The next day, you’ll journey to Petra on foot over the course of 9 miles. The hike might seem long, but you’ll be rewarded by entering Petra through a back entrance before exploring the narrow slot canyons and caves deep within the vast UNESCO World Heritage site. On your second day in Petra, our local guide will take us on a super-secret hike with stunning views known only by the locals (Shhhhh! Don’t tell the tourists!).

**WADI RUM DESERT TOUR AND BEDOUIN CAMP**

After our time in Petra, we’ll venture to Wadi Rum, the Arabic word for “dry river bed” aka where Matt Damon grew his doo-doo potatoes in The Martian. The Wadi Rum desert is unlike anything else on Earth! Protected by the National Park, this area is devoid of man-made architecture and influence. Instead, the nomadic Bedouin people thrive on what the Earth provides and call Wadi Rum their home. Lucky for us, the Bedouins will welcome us into their communities and share some of their favorite hiking trails. Spend two nights under more breathtaking stars in another authentic Bedouin camp. Your home will be a raised canvas tent complete with a bed and local decor.

**JEEP SAFARI TOUR TO MOUNTAIN ROCK SCRAMBLE AND DESERT CAMEL RIDE**

While in Wadi Rum, board a Jeep to safari to Burdah Mountain and take on a challenging 3-4 hour scramble to reach the famous Burdah Rock Bridge. If you’re feeling intrepid, inch out to the middle of an arch that stands 900 feet high. Catch your last sunset in Wadi Rum on the back of a camel as you enjoy a bucket-list desert experience.

**DEAD SEA SWIM AND JORDANIAN COOKING CLASS**

On your final full day, we’ll journey to the lowest place on the earth—The Dead Sea. Sit back, float, slather on some “magical” mineral mud, and wonder to yourself how you got to be so brave. In the evening, we’ll gather for one last meal. But here’s the kicker: You are going to help prepare it under the leadership of a Jordanian culinary school that is women-owned and operated!

title: Smoky Mountain Boots and Roots Hiking, Thu, Oct 15, 2026, 7:00 AM   | Meetup
summary: **OVERVIEW** Are you into endless views? Old-growth forests? Mist bouncing off a 100-foot waterfall hitting your face? Then spend a long weekend with a small group of women hiking the best trails in the Great Smoky Mountains National Park (
content:
**OVERVIEW**
 Are you into endless views? Old-growth forests? Mist bouncing off a 100-foot waterfall hitting your face? Then spend a long weekend with a small group of women hiking the best trails in the Great Smoky Mountains National Park (including parts of the Appalachian Trail).

Channel your inner goat girl as you stroll through iconic scenery and listen to stories of the women who helped shape the Smokies. Take a brief break from the trail living out your pottery fantasies throwing clay on the wheel and sculpting your very own mug. Then kick back like a queen with nightly glamping near Gatlinburg, TN.

**BOOTS = HIKING**
 Get your blues and greens in on three stunning hikes that don’t even look real. The views from Charlies Bunion and Ramsay Cascades are complete madness. Wind your way through pine trees and over classic creek crossings that make you momentarily consider a coonskin hat. (But not really, because animals ♥️)

**ROOTS = HER-STORY**
 Did you know a woman was the first settler to move to the Smoky Mountains? You didn’t? That’s because Martha Jane Huskey Ogle’s husband called dibs on the fame. Learn about the deliciously woman-heavy history of a wilderness that man tried real hard to claim as his own. Your Explorer Chick guide will drop all the juicy gossip, connecting you to the goosebumpy sisterhood who walked before you.
 Deep dive into Appalachian crafts straddling a wheel and molding a coffee mug with your very own hands. Local artists will guide you through the entire pottery process and only help when needed. After 10 weeks of drying, firing, and glazing, your mug will show up at your doorstep. Surprise! Relive the SHE-nanigans of your Smokies trip.

**YOU FEELING MAX COMFY WHILE GLAMPING**
 Put your feet up in total Insta-worthy digs at our adorable glamping site minutes from Gatlinburg. You will sleep in a tent that has been tastefully decorated and luxuriously appointed with WiFi and temperature control – with meals freshly prepared at camp by your Explorer Chick guides. You only have one task after hiking: RELAX.

**ADVENTURE HIGHLIGHTS:**

*   Hike the Appalachian Trail to the sweeping panaromic views from Charlies Bunion
*   Get up close and personal with the Smokies tallest waterfall, Ramsey Cascades
*   Learn how to work clay on a wheel as you create your one of a kind glazed coffee mug
*   Kick back at camp with breakfasts and dinners cooked by your Explorer Chick guides.
*   Sleep easy at our Glamping site with canvas tents outfitted with all the creature comforts.
*   Relax with a comprehensive itinerary that makes the logistics, transportation, navigation, meal planning, lodging, and everything between easy.
*   Geek out with supportive and encouraging Explorer Chicks on a private, women-only, small group adventure tour.

summary: 【大紀元2026年10月15日訊】（大紀元洛杉磯記者站報導）涉嫌充當中共代理人的加州華女張婉瑩此前經法官裁定不得保釋。10月14日（週三），她申請撤銷羈押令，再被聯邦地區法官駁回。法官認為，張婉瑩存在潛逃風險，可能逃離美國、躲避司法制裁，且在訴訟程序中存在不誠實行為。 [![Image 1](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14870179-2-1-600x450.jpg)](https://i.epocht
content:
【大紀元2026年10月15日訊】（大紀元洛杉磯記者站報導）涉嫌充當中共代理人的加州華女張婉瑩此前經法官裁定不得保釋。10月14日（週三），她申請撤銷羈押令，再被聯邦地區法官駁回。法官認為，張婉瑩存在潛逃風險，可能逃離美國、躲避司法制裁，且在訴訟程序中存在不誠實行為。

[![Image 1](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14870179-2-1-600x450.jpg)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14870179-2-1.jpg)

2026年10月14日，美國聯邦地區法官裁定張婉瑩繼續羈押。圖為庭審的聯邦法院。（韓冰／大紀元）

34歲的加州橙縣房地產經紀人張婉瑩（Wanying 「Heather」 Zhang）10月4日於洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）被逮捕。她被指控非法充當中共代理人，並涉嫌受命監視台灣總統賴清德之子。被捕當下，她正持有一張單程機票，準備飛往上海。

[![Image 2](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14870185-3-1-600x551.png)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14870185-3-1.png)

司法部起訴書顯示，西雅圖機場租車行拍攝到張婉瑩與涉嫌同伴在租用一輛黑色2025年款Nissan Rogue SUV。（美國司法部／公有領域）

7日開庭時，聯邦治安法官（Magistrate Judge）史蒂夫·金（Steve Kim）考慮其潛逃風險，已裁定不予保釋。檢方將張婉瑩稱為「祕密特工」，並指控其代表中共從事「間諜活動」。

張婉瑩一方隨後向上級法官提交羈押複審聽證會申請。但聯邦地區法官塞雷娜‧穆里略（Serena R. Murillo）駁回其申請，裁定不予保釋。

## 檢方提交密封文件

週三開庭前，檢方已向法庭提交一份密封文件，反對撤銷張婉瑩原本的羈押命令。

聯邦助理檢察官科林·斯科特（Colin Scott）在庭上指出，這不是一般案件，不僅是因為張婉瑩所涉嫌的行為，也因為其背後涉及一個國家的資源與力量；指派她在美國從事監視工作的是中共國家安全部的官員。

他接著說，間諜活動往往是建立在欺騙之上。檢方指控張婉瑩是中共情報機構的積極線人。她聽命於中共情報人員指令，與同伴「Individual 1」一同前往在西雅圖監視一名台灣高級政府官員的家人，並匯報監視結果。

這名同伴並非張婉瑩的丈夫。斯科特在庭上指出，此人據稱是她的「親密伴侶」。

檢方此前披露，張婉瑩曾透過一家「未註冊的加密貨幣交易所」，向她在中國的銀行帳戶轉帳19萬美元；她在中國擁有「數十萬美元」（hundreds of thousands）可供其支配。

「她還在中國投資了一家夜店。」斯科特表示，由於檢方無法直接調取中國銀行的完整資料，因此不確定她在中國到底還有多少其它資產。

不僅如此，他說，至少有相關指控指出，她的親密伴侶擁有相當可觀的資產，「具體是1億美元還是1億人民幣尚不確認，但金額十分龐大，這意味著她（在中國）完全不缺乏經濟資源」。

## 張婉瑩私人律師反駁指控

週三，張婉瑩的私人辯護律師克雷格·哈博（Craig Harbaugh）當庭反駁了檢方的種種指控。

他表示，張是美國公民，自2014年起就在美國生活，擁有相當可觀的房地產資產，還是兩個孩子的母親，且檢方指控的間諜活動可追溯至2025年9月。根據刑事起訴書，其當事人最後一次與中共官員接觸是在2025年10月。

哈博說，過去約一年的時間，張婉瑩也多次飛往中國，但每次都會返回美國；檢方沒有提供證據證明她對社區具有危險性。

哈博告訴法官，張婉瑩願意以名下一處市值超過100萬美元的房產作擔保，如果還不夠，也願意提供家人其它房產作為擔保；她還提出四名擔保人，分別為丈夫、公公、小姑子及主管。

「我們還可以接受佩戴電子監控腳環、居家監禁、接受電子監控。」哈博說，FBI已經扣留了她的護照，她行動受限，也不存在潛逃問題。

## 檢方：張婉瑩過著雙面生活

檢方主張被告律師的辯詞不足以撤銷羈押令。斯科特告訴法官，電子腳環及居家監禁遠遠不足以消除逃亡風險。即使在以往普通案件中，也發生過被告剪斷電子監控腳環逃跑、自此杳無音訊的情況。

「而本案的特殊之處在於，張婉瑩據稱得到她所服務的那個國家的積極支持。」斯科特說，中共政府可以替她取得新的護照，也可以安排專機、協助她離開美國。中美之間沒有引渡條約，如果她逃往中國，美國可能難以將她帶回受審。

斯科特指控，張婉瑩一直過著「雙面生活」，其家人都不知道她正在做這些事；最親近她的人，也不知道她是中共情報機構的積極情報人員，如今這些證據浮上水面。

網民深挖張婉瑩的背景時還發現，她與中共前外長秦剛、女間諜方芳一樣，都畢業於有「間諜搖籃」之稱的北京「國際關係學院」。

根據起訴書，張婉瑩與「中共政府官員1」均為國際關係學院公共管理學院2014屆的畢業生。畢業後，兩人持續透過電子訊息聯繫，偶爾見面。他們在微信中談論孩子、投資，比較美中差異，談話還涉及在華盛頓州西雅圖監視台灣政府高層官員近親及其家人。

檢方此前指控，張婉瑩的父母和兄弟姐妹都居住在中國；調查人員認為她的一位兄弟曾為中共政府工作（part of the Chinese government）；起訴書中的「Individual 1」已於不久前持單程機票返回中國。

檢方還指控，張婉瑩在被捕後填寫資產申報資料時，聲稱自己名下只有一處房產，但她實際擁有多處房產。這反映了她可能在對自己有利時向法庭說謊。

法官聽取雙方的陳述後，表示將做出裁決，駁回張婉瑩的請求、繼續羈押，直到下次開庭。

庭審結束後，張婉瑩由法警押送離開。她的丈夫埃德里克‧丁（Edric Ding）和另外兩名親友當天也在法庭現場。案件仍在起訴階段，未來一旦被定罪，張婉瑩將面臨最高10年監禁。◇

在另一宗个案中，投诉人以约港币9,000元聘请一家公司搬运家居用品，包括一台75寸液晶电视。该公司还负责对无法装入盒子的大型电器进行简单包装和保护。投诉人其后发现电视屏幕上方有明显裂纹，开机后屏幕无法正常显示图像。投诉人向搬家公司索要赔偿，但该公司只给予港币300元。投诉人表示，该电视机虽然已使用一年，但购买价格约为11,000港元，并以远低于电视机价值为由拒绝了报价。双方未能达成协议，申诉人向市议会求助。

Hong Kong
The Consumer Council received 29 complaints about moving services in the first nine months of this year, up from 25 a year earlier. Disputes ranged from vague quotes and delays to damage compensation. The council urged firms to disclose surcharges and claims terms upfront and advised consumers to do

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 10:42 HKT · 3 min read

The Consumer Council said it had received 29 complaints about moving services in the first nine months of this year, up from 25 in the same period last year. The disputes covered a wide range of issues, including unclear quotations, service delays and compensation for damaged belongings, the council said in a statement on Thursday.

The council urged the industry to improve information transparency, saying that the calculation criteria for various special charges, as well as the terms and mechanisms for claiming compensation for damaged furniture or delayed deliveries, should be provided and explained to consumers at the time of quotation.

In one case cited by the council, a family planning to relocate from Hong Kong to Melbourne, Australia, hired a company in January for an overseas move. As the items were not numerous, they chose a consolidated container shipment at a total cost of about HK$28,000. Because the shipment had to wait for other cargo to fill the container, no delivery date was stated in the service contract, and the complainant kept waiting for the company's shipping notice. In early February, the company said the goods were expected to be shipped by the end of that month, but no further update followed. In early March, the company said the shipment date had to be postponed to late March, but still could not provide a confirmed vessel schedule. Concerned that the delay might continue indefinitely more than two months after the goods were collected, the complainant sought help from the council.

In another case, a complainant hired a company to move household items, including a 75-inch liquid crystal display television, for about HK$9,000. The company was also responsible for simple packaging and protection of large appliances that could not fit into boxes. The complainant later found obvious cracks on the top of the television screen, and after switching it on, the screen could not display images properly. The complainant asked the moving company for compensation, but the company offered only HK$300. The complainant said the television, although used for a year, had been bought for about HK$11,000, and rejected the offer as far below the set's value. The two sides failed to reach an agreement, and the complainant turned to the council.

The council advised consumers to ask moving firms about the features and charges of different transport methods in advance, agree on expected shipping and arrival dates, and keep records or ask for such details to be written into the service contract or invoice. It noted that overseas moves involve uncontrollable factors such as customs clearance, and recommended consumers leave flexibility in their moving and move-in arrangements.

The council also suggested consumers prepare an inventory of items before moving and take photos of valuable, large or fragile goods to record their condition beforehand. If the company offers packing and appliance protection services, consumers should check that boxes are properly sealed and protection is secure, and number the boxes for easy counting upon arrival.

title: AI customer service can frustrate, Hong Kong consumer watchdog warns
zh_title: 香港消费者监管机构警告称，人工智能客户服务可能会令人沮丧
summary: 香港 截至今年8月，香港消费者委员会共收到2,705起有关商户客户服务的投诉，接近去年的总数。它敦促使用人工智能聊天机器人的企业提供明确的指导，并在需要时允许将信息转移给人工代理。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 主编 [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 2026 年 10 月 15 日香港时间 10:52 · 2 分钟阅读消费者委员会表示八个月收到2,705起有关商户客户服务的投诉
content:
香港
截至今年8月，香港消费者委员会共收到2,705宗有关商户客户服务的投诉，接近去年的总数。它敦促使用人工智能聊天机器人的企业提供明确的指导，并在需要时允许将信息转移给人工代理。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 10:52 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

消委会表示，今年截至8月的8个月内，共接获2,705宗有关商户客户服务的投诉，接近去年全年的投诉总数。该委员会表示，这些数字反映了商家客户服务质量与消费者期望之间的差距。
进一步分析发现，常见的投诉包括商户跟进不力、客服无法联系、态度粗鲁、反应缓慢等。在该委员会引用的一个案例中，一名投诉人通过一家公司的在线票务平台预订了五天后的一场活动的门票。由于天气预报不稳定，确认机票后无法取消，该客户向该公司在线人工智能客服询问，如果发出8号台风信号，是否可以改期。 AI服务回复称可根据当日情况改期门票，因此顾客以约港币400元购买了三张门票。

活动当天，八号台风信号发布，门票无法使用。当客户联系在线服务重新安排时，人工智能聊天机器人却无能为力。拨打热线电话无人接听，电子邮件和社交媒体消息也连续几天没有得到回复。该顾客最终向消委会求助并成功更改门票日期。

该委员会表示，人工智能的应用是必然趋势。人工智能客服和自助服务工具可以帮助提高处理查询和投诉的效率，但当消费者需要进一步帮助时，人工智能聊天机器人可能无法完全理解他们的需求，可能仍然需要人工支持。
该委员会建议引入人工智能的企业应向客户提供明确的指导，告诉他们如何有效地使用此类服务​​以及如何在必要时转移给人工代理。它还建议消费者注意商家提供的各种支持渠道和说明，保留沟通记录，如果人工智能客服没有帮助，可以考虑请求转接人工客服。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong's Consumer Council received 2,705 complaints about merchant customer service by August this year, nearing last year's total. It urged businesses using artificial intelligence chatbots to provide clear guidance and allow transfers to human agents when needed.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 10:52 HKT · 2 min read

The Consumer Council said it received 2,705 complaints about merchant customer service in the eight months to August this year, a figure close to the total number of complaints received for the whole of last year. The council said the numbers reflected a gap between the quality of merchant customer service and consumer expectations.

Further analysis found that common complaints included merchants failing to follow up, customer service being unreachable, rudeness and slow responses. In one case cited by the council, a complainant booked tickets through a company's online ticketing platform for an event five days later. Noting the weather forecast was unstable and that tickets could not be cancelled once confirmed, the customer asked the company's online artificial intelligence (AI) customer service whether tickets could be rescheduled if a No 8 typhoon signal was issued. The AI service replied that tickets could be rescheduled depending on the day's situation, so the customer bought three tickets for about HK$400.

On the event day, a No 8 typhoon signal was issued and the tickets could not be used. When the customer contacted the online service to reschedule, the AI chatbot could not help. Attempts to call the hotline went unanswered, and emails and social media messages also drew no response for several days. The customer eventually sought help from the Consumer Council and successfully changed the ticket date.

The council said the application of artificial intelligence is an inevitable trend. AI customer service and self-service tools can help improve the efficiency of handling enquiries and complaints, but when consumers need further assistance, AI chatbots may not fully understand their needs and human support may still be required.

The council recommended that businesses introducing AI should provide clear guidance to customers on how to use such services effectively and how to transfer to a human agent when necessary. It also advised consumers to note the various support channels and instructions provided by merchants, keep records of communication, and consider requesting a transfer to a human agent if AI customer service is not helpful.

# Hong Kong funding scheme backs nearly 150 smart production lines

Hong Kong's新型工業化資助計劃 has funded nearly 150 smart production lines, the innovation chief said. The government is boosting youth researcher support and building a national manufacturing innovation centre with pilot lines for third-generation semiconductors.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 11:11 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20funding%20scheme%20backs%20nearly%20150%20smart%20production%20lines%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-funding-scheme-backs-nearly-150-smart-production-l-05ea68 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-funding-scheme-backs-nearly-150-smart-production-l-05ea68&text=Hong%20Kong%20funding%20scheme%20backs%20nearly%20150%20smart%20production%20lines "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-funding-scheme-backs-nearly-150-smart-production-l-05ea68 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-funding-scheme-backs-nearly-150-smart-production-l-05ea68&text=Hong%20Kong%20funding%20scheme%20backs%20nearly%20150%20smart%20production%20lines "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20funding%20scheme%20backs%20nearly%20150%20smart%20production%20lines&body=Hong%20Kong%20funding%20scheme%20backs%20nearly%20150%20smart%20production%20lines%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-funding-scheme-backs-nearly-150-smart-production-l-05ea68 "Email")

The Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, Professor Sun Dong, said the city's New Industrialisation Funding Scheme has subsidised nearly 150 smart production lines, as the government pushes to accelerate Hong Kong's advanced manufacturing development.

Speaking at an event on Thursday, Sun said innovation commercialisation requires understanding industry needs, managing intellectual property and expanding business outreach. He noted that the government's InnoHK initiative has brought together about 3,000 international researchers from around the world, who collaborate with local institutions to set up research centres and laboratories in Hong Kong.

The government will add a new category for young researchers under the Innovation and Technology Support Programme to strengthen support for early-career scientists, Sun added.

He also said the authorities are helping companies establish advanced manufacturing facilities in Hong Kong. The Microelectronics Research and Development Institute (MRDI) is preparing to set up the city's first national manufacturing innovation centre, with two pilot lines expected to begin operation this year, focusing on third-generation semiconductor research and trial production.

Sun expressed confidence that Hong Kong's advanced public service infrastructure, abundant testing platforms and international connections, combined with the Greater Bay Area's strong manufacturing capabilities and supply chains, would create significant opportunities for businesses.

**Psychic Game Night** is a playful, interactive experience where you'll explore different psychic skills through a variety of fun challenges and group activities. One game might have you tuning into hidden objects. Another might invite you to describe unseen images, practice telepathy, work with symbolic impressions, or experiment with classic ESP exercises. There are no grades, no pressure, and no expectation that you'll get everything "right." The goal is to experiment, discover how your intuition works, and enjoy the experience alongside others who are just as curious as you are.

Bring your curiosity, your sense of humor, and an open mind!

title: Fall potluck!, Sun, Oct 18, 2026, 1:00 PM   | Meetup
summary: Earlier time this month! Lois S. is graciously hosting us at her church. We'll have our very own whole-foods, plant-based, no-oil FEAST. Bring dishes containing NO oil or animal products. Bring your own take-home containers, and we'll share
content:
Earlier time this month!

Lois S. is graciously hosting us at her church. We'll have our very own whole-foods, plant-based, no-oil FEAST. Bring dishes containing NO oil or animal products. Bring your own take-home containers, and we'll share our leftovers. Plates, eating utensils, and napkins provided. It might be helpful to bring your own serving utensils. We will provide coffee, tea, water, and maybe lemonade.

If you'd like to help set up, come a bit early.

If you're unfamiliar with our way of eating, check our discussion board. You'll find plenty of recipe websites that comply with the Forks Over Knives program. (I promise, it's easy!) A couple of websites with easy, compliant recipes: [happyherbivore.com,](http://happyherbivore.com,/)[drmcdougall.com/recipes.](http://drmcdougall.com/recipes.) Can't cook? Think fruit salad, fruit plate, vegetable platter.

The church was kind enough to offer their space free of charge. We'll clean up after ourselves and wash the dishes after dinner. We'll have an optional free-will donation plate to give them as a thank-you.

(No need to RSVP if you can't make it.)

Omaha Forks Over Knives is a lively group celebrating the health benefits of a whole-foods, plant-based, no-oil diet. Each of us is in a different place with foods we do and do not consume; we're not The Food Police. We're here to support and learn from each other. (While we're at it, we entertain each other as well.) If you're new to this, we ask that, at a minimum, you confine your food choices in these meetups to plant-based options. Questions? Watch the documentary Forks Over Knives available to stream online.

content:
We get together the first and third Sundays (usually; watch for changes) to practice The Buddha Path and learn about Buddhism together.

We meet in person in Bend, and we also broadcast online for those who are not in this area or feel more comfortable being online.

Our **face-to-face teachings** are held in the Hawthorn Healing Arts Center, 39 NW Louisiana Avenue in Bend. This is across Louisiana from McMenamins near downtown Bend. There is parking on the street as well as in the parking lot next to the building.

Feel free to dress in shoes that can be removed easily and comfortable, loose-fitting clothing. Bring your cushion if you'd like; there will be cushions and chairs available. You might want to bring something to take notes with.

To **join via Zoom**, please use this link: [https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84113348500?pwd=gZAeKCAdHhGH4dcXwdskvLP0yiGa9U.1](https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84113348500?pwd=gZAeKCAdHhGH4dcXwdskvLP0yiGa9U.1)

_**Please note that we will lock the Zoom meeting a few minutes after the start time, so please be on time.**_

These friendly and informal gatherings are open to everyone, with no previous training required. There is no charge; you will have the opportunity to make a donation to support our local Central Oregon Dharma Center, if you wish.

_Practice compassion: bring a friend!_

When you RSVP, Meetup assumes you are attending online--they somehow cannot handle a hybrid meeting. That doesn't cause any problems for us. Thanks for responding!

Feel free to contact me if you have any questions. I hope to see you soon!

Many blessings, Mary

title: Donate to SAVE US FROM THE MEGA EMBASSY! SUPPORT OUR LEGAL CHALLENGE, organized by Mark Nygate
summary: We are 100 families taking on the CCP - and we need your help. 我們是「皇家鑄幣廠居民協會」，由約一百戶職工家庭組成。我們懇請你伸出援手。 In 2018, our homes-key-worker flats in Tower Hamlets were sold in a secretive deal to the People's Republic of China. We had no say. No war
content:
We are 100 families taking on the CCP - and we need your help.

我們是「皇家鑄幣廠居民協會」，由約一百戶職工家庭組成。我們懇請你伸出援手。

In 2018, our homes-key-worker flats in Tower Hamlets were sold in a secretive deal to the People's Republic of China. We had no say. No warning. And now, we face living under the shadow of a hostile superpower.

2018年，我們居住的Tower Hamlets地段，在未經通知、無任何諮詢下，被秘密售予中國政府。我們無從置喙，如今更面對一個敵對政權的威脅。

The UK Government is expected to approve plans to build the largest embassy in Europe - right here, at Royal Mint Court, next to the Tower of London… and directly on top of our homes.

英國政府即將批准於倫敦塔旁的皇家鑄幣廠（Royal Mint Court）興建歐洲最大規模的中國大使館，預定地點正正位於我們所居之上。

This is not just a planning dispute.

我們擔憂的不僅是一項城市規劃決策，而是一場關乎國家安全、人身安全與基本權利的危機。

China has never shown any regard for our safety - and now the Government and the Metropolitan Police have abandoned us too.

自2018年起，中國政府從未就此提供明確回應，我們甚至不知道會否被驅逐、是否仍能繼續安居於此。而如今，政府與執法機關也對我們置之不理。

We are the Royal Mint Court Residents Association. People backed our previous Crowdfunder campaign that helped pay for a barrister to present our evidence including an independent security assessment showing the serious risks to us from a terror attack on the mega-embassy.

我們是「皇家鑄幣廠居民協會」。我們之前的眾籌活動獲得許多人的支持，資助我們聘請資深大律師提交證據，包括一份獨立的安全評估報告，指出超級大使館可能帶來的恐襲風險。

We are now launching an urgent legal challenge - a Judicial Review - to change the law and stop this injustice.

我們現在正展開一項緊急法律挑戰 — 即司法覆核 — 希望改變現行法律，阻止這場不公。

We need your help to protect our community from the mighty Chinese Communist Party.

我們需要你的幫助，去保護我們的社區，免受強大的中國共產黨威脅。

Whatever you can spare us, will help David stand-up to Goliath.

無論你能捐出多少，都能幫助大衛對抗歌利亞。

We are seeking to pursue a Judicial Review because we have believed all along that the planning process has been flawed. Here are some of the reasons we think are likely to be relevant:

我們決定提起司法覆核，是因為我們始終認為整個規劃程序存在問題。以下是我們認為可能相關的一些原因：

“Closed mind”: Ministers may have signalled early approval to China, before formal procedures were followed, breaking the law and abusing planning powers. In a similar vein, objections disappeared after UK ministers returned from Beijing. Residents have felt like pawns in a geopolitical game since the start.

預設立場：部長們可能在正式程序開始前就向中方表示支持，違反法律並濫用規劃權力。在部長們從北京回來之後，原有的反對聲音突然消失。居民們從一開始就覺得自己成了地緣政治博弈中的棋子。

Security concerns: Building a fortified embassy with homes on site and critical infrastructure nearby, ignoring espionage concerns and the real human risk to dissidents, is indefensible.

安全隱患：在住宅區內及重要基礎設施附近建設高度防禦的大使館，無視間諜活動與對異見人士的人身威脅，完全不能接受。

Procedural unfairness: We were shut out of the process. No consultation. No transparency. No respect for the people who live here.

程序不公：我們被完全排除在決策過程之外。無諮詢、無透明、無對居民的尊重。

Legitimate expectation: We were promised due process and protection. We got silence.

合理期望落空：我們被承諾將獲程序保障與保護，實際卻是得不到任何保障。

What’s wrong with the embassy plan?

We still live here. 100 families. Nurses, teachers, pensioners. Our 100 homes are on land now owned by the Chinese government. That means the Chinese ambassador is our landlord - with rights to enter our homes.

我們仍然住在這裡 ，足足一百戶家庭，包括護士、教師、退休人士。我們的一百個住所現已位於中國政府擁有的土地上。這代表中國大使成為我們的業主，有權進入我們的住所。

China refuses to answer us. Since 2018, we’ve begged for assurances: will we be evicted? Will we be safe? Can we stay? Beijing’s answer: not until we get planning permission. This refusal, and the proposal to install a temporary style wooden boundary fence as a dividing line, raises fears that the Chinese Government intends to take back the entire 100 apartments at St Mary Graces Court once they secure diplomatic status for the site, leaving us homeless.

中國拒絕回應我們的訴求。自2018年起，我們不斷尋求保證：我們會被驅逐嗎？我們是否安全？我們能否繼續居住？北京的答覆是：等規劃許可下來再說。這種拒絕，以及擬議中以臨時木欄分隔的做法，讓我們擔心中國政府一旦取得外交地位，將會收回整個St Mary Graces Court的100個單位，使我們流離失所。

This embassy is a fortress. It’s not a normal diplomatic building. It will have secret communications centres, fortified walls, and surveillance technology that can monitor our entire estate, even our bedrooms. It will also stand on top of critical UK cables that MI5 warn are a security risk to the UK.

這座大使館是一個堡壘，並非普通的外交建築。它將設有秘密通訊設施、加固圍牆、監控技術，可監視整個屋苑，甚至包括我們的睡房。而它的地基下方，更有英國重要電纜 ，MI5曾警告這是對國家安全的威脅。

The UK Government knows the risk - and ignored it. Our independent security report warns that this site puts families and national security at risk. Even the UK’s Head of Counter-Terrorism originally objected - citing threats to residents and dissidents. But since ministers returned from Beijing, objections have mysteriously vanished.

英國政府明知有風險，卻選擇無視。我們的獨立安全報告指出，該地點將危害居民與國家安全。甚至連英國反恐部門首長最初也曾反對 ， 指出對居民與異見人士的威脅。但自從部長從北京回來後，這些反對聲音神秘地消失。

Ministers made no mention of the 100 families living here. We are alarmed that the letters from Home Secretary Yvette Cooper and Foreign Secretary David Lammy have ignored the fact that UK families live in 100 apartments on the land that is actually part of Royal Mint court - and is owned by the Chinese government. Our Resident’s Chairman has personally appealed to ministers, submitted the full Crilly Consultants security report, and our plight has appeared in The Times, FT, BBC, CNN, and more. What is happening to democratic accountability in this country?

部長們從未提及這裡有一百戶居民。我們對內政大臣Yvette Cooper及外交大臣David Lammy的信件感到震驚，因為他們完全忽略了皇家鑄幣廠的土地上住有英國公民、100個家庭。我們的居民協會主席曾親自致函部長、提交完整的Crilly安全報告，而我們的處境亦已被《泰晤士報》、《金融時報》、BBC、CNN等多間媒體報導。英國民主問責制度何在？

The first duty of the UK government is to protect its citizens. We understand the UK’s diplomatic obligations - but not at the expense of its own people. The refusal to acknowledge the basic risks of housing a high-security foreign embassy on top of a residential block is deeply troubling. It appears the government is prioritising relations with Beijing over the safety of its own citizens.

英國政府的首要職責是保護其國民。我們明白外交義務，但不能以犧牲本國人民為代價。將一個高安全級別的外國大使館設於住宅區上方，而拒絕承認基本風險，是極度令人不安的。

It’s not just about us. Dissidents, including Hong Kongers, Uyghurs, Tibetans, Taiwanese and Chinese exile communities are terrified. They’ve told us they no longer feel safe protesting outside the site, and on British soil. Their presence, and ours, will be met with constant surveillance and intimidation by a regime known to harass and threaten activists - even abroad.

這件事不僅關係到我們。流亡港人、維吾爾人、西藏人、台灣人及中國異見社群皆感到恐懼。他們表示不再敢在該地點或英國土地上公開抗議。他們與我們一樣，將面對來自這個以恐嚇異見者聞名的政權的持續監控與威嚇。

The people have spoken, and they support us.

人民已經發聲，並支持我們。

On 8 February 2025, thousands of British citizens - including Hong Kongers, Uyghurs, Tibetans, Taiwanese and Chinese pro-democracy activists, and human rights campaigners - gathered outside Royal Mint Court in protest against this embassy.

2025年2月8日，數以千計的英國公民 ，包括港人、維吾爾人、西藏人、台灣人、中國民主人士與人權倡議者， 齊集皇家鑄幣廠，抗議中國大使館計劃。

They were joined by cross-party MPs, journalists, and allies. Together, they said NO to the Chinese embassy, and YES to democratic values, safety, and justice.

他們與跨黨派議員、記者及盟友並肩站立，一同說出明確立場：反對中國大使館，支持民主、安全與公義。

Further mass protests followed on 15 March, 3 May, and 14 June - showing growing national resistance to the plan.

3月15日、5月3日及6月14日亦舉行後續大型集會，反對聲浪日益壯大。

They continue to protest, and have made it clear: they won’t stop until this mega-embassy deal is over.

抗議仍在持續，並清楚表示：他們不會停止，直至該項目取消為止。

But the Government is not listening.

但政府並未聆聽我們的訴求。

So now, we go to court.

所以現在，我們只有訴諸法庭。

But we need your help - fast.

但我們需要您的協助 - 迅速的協助。

The legal fees for a Judicial Review are beyond the reach of ordinary families. But with your help, we can stand up to both Beijing and Whitehall.

司法覆核的法律費用遠超普通家庭的負擔。但在您的幫助下，我們能夠與北京和英國政府對抗。

This case is about more than one building. It’s about:

這宗案件關乎的遠不止一座建築。它關乎：

Protecting British citizens from state overreach

保護英國公民免受國家權力的侵害

Defending UK democracy from foreign influence

捍衛英國的民主，抵抗外國影響

Challenging backroom deals that put power over people

挑戰那些將權力凌駕於人民之上的秘密交易

If we succeed, we won’t just protect our homes. We’ll set a precedent that no foreign government can build on British soil without respecting British citizens and British values.

如若成功，我們不僅能保護我們的家園，我們更是創下先例：任何外國政府不得在罔顧英國公民和英國價值的前提下在英國土地上建造任何建築。

Will you stand with us?

您願意與我們並肩作戰嗎？

Please chip in whatever you can. £10. £100. £1,000. Every penny goes to legal costs to take this to court. We are a group of teachers, nurses, shop workers and pensioners. We don’t have the Chinese Communist Party’s millions - but with your help, we do have people power.

請您捐出任何您能負擔的金額 — 不論是 £10，£100 還是 £1,000。每一分錢都將用於支付法律費用，讓我們將此案帶上法庭。我們只是一群教師、護士、店員和退休人士。雖然我們沒有中國共產黨的龐大資金 — 但在您的幫助下，我們擁有的是人民的力量。

Share this far and wide.

請廣傳此訊息。

Donate if you can.

如有行力，請捐款。

Stand up for democracy.

為民主發聲。

Because if they can do this to us, they can do it to anyone.

唇亡齒寒。

PLEASE NOTE

請注意：

This is a secure UK-based platform, fully registered and subject to UK law.

這是一個安全的英國平台，註冊並受英國法律管轄。

It is widely used to support political and legal campaigns, including by MPs, NGOs, and grassroots movements - some of which are openly critical of the Chinese government.

該平台廣泛用於支持政治和法律活動，包括國會議員、非政府組織和基層運動 — 包括曾公開批評中國政府的政治活動。

The platform offers full transparency, with public donation records and payment processing via Stripe or PayPal.

該平台提供完全透明的捐款記錄，並通過 Stripe 或 PayPal 處理支付。

There is no history of censorship or compliance with pressure from the Chinese state.

台以往並無自我審查紀錄，也未曾屈從於中國的壓力。

It adheres strictly to GDPR regulations, ensuring donor and campaigner data is protected.

平台嚴格遵守 GDPR 規範，確保捐款者和活動者的數據安全。

About your donations

關於您的捐款

2.95% + 0.25 of each donation goes to the platform; 100% of the remaining funds will be used to cover legal costs.

每筆捐款將扣除 2.95% 加 £0.25 之平台手續費，其餘款項將全數用以支付法律相關費用。

If the legal case is dismissed, your donation will be directed to charity unless you request a refund. If you would like your donation returned, please email us. We will calculate and refund your contribution (with platform fee deducted).

如法律訴訟最終被駁回，捐款將撥捐予慈善機構，除非閣下主動申請退款。如欲索回捐款，請電郵至，我們將在扣除平台手續費後，計算並退還閣下之捐款。

About campaign updates

關於活動更新

We will post updates every two weeks, which you can follow directly on this page.

我們每兩週更新一次進展，您可以直接於此頁面查看。

# Support Pie Formosa’s Independent Work

I sometimes describe myself as a refugee from WeChat to Instagram — but I am also, quite literally, a refugee from China. I am a political dissident, human rights activist, non-binary person and independent writer living with invisible disabilities, now continuing my work in Europe. I write and create public work about censorship, authoritarianism, political memory, democracy, queer and trans freedom, refugee experiences, neurodiversity, and the cultural spaces where resistance survives. For years, WeChat was one of the places where I published my work. Readers could easily support independent creators with small tips. Then the Chinese Communist Party shut down my account. I lost not only a platform, but also an audience, an archive, and a simple way for people to support my work. This fundraiser is part of rebuilding that independence. Living with invisible disabilities also means that conventional employment structures and constant high-intensity workloads are not always accessible or sustainable for me. I need a modest and stable income to make independent research, writing and human-rights work sustainable. Your support will help cover: * research, writing and documentation * travel to human-rights, democracy and civil-society events * digital tools and publishing costs * accessibility-related working needs * basic living costs that allow me to continue this work independently My first goal is €3,500. If something I have written, documented or created has informed, helped or inspired you, even €1, €5 or €10 helps me keep this work alive. If donating is not possible, sharing this fundraiser also makes a real difference. Authoritarianism depends on silence and forgetting. Independent voices survive because people choose to keep them alive. Thank you for supporting my work. Pie Formosa (they/them) https://linktr.ee/pieformosa

**Alan Wan**

Donation protected

Dear Friends,

My name is Alan, and I am writing this with a sincere and humble heart.

I am a Chinese political dissident living in Houston, Texas. Because of my beliefs and my willingness to speak openly about freedom, human rights, and justice, I have faced serious threats and intimidation from the Chinese government. These pressures have made it impossible for me to safely return to China, where my family still lives. Every day, I carry the pain of being separated from my loved ones, uncertain when—or if—I will ever be able to reunite with them again.

Beyond the emotional suffering, I am now facing severe financial hardship. Due to restrictions and complications surrounding the transfer of my personal funds from abroad, I have been unable to access resources that I once depended on for survival. My savings are rapidly disappearing, and I am now struggling simply to cover basic daily necessities such as food, housing, transportation, and medical care.

This situation has left me feeling isolated and vulnerable. I never imagined that standing by my principles would lead to such profound personal sacrifice, but I continue to hold onto hope.

Today, I am reaching out with deep humility to ask for your support. Any assistance—whether financial help, practical resources, or connections to organizations that aid individuals in political exile—would mean more than words can express. Your kindness could help me maintain stability during this incredibly difficult chapter of my life and allow me to continue moving forward with dignity.

I am not asking for luxury, only for the chance to live safely and meet my most basic needs while I navigate these extraordinary challenges.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Your compassion, understanding, and support would be a lifeline during one of the hardest periods of my life.

With deepest gratitude,

Alan

Our names are Aarin Shah, Jaival Patel, Kabir Shah, and Vihaan Thakar, and we are youth volunteers from Apex, North Carolina, at Krishnadham USA Haveli (795 Beaver Creek Road, Apex, NC 27502). Through Krishnadham, we are raising funds to support communities affected by recent flooding in Nepal and Tibet. Funds will support food and clean water, medical aid and supplies, temporary shelter and clothing, and rebuilding and recovery efforts. 100% of proceeds will be donated to the Direct Relief Fund. We are committed to transparency and ensuring all donations are used for the purposes stated above. Every contribution can help provide essential support to families affected by the flooding. Thank you for supporting Nepal and Tibet during this difficult time. Jai Shri Krishna!

**Craig De Meillon**

Donation protected

 My name is Craig De Meillon, and I am based in Miami, Florida. I work in safety and emergency management and am a trained firefighter and EMT with professional experience responding to disasters, emergencies, and humanitarian situations.

 I am raising these funds as an independent volunteer to support my deployment to the areas affected by the recent mudslides and flooding in Nepal near the China border. I am not a family member or representative of anyone affected by the disaster, nor am I collecting these funds on behalf of a government agency or other organization. I am responding independently based on my emergency-response experience and my ability to bring useful communications and search equipment into the field.

 The funds raised will be used primarily to cover the direct costs of my deployment and emergency-response work. This includes my airfare and ground transportation to and within the affected region, accommodation and essential field logistics, food and other necessary expenses while deployed, and emergency-response equipment and supplies.

 A significant part of the funding will also be used for search and communications capabilities. This may include purchasing or renting drones that can be used to conduct aerial searches, assess inaccessible areas, locate people who may be stranded or missing, and help response teams understand conditions on the ground. Funds will also be used for satellite communications equipment and associated Starlink service costs so that I can maintain reliable communications in areas where local telecommunications infrastructure may be damaged, unavailable, or overloaded.

 Where practical, I may purchase essential supplies locally rather than transporting them from the United States. This allows funds to be used more efficiently and can also support local businesses and responders.

 The primary beneficiary of this fundraiser is me, Craig De Meillon, because the funds are being raised to cover the actual expenses I incur while independently deploying and carrying out this emergency-response work. The money is not being raised for personal profit or general living expenses. It is intended to offset the costs directly associated with the mission, including travel, equipment, communications, transportation, and necessary field expenses.

 Once on the ground, I will coordinate as appropriate with local emergency responders, humanitarian organizations, community leaders, and other response personnel to determine where my skills, equipment, and communications capabilities can be most useful. My role and activities may change depending on the needs identified in the affected areas and the accessibility and safety of the region.

 I will keep records of mission-related expenses and provide updates throughout the deployment so donors can understand how the funds are being used and what work is being carried out on the ground.

 Thank you to everyone who contributes, shares this fundraiser, or supports the response in any way. Every contribution helps make it possible for me to get the equipment, communications, and resources needed to reach affected areas and assist where I can. Flood

**Help for Bhujung Tamang**

Dominic and Kayla are raising funds for Bhujung Tamang, a friend they met while traveling in Nepal before/after the Langtang trek. During that trip, Dominic and Kayla stayed with Bhujung for a few days in his village of Syabru Besi. Bhujung welcomed them with kindness and gave them a truly special local experience they have never forgotten. Now, after a devastating flood destroyed Syabru Besi, Bhujung is facing an unimaginable loss. His home and hotel were destroyed, many of his friends were killed or are missing, and he lost all of his possessions in the disaster. It is estimated that Syabru Besi still has 1300 people missing.

Dominic and Kayla met Bhujung by chance while starting their 7 day hike up the Langtang Valley, one of Nepal's premier hiking destinations. They were looking for a place to stay and found the only hotel in the Old Village of Syabru Besi. Upon getting to know Bhujung, Dominic and Kayla discovered that they were the first guests Bhujung had had in almost 3 years because he was taking care of his late mother's declining health. As a token of gratitude and friendship, Bhujung gifted Dominic and Kayla a hand stitched bag his mother made pictured above.

This fundraiser is meant to provide direct relief to Bhujung as he begins the long process of recovering and rebuilding after this tragedy. The money raised will go directly to him to help support his immediate needs (food, housing, etc.) and give him a foundation to move forward after losing so much. Dominic and Kayla are asking for donations of any amount to help Bhujung through this heartbreaking time. If you are able to give, thank you for showing compassion and support to someone who once showed such generosity to travelers far from home. Please consider donating and sharing this fundraiser to help Bhujung rebuild his life.

**Tarra Subhar Massallo**

Donation protected

After fleeing from the Chinese annexation of Tibet, many Kyirong Tibetan families crossed into Nepal believing their exile would be temporary. It was not. Syabrubesi and the Trishuli valley had become their home instead- a place where hundreds of families had to rebuild from nothing, including my grandparents. Like many Tibetan refugees, they eventually moved on to build new lives in India. However, not everyone left. Some of their family stayed behind in Syabrubesi and the Trishuli valley, carrying on the roots left behind by previous generations.

On August 26, 2026, a glacier collapse high in the Langtang Himal sent a wall of water and debris surging down the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli Bazaar: the towns where that branch of our family stayed and built their lives after losing everything once before. **Four households in our family were directly affected:**

*   **Our cousin Dawa Dakpa (confirmed deceased) leaves behind a wife and two young children.**
*   **Aku Jangchup, his wife, and child (confirmed deceased)**
*   **Nama Nangsa Ghongma's family and relatives (missing)**
*   **Nama Karmo Subhar's family and relatives (missing)**

Now, our families face rebuilding once again, with roads and homes submerged in mud. **100% of every contribution will go directly to these impacted families and the wider flood-affected communities**as they recover together. The funds will be spent on various essentials based on each family's needs (including, but not limited to: temporary shelter, food, emergency medical care, and transportation costs). We invite you to help write the next chapter of this story. Please help support this fundraiser in any way that you can.

**Who I am:**

My name is Tarra Subhar Massallo. I am the granddaughter of Tibetan refugees who fled from Kyirong during the 1959 Chinese annexation of Tibet, and the daughter of a Tibetan immigrant mother who moved from India to the United States with her family in search of a better life. Growing up in a mixed household, I am surrounded by the importance of my many cultures and giving back to my respective communities.

The Indian Association of Sacramento (IAS) based in Sacramento , California, USA has a long-standing commitment to helping families in need. Momo Crawlers, we’re asking for your help.

The disaster at the Nepal-Tibet border has left thousands displaced from their homes, and the full scope of the crisis is still being realized. Many Momo Crawl vendors and volunteers remain concerned for loved ones who are still missing.

Through friends and family, we’ve established contact with mutual aid networks on the ground in Nepal. They are also providing us with live updates on the aid groups they’re seeing, what those groups are accomplishing, and where additional support is most needed.

Our plan is to allocate funds according to the feedback we receive from our contacts in Nepal. In addition to mutual aid groups and NGOs, we anticipate directing a significant portion of proceeds to the Nepali government’s [Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/). This fund accepts digital payments, and we encourage you to donate directly if you prefer: [](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/)[https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/)

We established this GoFundMe primarily for ease of use and to help us track the impact of the Momo Crawl community. We expect to keep the drive active until Momo Crawl on September 13th, 2026, but donations received now will be allocated to relief efforts on a rolling basis. We will share updates about the use of funds as information becomes available.

With love and gratitude,

The Momo Crawl team

title: 朝鲜与中国在长达 12 年的延迟后开启新桥
summary: 新鸭绿江大桥横跨 3 公里（1.9 英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州 据中国官方媒体报道，一座连接中国和朝鲜的公路大桥已开通，两国老牌盟友之间的贸易关系正迅速升温。 新鸭绿江大桥横跨 3 公里（1.9 英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州，预计将成为两国之间贸易的主要陆路通道。 该大桥最初定于 2014 年开通，但因朝鲜暂停修建道路和海关设施，且与北京的关系变得紧张，已无限期推迟。 专家认为，大桥周四的开通将标志着北京与平壤关系的持续回暖——尽管仍存在分歧。 新鸭绿江
content: 新鸭绿江大桥横跨 3 公里（1.9 英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州 据中国官方媒体报道，一座连接中国和朝鲜的公路大桥已开通，两国老牌盟友之间的贸易关系正迅速升温。 新鸭绿江大桥横跨 3 公里（1.9 英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州，预计将成为两国之间贸易的主要陆路通道。 该大桥最初定于 2014 年开通，但因朝鲜暂停修建道路和海关设施，且与北京的关系变得紧张，已无限期推迟。 专家认为，大桥周四的开通将标志着北京与平壤关系的持续回暖——尽管仍存在分歧。 新鸭绿江大桥是数十年来中朝友谊大桥的替代方案，该桥建于 1937 年至 1943 年，当时该地区处于日本帝国占领之下。 中国外交部发言人毛宁周三表示，新鸭绿江大桥是两国邻国之间“重要的连通设施”，并补充称新路线将“进一步促进贸易和人员交流”。 中国是朝鲜最大的贸易伙伴，也是朝鲜应对其核武器计划引发的严厉国际制裁的生命线。 去年，双边贸易额达到 27 亿美元，恢复到疫情前水平——但这主要得益于中国对朝鲜的出口。 汉国外国语大学中国研究教授姜俊永告诉 BBC，在朝鲜制裁仍然生效的情况下，边境贸易的“急剧且突然增加”是“不太可能”的。 “平壤也担心中国进口商品突然涌入，这将极大地扩大中国对其国内市场的影响力，”他补充道。 “中国对这些担忧心知肚明，因此贸易更可能逐步增长。” 北京与平壤是长期盟友，拥有相互防御条约——这是中国与其他任何国家签订的唯一一份——其关系被著名地描述为“亲密无间，如唇齿相依”。 但联盟并非没有紧张局势。 这两位邻国仅在近年来才走出 2010 年代大部分时间所特有的冷淡时期，当时北京对平壤核武器计划的耐心逐渐耗尽。 随着中国对朝鲜核发展采取更温和的立场，友谊得以回暖。 牛津大学讲师爱德华·霍威尔告诉 BBC：“十年前，北京对朝鲜核武器化持明显批评态度，甚至呼吁平壤弃核，而中国现在对此几乎不再发表任何意见。” 中国国航于 3 月恢复了北京与平壤之间的直飞航班，此前因疫情中断了六年。两国在同一个月恢复了客运列车服务。 但北京也在密切关注平壤与莫斯科之间日益增长的友谊，自俄乌战争爆发以来，这种友谊已显著发展。 上个月，朝鲜和俄罗斯开通了第一条公路大桥，俄罗斯官方媒体称，该桥每天可通行多达 300 辆车辆和 2000 多人。 周四新鸭绿江大桥的开通恰逢北京试图巩固关系并重申其对平壤不可预测政权的影响力。 今年 6 月，中国国家主席习近平首次出访朝鲜，与朝鲜领导人金正恩会面。 首尔世华大学教授莱夫 – 埃里克·伊尔斯利表示：“新鸭绿江大桥的开通表明双边关系正在改善，习近平主席 6 月对朝鲜的访问不仅仅具有象征意义。” “但长期的延误，包括朝鲜的疫情自我隔离和国内社会经济镇压，显示了平壤对北京而言可能是一个多么困难的合作伙伴。”

zh_title: 香港电台将以手语直播亚洲残疾人运动会并供公众观看
summary: 香港电台TV31将于明日至10月24日直播亚洲残疾人运动会小组赛和重要赛事，并配有手语翻译。香港将派出约80名运动员参加10个项目，并在18个地区和商场进行公众观看。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 06:00 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 RTHK TV31将在香港独家直播亚残运小组赛及重要赛事开赛
content:
香港
香港电台 TV31 将于明天至 10 月 24 日直播亚洲残疾人运动会小组赛和重要赛事，并配有手语翻译。香港将派出约80名运动员参加10个项目，并在18个地区和商场进行公众观看。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 06:00 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港电台 TV31 宣布，将于明日至 10 月 24 日在香港为亚洲残疾人运动会小组赛和重要赛事提供独家现场直播，并配备同步手语翻译，以促进社会共融。

报道将使公众能够为国家队和香港队的残疾人运动员加油。香港电台高级执行制片人余恭蕙指出，自香港电台在 2021 年东京残奥会期间首次播放大型残疾人体育赛事以来，收到了积极的社会反馈。

于补充说，今年的制作，电视台已经动员了专门的人力，并强调直播时间表可能需要实时调整，以跟踪运动员的进度和即将举行的比赛的时间表。她说，还必须协调深入的背景研究，以便为主持人向观众提供更多背景信息。
加入转播团队的还有曾在2024年巴黎残奥会上为香港夺得轮椅羽毛球银牌的陈浩源。去年十五运会首次担任东道主的这位运动员，希望能够分享残奥运动员在面对不同对手时的励志故事或准备工作。

第五届亚洲残疾人运动会的现场报道将在香港电台TV31、香港电台YouTube频道、其网站和“RTHK On the Go”应用程序上进行直播。康乐及文化事务署辖下18区的「亚运焦点场地」及多个商场亦会安排公众观赏。

香港将派出约80名运动员组成的代表团参加本届运动会，参加10个大项的比赛。在周一的启动集会及加油活动中，文化体育及旅游局副局长刘俊赞扬残奥运动员体现了坚韧不拔、永不放弃的香港精神，并称体育是团结社会的重要桥梁。

手语翻译梁凯欣对香港电台提供的热心翻译服务深表谢意，称这是让听障观众充分沉浸在体育运动中的重要“窗口”。自东京残奥会以来一直为香港电台翻译体育赛事的梁先生表示，如果没有实时手语翻译，听障人士无法完全理解运动员的表现。
她指出，体育赛事直播口译面临着独特的挑战，需要进行大量准备，因为口译员必须事先深入研究每个学科。梁女士表示，网上网友称赞口译员迷人且精准的面部表情，她相信这种关注有助于推广手语并提高公众意识。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
RTHK TV31 will broadcast Asian Para Games group stages and key events live from tomorrow to October 24 with sign language interpretation. Hong Kong will send about 80 athletes across 10 sports, with public viewings at 18 districts and shopping malls.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 06:00 HKT · 2 min read

RTHK TV31 will provide exclusive live broadcast in Hong Kong for the Asian Para Games group stages and key events starting tomorrow through October 24, featuring simultaneous sign language interpretation to promote social inclusion, the broadcaster announced.

The coverage will enable the public to cheer on para athletes from both the national team and the Hong Kong team. Senior Executive Producer at RTHK, Christine Yu, noted the positive social feedback received since RTHK's first major para-sports broadcast during the 2021 Tokyo Paralympics.

Yu added that the broadcaster has mobilised dedicated manpower for this year's production, stressing that the live broadcast schedule may need to be adjusted in real time to track the progress of the athletes and the schedules of their upcoming matches. Intensive background research must also be coordinated to provide the hosts with more context for the audience, she said.

Joining the broadcast team is Daniel Chan Ho-yuen, who won a silver in wheelchair badminton for Hong Kong at the 2024 Paris Paralympics. Having debuted as a host during last year's 15th National Games, the athlete expects to share the inspiring backstories or preparations of the para athletes when facing different opponents.

Live coverage of the 5th Asian Para Games will stream on RTHK TV31, RTHK's YouTube channel, its website, and the "RTHK On the Go" app. Public viewings will also be set up at the Leisure and Cultural Services Department's "Asian Games Focal Sites" across 18 districts, as well as in various shopping malls.

Hong Kong will send a delegation of approximately 80 athletes to compete across 10 sports at the Games. During the launch rally and cheering event on Monday, Under Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Raistlin Lau Chun praised the para athletes for embodying the resilient, never-give-up Hong Kong spirit, calling sports a vital bridge that unites the community.

Sign language interpreter Leung Hoi-yan expressed deep gratitude to RTHK for providing dedicated translation services, calling it a vital "window" that allows hearing-impaired audiences to fully immerse themselves in sports. Leung, who has been interpreting live sporting events for RTHK since the Tokyo Paralympics, said hearing-impaired individuals cannot fully comprehend athletes' performances without real-time sign language interpretation.

She noted that interpreting live sports presents unique challenges requiring extensive preparation, as interpreters must deeply study each discipline beforehand. Leung shared that online netizens have praised the interpreters' engaging and precise facial expressions, and she believes this attention helps promote sign language and raises public awareness.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

# 台灣採購阿拉斯加天然氣 美學者：強化能源韌性縮減貿易順差

2026/10/15 09:26

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 17](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

（中央社記者[侯姿瑩](https://cna.com.tw/author/0193/)華盛頓14日專電）美國總統川普稱台灣已同意在未來20年內採購阿拉斯加液化天然氣管線計畫30%天然氣。美學者今天向中央社記者分析，這有助強化台灣能源韌性、縮減對美貿易順差；台灣在美國出口市場的地位越重要，華府就越有意確保台灣安全。

川普（Donald Trump）昨天在阿拉斯加一場造勢集會上表示，台灣同意在未來20年內採購阿拉斯加液化天然氣管線計畫30%天然氣，還將額外投資44億美元用於該項計畫。他今天又在自家社群媒體「真實社群」（Truth Social）發文重申此事。

台灣經濟部指出，中油去年3月簽署「阿拉斯加液化天然氣買賣暨投資意向書」後，已與美方開發商協商取得重大進展，依目前規劃，開採後每年採購600萬噸液化天然氣，以及參與專案開發，預估投資金額最高44億美元。

針對這項天然氣採購及投資計畫，華府智庫「史汀生中心」（The Stimson Center）資深研究員孔明尚（Michael Cunningham）以電子郵件回覆記者詢問表示，這對台灣、美國及台美關係而言，都是有利的發展。若協議落實，將有助強化台灣能源韌性，同時也有助縮減台灣對美貿易順差，「這是華府非常在意的事項」。

根據台灣財政部統計，2025年台灣對美貿易順差約為1501億美元。

孔明尚指出，最重要的是，這類採購協議能提升台灣作為美國客戶的重要性。「台灣在美國出口市場的地位越重要，美國就越有意確保台灣維持安全」。

他認為，有鑑於阿拉斯加天然氣計畫預計2031年才會開始出口，川普所提及的20年採購時程意味著，至少就這項天然氣計畫而言，「台灣直到2050年代都將維持關鍵地位」。

另一方面，華府智庫哈德遜研究所資深研究員華特斯（Riley Walters）受訪表示，這項宣布意義重大，特別是在韓國對阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫是否能獲利表達疑慮後。

華特斯分析，台灣承諾採購約1/3的產量，將有助確保這條天然氣管線的獲利能力。就美台關係而言，這項宣布也有助台灣朝向達成擴大對美投資承諾的目標邁進。

[![Image 18](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/ad300x223.jpg)](https://lin.ee/tPtHlLQ)

川普表示，韓國將投資500億美元推動阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫。不過，外媒報導，韓國方面則說，唯有在這項計畫具備商業可行性的情況下才會推進。

經濟部表示，透過長期能源採購及專案投資，有助於增加天然氣供應來源，進一步強化台灣能源韌性。阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫可透過太平洋航線直達台灣，有助分散天然氣運輸路線及地緣政治風險；若計畫順利推進，最快2032年可挹注國內天然氣供應。（編輯：田瑞華）1151015

content: 才学了两个月英语而已 “她的英语说得不太好。” 近日，新西兰外交部长Winston Peters街头竞选时，对一名中国留学生英语水平的评价引发争议。 而就在今年7月，这位外长还曾因对一名中国出生的华人议员说“回你自己的国家”而遭到抨击。 据新西兰当地媒体报道，随着新西兰大选临近，新西兰外交部长、优先党（NZ First）领袖Winston Peters带领工作人员走上街头，希望通过与选民面对面交流，为自己的政党争取支持。 10月6日上午约11点，Peters去了奥克兰北岸的Takapuna进行街头拉票。 不过，当时街上的行人寥寥无几，Peters和一众工作人员走了很长一段路都没碰到一个人。 他甚至看了看手表调侃说“我们来早了一个小时”，还询问身边记者：“人都去哪儿了？” 随后，他继续沿街寻找愿意交流的民众，并遇到了几名正在英语学校学习的留学生。 现场视频显示，Peters主动走近几名留学生，与她们聊天。 交流开始后，他先询问其中一名女生来自哪个国家。 女生回答，她来自中国。 他又问道：“中国哪里”（Where about China？） 但女生听成了“best China”，于是回答了一句“yes”。 随后，Peters又询问她学习英语多久了。 女生回答：“两个月。” 得知这一情况后，Peters提到了一句英语学习中非常经典的句子： “The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.” 这句话包含英语字母表中的全部26个字母，因此经常被用于英语打字练习、字体展示以及键盘测试。 不过，从现场画面来看，双方交流过程中似乎存在一定语言障碍，对话并没有持续多久就结束了。 Peters转身向身边人员评价：“She couldn't speak English very well.”（她英语说得不太好。） 这段对话随后被现场媒体记录，并出现在当地媒体对其街头竞选活动的报道中。 事件曝光后，在新西兰华人社区引发争议。 一些观点认为，一名刚学习英语两个月的留学生，在日常交流中出现表达困难并不令人意外，公众人物面对年轻留学生时，可以给予更多鼓励。 但也有人认为，Peters的表述只是客观评论当时的交流情况，并不是嘲讽。 这件事争议的焦点在于，作为新西兰外交部长，同时也是长期活跃在政坛的政治人物，在面对语言能力仍处于学习阶段的移民群体时，公开评价其英语水平差是否合适。 其实，这并不是Winston Peters第一次因涉及华人群体的言论受到关注。 今年7月，在新西兰议会的一场辩论中，Green Party议员Lawrence Xu-Nan与Peters发生言语交锋。 在争论过程中，Peters对Xu说：“Go back to your own country.”（回你自己的国家去。） 随后，他还补充了一句：“Go back to where you've come from, you loudmouth.”（回你来的地方去，你这个大嘴巴。） 据报道，Xu-Nan出生于中国天津，后来移居新西兰，并在新西兰政坛担任议员。 Peters的相关言论随后引发华人群体的不满。 新西兰总理Christopher Luxon也公开指责，这样的表达“是种族歧视”、“很冒犯”。 中国驻新西兰大使馆也就相关言论提出交涉。 Lawrence Xu-Nan则表示，这类言论让移民社区感到不舒服。 Peters随后回应称，自己是在表达政治观点，并强调言论自由的重要性。 Winston Peters长期以强调新西兰利益、对移民问题立场强硬闻名。他领导的NZ First党目前也是新西兰政府联盟成员之一。 从今年7月的议会风波，到此次街头竞选活动中的留学生交流事件，涉及华人群体的言论接连引发关注。 在新西兰多元文化社会背景下，政治人物如何讨论移民、语言和文化差异，也成为当地社会持续讨论的话题。

content:
【大紀元2026年10月15日訊】（大紀元記者夏楚君澳洲悉尼編譯報導）一項調查發現，兩個涉嫌與中共間諜有關的領英（LinkedIn）帳戶，在全球累積了數千名人脈，並以有償諮詢服務為誘餌，主動聯繫了數十名在澳洲政府、警務及貿易領域任職的人士。

澳廣（ABC）的調查發現，這些涉嫌間諜偽裝成智庫員工，向目標提供具競爭力的報酬，以換取「有價值的建議」。

2016年至2025年間，超過100名與澳洲有關的人士被列為接觸目標，包括前昆州州長、現任反對黨領袖史蒂文·邁爾斯（Steven Miles）、一名澳洲聯邦警察（AFP）指揮官，以及多名聯邦政府高級官員。他們的個人資訊出現在自稱代表智庫的兩個LinkedIn帳戶的聯絡人記錄中。被指控的外國特工聯繫了其中的58位聯絡人，部分收件人也提供了個人聯絡資訊。

澳廣披露，這些澳洲人是被同一中共間諜網絡鎖定，該網絡曾招募澳洲商人亞歷山大·切爾戈（Alexander Csergo）。切爾戈已因「魯莽外國干預罪」入獄，成為首名依此罪名被定罪者。

澳洲聯邦警方在調查切爾戈期間獲得的LinkedIn記錄顯示，這些帳戶曾聯繫過其他澳洲人，其中包括在政府機構和州貿易投資機構工作的人員。聯邦警方稱，這項行動由中共國家安全部（MSS）策劃。聯邦警方表示，中共國家安全部使用虛假的LinkedIn帳戶，聯繫並培養潛在的外國線人，然後向他們索取資訊。

但中共駐堪培拉大使館否認相關指控，稱澳洲聯邦警方的說法「毫無根據」。

今年6月，由美國、英國、澳洲、加拿大和新西蘭組成的五眼聯盟發出罕見聯合警告，指中共情報機構利用線上求職平台進行招募，藉此取得對五眼聯盟國家具有戰略及戰術優勢的情報。

## 以高薪顧問工作為誘餌 接觸政府及貿易部門人士

2021年11月，當時居住在上海的切爾戈收到一個名為Vera Su的LinkedIn帳戶發出的兼職工作邀請。對方自稱來自Nesa Consulting，表示該機構希望聘請專家，就中國與澳洲之間的貿易提供建議。澳廣對Vera Su的通訊記錄進行分析後發現，同樣的LinkedIn帳號也在尋找其他擁有相關專業知識和人脈的人。

被直接接觸的人士包括曾任職於澳洲貿易投資委員會（Austrade）、澳洲外交貿易部（DFAT）、新州投資局（Investment NSW）、維州投資局（Invest Victoria）及澳洲旅遊局（Tourism Australia）的人員。

部分訊息更直接探詢對方能否接觸政府內部人士。其中一則訊息寫道：「我想知道您是否有特殊的資訊來源……例如：來自政府重要人物的資訊。」

一位澳洲貿易投資委員會的員工表示，他不能接受金錢，因為他為澳洲政府工作，但他表示願意介紹自己職業網絡中的人脈。

前昆州州長邁爾斯在2021年4月擔任副州長期間，也與Vera Su的LinkedIn帳戶有聯繫。據澳廣了解，邁爾斯沒有回覆Vera Su發出的任何訊息。

## 商業顧問：警惕網上接觸及美人計

澳廣檢視的數據顯示，部分與澳洲有關的目標分享了聯絡方式，或討論改以LinkedIn以外的方式繼續交流，包括通過微信、電話或會面。

商業顧問尼克·科伊爾（Nick Coyle）在處理其前伴侶成蕾在中國被捕一事時，也遭涉嫌中共間諜的接觸。

「那段時間我收到很多奇怪的接近」，他說。有些是「美人計」，有人試圖線上或線下成為「朋友」。

「我採取的做法是——如果我之前不認識他們，就會回避」，他說。

澳洲人生教練（life coach）阿德里安·卡希爾（Adrian Cahill）也在2021年與Vera Su交換了聯絡方式。他懷疑自己前軍人的背景使他成為更具吸引力的目標。

「我經常收到這類訊息」，他說。「有人寫信給我說『我們有工作、有錢、有預算』。」

他說，過去接受的訓練有助他辨識這類手法，但缺乏安全及情報經驗的人會逐漸被誘入陷阱，提供「越來越多的信息」。

## 專家：情報搜集手法出現根本轉變

中國情報問題專家尼古拉斯·埃夫蒂米亞迪斯（Nicholas Eftimiades）形容這類國家支持的「撒網」行動是情報搜集手法的「根本轉變」。他表示，中國日益增長的AI能力可能發揮了作用，使中共情報人員能夠更有效率、更安全地進行大規模招募。

「他們可以一次接觸數十萬人，招募人員為他們工作的成本更低」，他說。

曾為美國政府處理涉及中共情報行動案件的美國前聯邦檢察官維卡斯·迪德瓦尼亞（Vikas Didwania）表示，LinkedIn是情報收集的「金礦」。

「我們在LinkedIn上看到有人公開自己能接觸到什麼機密資訊、擁有什麼等級的安全許可。」

迪德瓦尼亞表示，從LinkedIn招募對象取得的資訊可能並非機密，甚至不實用，但可能只是培養消息來源過程的一部分。

「在關係發展過程中，你可以開始再推進一步。」

## 與中國往來的澳洲人面臨的微妙平衡

近年來，澳洲安全情報局（ASIO）局長邁克·伯傑斯（Mike Burgess）警告稱，外國干預澳洲的威脅已達到「極端級別」，並且很可能會加劇。

在切爾戈的審判中，法庭獲悉他沒有洩漏任何機密資訊，他的報告均來自公開信息。克雷格·史密斯（Judge Craig Smith）法官判處切爾戈三年六個月監禁。他表示，阻止人們參與可能危害澳洲國家安全的活動「至關重要」。

對於與中國合作的澳洲人來說，這項判決也重新界定了與外國實體進行合法合作與國家支持的干預之間的危險界線。

中國約有2,000家智庫，這些機構與中共及政府的關係各不相同，而且往往不透明。此外，中共2017年實施的《國家情報法》要求組織及公民支持國家情報工作。一些專家認為，這項法律在實際運作中的影響，也可能波及在中國經營的外國企業。

迪德瓦尼亞表示，應對中共間諜活動的努力需要權衡利弊，避免產生寒蟬效應。

他表示，「如何區分真正意義上的合作和實際上是國家安全部招募人員的合作，確實是一個挑戰。」

title: Songwriter Support Group - Zoom Edition, Wed, Oct 21, 2026, 7:00 PM   | Meetup
summary: Hello songwriters! We are continuing our Songwriter Support Group over Zoom and hope you will join us! This is a great chance to connect with fellow songwriters and hear what others are creating. And, as we have discovered over the past yea
content:
Hello songwriters!

We are continuing our Songwriter Support Group over Zoom and hope you will join us! This is a great chance to connect with fellow songwriters and hear what others are creating. And, as we have discovered over the past year, you can log in and share from almost anywhere!

The Zoom room will open at 6:50pm and we will start promptly at 7:00pm. Plan to login at least a couple minutes early to make sure you are there for the start of the meeting. We will post the Zoom link a day or two before the meeting.

Please read the "Virtual Rules" below as there are some minor and important requirements in order for you to participate and for this to be effective. Also, if you are new, please make certain your meetup setting allows you to receive private messages as that is how I communicate initially. If you have it turned off, you WILL NOT BE ABLE TO RECEIVE MESSAGES AND I WILL REMOVE YOU FROM THE LIST TO ALLOW A WAITLISTED MEMBER TO ATTEND.

Looking forward to hearing your beautiful songs.

The requirements for your song:

A) Have your lyrics ready to share with the group. This can be done by sharing your computer screen or pasting your lyrics into the chat. If you have any questions, please send us a note and we'll be happy to help out.

B) You need to be able to perform it live OR have a recording of it that you can play over Zoom. If you have questions about this please contact me at least 48 hours ahead of the meeting.

Also…

Tell us what you’d like critiques of and we’ll verbally discuss only what each writer would like to hear about. It's not up to anyone in the group to make value judgements on anyone's work (it's good, it's not good). We're here to consider our songs from where they're at, with respect to the artistic work we're helping to nurture and grow.

The event is limited to 11 people. You must stay for the duration of the event as you would if you came in person. After 11 have signed up, a ‘yes’ rsvp goes on a wait list, so please don't RSVP yes to hold a spot if it's only a 50-50 chance you'll make it. NO SHOWS AND LAST MINUTE CANCELS WILL NOT HAVE PRIORITY FOR FUTURE CIRCLES.

New people and all genres and levels of music are welcome!

title: Does Politics Have to be so Antagonistic?, Sun, Oct 18, 2026, 5:00 PM   | Meetup

content:
▶ To attend, register on Member Hub — an RSVP here does NOT give you the Zoom link. Registration takes a moment, and the Zoom link is emailed to you and shown there:
[https://members.crossingpartylines.net/events/cmuge0hqq00ay8pio0os1tc80?src=meetup](https://members.crossingpartylines.net/events/cmuge0hqq00ay8pio0os1tc80?src=meetup)

When one political party takes an action the other strongly opposes, there can be pressure to respond in kind—or go even further. Over time, political disagreements can become a cycle in which each side sees its actions as necessary responses to what the other side has proposed.

At this meeting, we’ll explore how we experience this dynamic, what we want from political leaders when the stakes feel high, and whether there are times when not being antagonistic is possible—or even desirable.

We’ll ask questions such as:

• Have you ever found yourself wanting your side to push harder because of something the other side had done? What felt at stake for you?
 • Have you ever thought your own side went too far in responding to the other? What made it feel different that time?
 • Can you think of a political leader who chose not to respond in kind—or who worked with the other side when there was pressure not to? How did you react?
 • What might make you support a leader who chooses to not fight the other side’s proposal, even when other people on your side wanted them to?

This will be an opportunity to explore how political actions and reactions shape one another and consider what we want from our leaders when political differences and pressures increase.

Please do your best to arrive at the beginning of the meeting – once we are in breakout rooms and the conversations have started, the meeting doors close to new arrivals. The breakout rooms open (and the doors close) approximately 15 minutes after the hour.

How do today’s autocratic governments maintain power, and what challenges do they pose for democracies?

In Autocracy, Inc., Anne Applebaum argues that modern autocratic governments are not necessarily united by a single ideology. Instead, she describes networks connected by shared interests in maintaining power, wealth, and political impunity.

The book examines why traditional responses such as international condemnation, economic sanctions, and popular opposition may struggle against these networks. Applebaum also makes the case that democracies need to reconsider how they respond.

About CPL Book Club:

This monthly gathering's mission is simple: to explore profound opinions
 and accounts of our nation’s and the world’s most critical issues
 through in-depth books. But it’s not just about reading - it’s about
 embracing diverse perspectives, sparking discussions, and sharing
 thoughts with fellow explorers of knowledge.

What you’ll get out of book club: our hope is for you to dare to dive
 deep, analyzing topics and navigating the twists and turns of politics
 together. If you share a passion for continuous learning and want to
 explore the intricacies of our world’s challenges, then this club is
 your intellectual haven (or entry) into finding out more.

## Details

Welcome to this fascinating global debate, held simultaneously across cities and countries. Join thoughtful people from around the world for a structured conversation where disagreement is welcome and curiosity matters more than winning.
**Reserve your place:**[https://ideas-exchange.info/en/online-debate/can-we-still-talk-across-our-differences/](https://ideas-exchange.info/en/online-debate/can-we-still-talk-across-our-differences/)
 Public conversation increasingly rewards certainty, outrage and performance. Political identity can shape whom we trust before a discussion even begins, while fragmented media make it difficult to agree on basic facts. Yet dialogue remains one of the few tools available when people must share workplaces, families, cities and democracies despite deep disagreement.
 This final English debate in the Meetup series asks when dialogue changes minds, when it merely manages coexistence, and when refusing conversation is justified. We will examine empathy without endorsement, the role of power and bad faith, and the habits and institutions that make disagreement productive.

## **Key topics we will discuss**

1.   Why people change—or defend—their beliefs
2.   Understanding, persuasion, compromise and coexistence as different goals
3.   Empathy without agreement or endorsement
4.   Identity, dignity and emotional safety
5.   Shared facts in a fragmented information environment
6.   Bad faith, propaganda and the limits of dialogue
7.   Online incentives that turn conversation into performance
8.   Practices and institutions that help people disagree better

You do not need to arrive with a fixed position. Bring experiences, questions and a willingness to listen. People of all ages, professions, countries and political viewpoints are welcome.

## **Practical information**

**When?** Tuesday, October 27, 2026
**What time?** 8:00 PM New York · 7:00 PM Chicago · 5:00 PM Los Angeles
**How does it work?** Online on Zoom · International groups · Maximum 9 participants per group
**How much?** US$6 contribution · First participation free on request · Full refund if it is not for you
**Do I need to prepare?** You do not have to prepare. The optional Food for Thought videos below offer contrasting perspectives and useful questions.
**How do I connect?** You will receive the Zoom link by email no later than 24 hours after payment.
**Register now:**[https://ideas-exchange.info/en/online-debate/can-we-still-talk-across-our-differences/](https://ideas-exchange.info/en/online-debate/can-we-still-talk-across-our-differences/)

content:
Wrongly Accused Abroad Help Me Afford Legal Defense and Survival.

Hi to everyone, my name is Julian! I'm an Italian and American national, I used to work as a substitute teacher in an Italian high school.

On 26th of August I went to China to start traveling. Some weeks later, on September 28th, I arrived in Thailand. Since then, I had been traveling mostly in northern Thailand.

It was an incredible experience — honestly, probably the best of my life.

But then… something completely unexpected happened to me.

On Wednesday, November 26th, very early in the morning around 5:30 a.m., I booked a Grab taxi from where I was staying, in Nothanburi (a province northwest of Bangkok), to go to Suvarnabhumi Airport. I had a flight with Etihad Airways at 8:55 a.m. to Italy, where I live.

I arrived at the airport two hours before departure, as recommended by the airline. The check-in process went smoothly, and everything seemed normal until I reached immigration.

There were two sections: one with officers and one automatic lane. The automatic lane was moving faster, so I chose that. When it was my turn, I tapped my passport on the scanner, but a red message appeared. I tried again—same result.

A security guard came to help me and tried scanning my passport himself, but it still didn’t work. He then told me to go to the manual lane.

The immigration officer took my passport, typed something on her computer, smiled, and said, “Sorry, just wait here for a moment.” She left and returned a few minutes later with another officer who looked serious. They escorted me to the immigration desk and told me to wait.

At that moment I started to feel anxious. I thought maybe I had overstayed my visa. My visa was expiring that same day, November 26th, so I was worried I might be in trouble.

After about 15 minutes, I approached the desk to ask what was happening, but they just told me to sit down and wait. Ten minutes later, another officer came with a paper showing a photocopy of my passport and asked me to confirm that it was mine. I said yes.

Most of the staff did not speak English, which made everything more frightening.

Then, using a translation app on his phone, the officer showed me a message saying that I was being charged with possession of indecent content and distribution of that material on websites accessible to the public.

I was completely shocked and confused. I thought there must be a mistake.

There was no opportunity to explain anything. Two immigration officers escorted me to another office inside the airport.

Inside, I was told to sign many documents, all in Thai. No one explained them to me in English. They took photos of me with officers behind me. Later, they took more photos from the front, left, and right. That’s when I realized: they were taking a mugshot.

Everything felt surreal. I was exhausted because I hadn’t slept much the night before. It felt like a nightmare.

“Did you tell your family that you have been arrested?”

That was the moment it truly hit me. I had never imagined being arrested in my life, especially not in a foreign country. I was terrified and confused.

I called my embassy, but it was still closed. Later, they contacted me and explained the situation. The embassy told me that creating and distributing certain types of videos can be a crime in Thailand, as in many countries, and that if I believed I was innocent, the Thai legal process would take its course.

They asked me for two emergency contacts and sent me a list of lawyers, advising me to find legal representation.

Eventually, we arrived at a police station in Samut Prakan province, in a town called Khlong Dan.

At that point, I was officially placed under arrest and faced the risk of jail if I was unable to pay bail.

My Italian passport was confiscated by the police and is currently being held by them. This happened on November 26th.

I am writing this today, February 24, 2026. I am creating a YouTube channel to explain in more detail what is happening to me. I am currently safe and living in a hostel in Bangkok. The last three months have been the most stressful of my life.

In December, I struggled to obtain a visa extension, which I was finally able to secure on January 8, 2026. This visa must be renewed every 45 days.

I am asking for your help to raise funds for legal fees, living expenses, and possible bail that may be requested by the judge if the case goes to court. I cannot legally work in Thailand because that requires a work visa. My family is helping me at the moment, but they cannot sustain these expenses for much longer. I do not know when I will be able to return to my country, as I must wait for the Thai legal process to run its course.

**I want to state clearly that I have never uploaded any indecent content on the internet. The accuser, a woman, has claimed to provide “evidence” of this. At the police station, I was shown the alleged evidence, which consisted of screenshots from an OnlyFans profile belonging to a couple: a Thai woman and a Caucasian man. The man’s face was blurred, and I was accused of being that person.**

The case will soon be handed over to the prosecutor, and according to police officers at Khlong Dan Police Station, it will most likely proceed to court (that's what they said). This is extremely distressing, especially because my lawyer has told me that cases with weak evidence are usually dropped by the police or the prosecutor.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Any help or support during this very difficult time would mean a great deal to me.

Julian
