# Northern Taiwan to see showers Thursday as day-night temperature gap widens

10/14/2026 08:15 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 14 (CNA) Northern Taiwan will see local showers on Thursday, with weather conditions over the following days expected to stabilize, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).

However, a wider day-night temperature gap is expected to persist through Tuesday, the CWA added.

Although the northeasterly monsoon will weaken on Thursday, moisture levels are set to increase, bringing localized showers to Keelung's northern coast, mountainous areas of Greater Taipei, eastern Taiwan and the Hengchun Peninsula, according to the CWA forecast.

Yilan is expected to see the most significant rainfall on Thursday, CWA forecaster Wang Pin-hsiang (王品翔) said.

Temperatures in northern and northeastern Taiwan will be relatively low, with highs of 28-30 degrees Celsius, while highs in central and southern Taiwan will reach 32-33 degrees on Thursday, Wang said.

After Thursday, moisture levels will gradually decrease across Taiwan, with sunny to cloudy skies expected from Friday through Tuesday, he added.

Eastern Taiwan and the Hengchun Peninsula will see localized showers, while mountainous areas in central and southern Taiwan will experience sporadic showers.

From Friday, daytime highs could exceed 30 degrees across Taiwan, with temperatures in central and southern areas ranging from 33-35 degrees, Wang said.

However, the day-night temperature difference will be most pronounced in western Taiwan, with lows of 23-25 degrees, he added.

Owing to radiative cooling, some parts of Taiwan could see lows below 20 degrees Celsius, Wang said.

(By Chang Hsiung-feng and Lee Chieh-yu)

# 台湾财政部长庄翠云将赴港出席APEC财长会 中国财长蓝佛安主持

茉莉花综合报道 2026年10月14日 19:53

亚太经济合作组织（APEC）财政部长会议10月20日至21日在香港举行，由中国财政部长蓝佛安主持；台湾财政部10月13日说，财政部长庄翠云会“循例”出席。中国财政部10月14日说，21个APEC经济体的财政部长或代表、有关国际组织负责人和伙伴方高级代表会参加，议题有4项：支持民生发展的财政政策、数字基础设施融资、因地制宜促进普惠金融发展、促进APEC青年财经人才交流合作。

受影响的是台湾参加APEC的方式：今年APEC领袖峰会由中国主办，11月18日至19日在广东深圳举行，相关部长级会议多安排在中国境内。按惯例，台湾会由总统赖清德指派领袖代表出席领袖峰会，但到10月13日，总统府还没有公布人选。

劳动部长洪申翰9月21日在南京出席APEC人力资源发展部长会议，9月22日回到台湾。他说，他没有办、也没有用台胞证，是按照惯例用邀请函进入中国；中方依照APEC规定安排会议和权利，台湾坚持的对等尊严要求得到了落实。他还说，台湾在APEC的正式会籍名称就是Chinese Taipei，真正要坚持的是和其他会员享有同等的权利。

台湾出席中国主办的APEC会议

1.   2014年 APEC在北京开经济领袖会议，台湾由领袖代表、前副总统萧万长率团出席
2.   2026年9月21日 劳动部长洪申翰在南京出席APEC人力资源发展部长会议
3.   2026年9月22日 洪申翰回到台湾，说没有办台胞证，对等尊严要求得到落实
4.   2026年10月13日 台湾财政部说，财政部长庄翠云会循例出席香港APEC财长会
5.   2026年10月20日至21日 APEC财长会在香港举行，中国财政部长蓝佛安主持
6.   2026年11月18日至19日 APEC领袖峰会在深圳举行，台湾领袖代表人选未公布

数据：台湾行政院2014年的出席总结、台湾劳动部长洪申翰的说法、台湾财政部和中国财政部的说明

按中国财政部公布的日程，10月20日上午是财长闭门会，中午财长和亚太工商界代表吃工作午餐，听取动员私人资本、支持数字基础设施融资的建议，下午开幕；10月21日会议闭幕后举行记者会。中方希望会上形成财长会声明、数字基础设施融资政策声明等文件。

## 茉莉花观察

这一节是茉莉花的看法，依据是上文的事实。

我们的分析 台湾部长出席中国主办的APEC部长级会议，已经有了一套做法。洪申翰用APEC的邀请函入境，不办台胞证，以正式会员的身份和其他会员同等参加；庄翠云这次是“循例”去香港。还没有定下来的是领袖峰会：2014年APEC在北京开经济领袖会议时，台湾由领袖代表、前副总统萧万长率团出席；今年深圳峰会的领袖代表，总统府还没有公布。

不同看法 国民党立委王鸿薇说，APEC今年已经开过多场部长级会议，杨珍妮之前也参加过，洪申翰不是第一个，不必标榜自己提升了台湾的地位；国民党立委廖伟翔说，国民党过去用中华台北的名称出席，被民进党骂成矮化、卖台，如今民进党自己用就说是守住尊严，这种双重标准才是台湾外交最大的阻力。我们同意，用中华台北的名称出席APEC是历届政府一样的做法，不是这次才争取到的；但洪申翰讲的重点不在名称，而在入境方式和同等的权利，这一点在领袖峰会上还要再看一次。

# DH urges hygiene as hand, foot and mouth disease cases rise

Hong Kong's Department of Health has urged the public to maintain hygiene as hand, foot and mouth disease outbreaks increase in schools and child care centres. The Centre for Health Protection will update schools and requires immediate reporting of outbreaks, noting alcohol-based handrub is not a su

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 14 Oct 2026 at 19:52 HKT · 1 min read

The Department of Health (DH) on Wednesday urged the public to maintain hygiene as local cases of hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) have increased recently.

The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) of the DH will issue letters to schools today, updating them on the latest HFMD situation. Schools and institutions are required to report any outbreak to the CHP immediately.

According to the CHP's latest surveillance data, eight outbreaks in institutions and schools, affecting 27 people, were recorded per week in mid-September. The number of HFMD outbreaks increased gradually to 12, 11 and 20 outbreaks per week in the past three weeks.

From Sunday to Tuesday, nine outbreaks affecting 24 people were reported. Ninety per cent of the outbreaks occurred in child care centres, kindergartens and primary schools.

HFMD is a common disease in children caused by enteroviruses, such as Coxsackie virus and EV71. It occurs throughout the year in Hong Kong, with the usual peak from May to July and from October to December.

The DH said HFMD usually causes mild symptoms, including fever, poor appetite, fatigue and sore throat, followed by painful mouth sores that may ulcerate. Most people recover without treatment in seven to 10 days.

The department also reminded that alcohol-based handrub should not substitute hand hygiene with liquid soap and water, as alcohol does not effectively kill some viruses that cause HFMD.

title: Tokyo protests Russia’s arrest of Japanese journalist on suspicion of spying
summary: TOKYO — Japan lodged a protest with Russia on Wednesday over the arrest of a Japanese journalist on suspicion of spying, demanding that Moscow provide an explanation, consular access and humane treatment. Russia's Federal Security Service s
content:
TOKYO — Japan lodged a protest with Russia on Wednesday over the arrest of a Japanese journalist on suspicion of spying, demanding that Moscow provide an explanation, consular access and humane treatment.

Russia's Federal Security Service said the man, who works for the Hokkaido Shimbun newspaper, was suspected of gathering information about Russia's defense capability on behalf of a Japanese intelligence agency. Russia's Foreign Ministry identified the reporter as Yuki Imai.

**The FSB, the main successor to the Soviet KGB, said it arrested the man on Sakhalin Island as he was preparing to leave Russia.**

*   [Nobel winner Pillay blasts 'unlawful' Trump ICC sanctions](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/world/nobel-winner-pillay-blasts-unlawful-trump-icc-sanctions/2445624)

Tuesday’s arrest is the latest dispute between the two countries, whose tensions have spiked after President Vladimir Putin ’s visit in August to Iturup, one of four disputed Kuril Islands, a Moscow-controlled Pacific archipelago that also is claimed by Japan.

Hokkaido Shimbun said the man had been reporting in Russia on a journalist visa and was due to leave the country Monday. The newspaper did not disclose his name.

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova said Tuesday that Imai had been charged with espionage. She accused Tokyo of using Japanese journalists in Russia to gather information to undermine Russian security, calling it “regrettable.”

Zakharova said Japan’s policies toward Russia and its military buildup threatened Moscow’s security interests in the Far East, adding that “the incident will further dampen the atmosphere in Russian-Japanese relations.”

In Tokyo on Wednesday, Kimitake Nakamura, head of the European Affairs Bureau at Japan's Foreign Ministry, summoned Russian Ambassador Nikolay Nozdrev to protest the arrest and Moscow's announcement without an explanation to Japan's government, according to a ministry statement.

*   ![Image 1: Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/13/1258203.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/opinion/columns/marcos-impeachment-plot-backfires/2444878)

Nakamura demanded humane and fair treatment of the journalist and for Japanese officials to be allowed to have contact with him, the ministry said.

He also reiterated Japan's territorial claim over the Kuril Islands, which Tokyo calls the Northern Territory. He protested a recent visit to Iturup by officials of a Chinese regional government and companies, calling it “unacceptable.” The Sakhalin regional government announced the visit Tuesday.

**Nozdrev said he would relay Japan's position to Moscow, according to the Japanese ministry.**

Japan's Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara earlier said the journalist's health was unknown because Japanese officials have been unable to contact him. Russia had not responded to Tokyo's requests for access, he added.

*   ![Image 2: 44% expect Sara Duterte’s conviction in impeachment trial — survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258812.jpeg?width=113&crop=113:85)

**“We'll do everything we can for the protection of the Japanese citizen,” he said.**

Though Japan has “many problems” with Russia, the two countries are neighbors and “we need to communicate,” Kihara said. Japan recognizes the importance of properly managing relations and will take appropriate steps to serve its national interests, he added.

The Russian region of Sakhalin includes Sakhalin Island and the four southernmost islands of the Kuril chain, which Moscow controls and Tokyo claims.

Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi protested Putin’s August visit, calling it a further blow to relations already strained by Russia’s war in Ukraine. Earlier this month, Tokyo imposed additional economic sanctions on Moscow over the war.

The Soviet Union seized the Kuril Islands from Japan in the final days of World War II. The territorial dispute has prevented the two countries from signing a peace treaty formally ending their hostilities.

# EXCLUSIVE/Belize PM vows stronger support for Taiwan after China sanctions

10/14/2026 09:07 PM

Belize Prime Minister John Briceño. CNA photo Oct. 14, 2026

Bangkok, Oct. 14 (CNA) Belize Prime Minister John Briceño said Wednesday that China's sanctions against Belize's foreign minister were "uncalled for," "unjustified," "wrong" and "illegal," adding that the move would only strengthen Belize's resolve to keep supporting Taiwan.

Briceño made the remarks in an interview with CNA in Bangkok, where he was attending the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank.

"We are very concerned and disappointed that China would take such a position," Briceño said, referring to Beijing's decision to impose sanctions on Belizean Foreign Minister Francis Fonseca.

"We believe that we are an independent country and, as an independent country, we should be allowed to make our own decisions," he said. "We believe that we are doing the right thing by standing with Taiwan."

Briceño said the sanctions would have no impact on Belize's commitment to maintaining relations with Taiwan.

China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced Monday that it had imposed what it described as "countermeasures" against Fonseca and Paraguayan Minister of Information and Communication Technologies Gustavo Villate.

The measures include freezing any movable, immovable or other assets belonging to the two officials within China, prohibiting Chinese organizations and individuals from conducting transactions or engaging in cooperation with them, and denying them visas and entry into China, including Hong Kong and Macau.

Beijing announced the sanctions after Fonseca and Villate attended an event in Taipei celebrating Republic of China (Taiwan) National Day.

(By Zachary Lee and Evelyn Kao)

summary: 作者：Yoo Jee-ho 首尔，10 月 14 日（韩联社）——LG Twins 球星奥斯汀·迪恩周三计划了一个更好的方式来庆祝他的 33 岁生日。这位美国重击手在首尔蚕室棒球场举行的韩国棒球组织 (KBO) 季后赛中，在第一局下半打出两分本垒打，帮助双城队以 4-1 击败斗山熊队，获得外卡资格。 10 月 10 日，在首尔蚕室棒球场举行的韩国棒球组织季后赛俱乐部外卡赛中，LG 双城队的奥斯汀·迪恩 (Austin Dean) 在对阵斗山熊队 (Doosan Bears) 的比赛中打出两分本垒打后庆祝。
content:
作者：柳智浩

首尔，10 月 14 日（韩联社）——周三，LG Twins 球星奥斯汀·迪恩 (Austin Dean) 计划了一个更好的方式来庆祝他的 33 岁生日。

这位美国重击手在首尔蚕室棒球场举行的韩国棒球组织 (KBO) 季后赛中，在第一局下半打出两分本垒打，帮助双城队以 4-1 击败斗山熊队，获得外卡资格。

2026 年 10 月 14 日，在首尔蚕室棒球场举行的韩国棒球组织季后赛俱乐部外卡赛中，LG 双城队的奥斯汀·迪恩 (Austin Dean) 在对阵斗山熊队的比赛中击出两分全垒打后庆祝。（韩联社）

在对阵先发球员郭本（Gwak Been）的第一次击球的第六球中，迪恩（Dean）得到了一个悬挂在该区域顶部的弧线球，迪恩（Dean）猛烈地挥杆并欣赏他的高耸射门，该球飞入左外野的看台深处。

“对我来说，这只是想找到一个好的球场来处理，”迪恩说。 “显然，如果你看了今天的比赛，你就会知道他们的计划是不给我任何中间的东西，或者相对而言任何好的击球。我觉得那里的那个球已经足够好，让我能够发挥出我最好的挥杆能力。我想他一扔球，我就很好地看到了球的出局。我一击球，就自动知道我得到了它。”

迪恩在接下来的三场本垒打中三振，但第一局的出色表现足以让他被评为本场最佳球员。
迪恩带领双城队在常规赛中打出了职业生涯最高的 41 个本垒打。不过，他在接下来的比赛中表现得很冷静，在 10 月份的 9 场比赛中只打出了 2 个本垒打，安打率只有 0.200，但他在本次季后赛的第一次击球中表现出色。

迪恩在最近的季后赛系列赛中表现非常挣扎。在 2025 年韩国系列赛中，迪恩在 5 场比赛中 20 场仅打出 1 次，双城队以 4-1 击败韩华老鹰队的系列赛轻松掩盖了这一低迷状态。在 2024 年第二轮对阵三星雄狮队的比赛中，迪恩在四场比赛中 15 投 1 中，双城队在卫冕过程中提前被淘汰。

LG 双城队的奥斯汀·迪恩于 2026 年 10 月 14 日在首尔蚕室棒球场举行的韩国棒球组织季后赛对阵斗山熊队的外卡比赛中被评为最佳球员后进行庆祝。（韩联社）

虽然大多数季后赛比赛都在 10 月进行，但这是迪恩自 2023 年加入双城队以来在生日那天的第一次季后赛比赛。

迪恩还在 2023 年 10 月 14 日打了一场常规赛，并在当天对阵熊队的比赛中打出了全垒打。

“我很少这样做，”他说。 “我并没有把我的生日当作什么大事。这只是又一天变老了，我的头上和胡须上的白发越来越多，但现在很酷。显然，我必须花时间和家人、孩子们在一起。获得生日本垒打总是一种奖励。”
双胞胎队的下一场比赛将是起亚老虎队，他们的 MVP 候选人是金道英。

金和迪恩为争夺本垒打冠军进行了一场令人难忘的对决，金以四支本垒打获胜，其中包括周一两队常规赛最后一场比赛中的一支本垒打，这场比赛为老虎队锁定了第三号种子，并将双城队送入外卡赛。

当被问及与金和他的老虎队的另一场比赛时，迪恩表示季后赛将是另一种情况。

“常规赛已经结束了，”迪恩说。 “道英加冕本垒打之王。祝贺他。这是一项了不起的成就，但现在我们处于季后赛模式。你的统计数据

【原文 English Original】
By Yoo Jee-ho

SEOUL, Oct. 14 (Yonhap) -- LG Twins star Austin Dean could not have planned a better way to celebrate his 33rd birthday Wednesday.

The American slugger launched a two-run home run in the bottom of the first inning to help the Twins defeat the Doosan Bears 4-1 for the wild card in the Korea Baseball Organization (KBO) postseason at Jamsil Baseball Stadium in Seoul.

Austin Dean of the LG Twins celebrates after hitting a two-run home run against the Doosan Bears during the clubs' wild card game in the Korea Baseball Organization postseason at Jamsil Baseball Stadium in Seoul on Oct. 14, 2026. (Yonhap)

On the sixth pitch of his first at-bat against starter Gwak Been, Dean got a curveball that hung over the top of the zone, Dean took a violent swing and admired his towering shot that flew deep into the stands in left field.

"For me, it was just trying to find a good pitch to handle," Dean said. "Obviously, if you watched the game today, you know their plan was to not give me anything in the middle or relatively anything good to hit. I feel like that one right there was just good enough for me to be able to put my best swing on it. I think I saw it out of the hand really well as soon as he threw it. I knew automatically, as soon as I hit it, that I got it."

Dean struck out in his next three trips to the plate, but the first-inning dinger was enough to get him named the Player of the Game.

Dean led the Twins with a career-high 41 home runs in the regular season. He had cooled off down the stretch, though, managing just two home runs and a .200 batting average in nine games in October, but he went deep in his very first at-bat of this postseason.

Dean struggled mightily in his recent postseason series. In the 2025 Korean Series, Dean batted only 1-for-20 in five games, a slump conveniently masked by the Twins' 4-1 series win over the Hanwha Eagles. And for the 2024 second round against the Samsung Lions, Dean went 1-for-15 in four games, as the Twins were eliminated early in their title defense.

Austin Dean of the LG Twins celebrates after being named the Player of the Game in a Korea Baseball Organization postseason's wild card game against the Doosan Bears at Jamsil Baseball Stadium in Seoul on Oct. 14, 2026. (Yonhap)

While most postseason games are played in October, this was Dean's first postseason action on his birthday since he joined the Twins in 2023.

Dean had also played a regular-season game on Oct. 14, 2023, and homered against the Bears that day, too.

"It's not very often I get to do that," he said. "I don't make a big deal of my birthday. It's just another day of getting older, getting more gray hairs on my head and my beard, but now it is cool. I got to spend the time with my family, with my kids, obviously. And getting the birthday home run is always a bonus."

Next up for the Twins will be the Kia Tigers, featuring their own MVP candidate in Kim Do-yeong.

Kim and Dean engaged in a memorable duel for the home run title, with Kim winning it by four homers, including one on Monday in their two teams' final regular-season meeting that sealed the third seed for the Tigers and sent the Twins to the wild card game.

Asked about another matchup against Kim and his Tigers, Dean said the postseason will be a different animal.

"The regular season is over with," Dean said. "Do-yeong is crowned the home run king. Congratulations to him. It is an awesome achievement, but now we are in the postseason mode. Your stats don't matter, what you did in the regular season. Now it is just trying to be a good team player and do what we can to win ball games.

"That is all that really matters right now."

Austin Dean of the LG Twins flips his bat after hitting a two-run home run against the Doosan Bears during the clubs' wild card game in the Korea Baseball Organization postseason at Jamsil Baseball Stadium in Seoul on Oct. 14, 2026. (Yonhap)

# 花莲市长参选人张荣法部分竞选资金疑受中共资助 6万元交保

茉莉花综合报道 2026年10月14日 20:05

今年以无党籍身份参选花莲市长的前新党副发言人张荣法，涉嫌接受境外敌对势力的指示、委托或资助从事竞选活动，检察官讯问后认为张荣法涉嫌违反《反渗透法》、罪嫌重大，但没有羁押的必要，谕令张荣法以新台币6万元交保候传。检调说，张荣法用来参选的部分资金疑似受中共资助。花莲地检署10月14日说，10月12日、13日指挥法务部调查局花莲县调查站、台北市调查处、苗栗县调查站等单位，持花莲地方法院核发的搜索票到张荣法住处搜索；检调会继续追查相关资金的来源和流向，厘清是否涉及境外资金或大陆势力介入选举，全案仍在侦办中。

受影响的是花莲市的选民：一名花莲市长候选人正因涉嫌受境外敌对势力资助从事竞选活动而被侦办。花莲地检署呼吁民众，遇到买票贿选、选举赌盘、不实讯息或境外资金势力介入等情况，拨打免付费检举专线0800-024099检举，查明属实的，检举奖金最高2000万元。

同一次行动还侦办了花莲县议员候选人杨悟空等人涉嫌挪用一个公益社团法人的捐款作选举等用途的案子：检调10月12日、13日到被告住处等10处搜索，通知4名被告到案说明。杨悟空被法院裁定羁押禁见，另两名被告分别以3万元、1万元交保。

花莲地检署10月12日至13日行动的4名被告

| 被告 | 涉嫌 | 怎样处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 张荣法（花莲市长候选人） | 违反《反渗透法》 | 检察官谕令以新台币6万元交保 |
| 杨悟空（花莲县议员候选人） | 公益侵占等（挪用公益社团法人捐款作选举等用途） | 法院准予羁押禁见 |
| 庄姓被告 | 公益侵占等 | 具保新台币3万元 |
| 王姓被告 | 公益侵占等 | 具保新台币1万元 |

张荣法现年54岁，曾任台大夜间部首任学生会长、新党副发言人，2022年代表新党参选台北市第五选区市议员落选。今年张荣法转到花莲参选市长，主张争取两岸三地直航，并承诺当选后把选举补助款全数捐出做公益。2022年参选台北市议员期间，张荣法为了规避食药署查验，用配偶和亲友当人头，从中国大陆厦门宝太生物科技公司输入4300剂快筛试剂，免费提供选民使用；一审依违反《医疗器材管理法》判有期徒刑5个月，上诉后张荣法认罪，台湾高等法院改判有期徒刑3个月，可易科罚金9万元，缓刑2年。

这一节是茉莉花的看法，依据是上文的事实。

我们的分析 这个案子目前只到“疑似”。检调说张荣法部分参选资金疑似受中共资助，但这几篇报道都没有写出钱的来源、金额和指示的内容，检察官也认为不必羁押。花莲市的选民因此知道一名候选人正被怀疑拿了中共的钱，却还看不到证据。

title: HK and Chongqing launch cross-boundary data validation platform
zh_title: 香港与重庆推出跨境数据验证平台
summary: 香港 香港和重庆推出基于区块链的跨境数据验证平台，无需传输原始文件即可验证财务数据。该平台由重庆信用和微众银行科技服务有限公司运营，最初将支持开户等银行服务 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 14 2026 年 10 月，香港时间 17:57 · 1 分钟阅读香港金融管理局 (HKMA) 和重庆当局关于 W
content:
香港
香港和重庆推出基于区块链的跨境数据验证平台，无需传输原始文件即可验证财务数据。该平台由重庆信用和微众银行技术服务公司运营，初期将支持开户等银行服务。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 14 日 17:57 · 阅读时间 1 分钟

香港金融管理局（金管局）和重庆当局周三推出了渝港跨境数据验证平台，这是一个基于区块链的系统，可以在不传输或存储原始文件的情况下验证数据，从而降低跨境结算中的合规和隐私风险。

该平台由重庆信贷和微众银行技术服务公司运营，微众银行是腾讯支持的微众银行的子公司。金管局表示，最初将重点关注两个城市之间的金融应用，由当地银行开发用例来验证北向和南向数据流。这将帮助客户获得银行服务，例如开户和贷款申请。
金管局总裁余伟文表示：“我们将与内地有关部门、银行业、前沿科技企业及其他持份者保持紧密联系，不断完善平台，造福两地居民和企业，支持实体经济发展。”

该技术已在深港跨境数据验证平台得到验证，该平台于2024年5月启动试点，并于2025年4月接入金管局商业数据交换平台。金管局表示，该平台已记录超过4万次使用，为10多家银行、10多个业务场景提供服务。

金管局表示，致力于根据2025年香港金融科技周期间公布的金融科技2030战略创建下一代数据基础设施，围绕数据基础设施、人工智能、弹性和代币化这四个“DART”支柱，将香港变成一个强大的、面向未来的国际金融中心。

Hong Kong and Chongqing have launched a blockchain-based cross-boundary data validation platform to verify financial data without transferring original documents. The platform, operated by Chongqing Credit and WeBank Technology Services, will initially support banking services such as account openin

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 17:57 HKT · 1 min read

The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and Chongqing authorities on Wednesday launched the Chongqing-Hong Kong Cross-boundary Data Validation Platform, a blockchain-based system that verifies data without transferring or storing original documents, reducing compliance and privacy risks in cross-border settlement.

The platform is operated by Chongqing Credit and WeBank Technology Services, a unit of Tencent-backed WeBank. It will initially focus on financial applications between the two cities, with local banks developing use cases to validate northbound and southbound data flows, the HKMA said. This will help clients access banking services such as account opening and loan applications.

Eddie Yue Wai-man, chief executive of the HKMA, said: "We will maintain close liaison with the relevant Mainland authorities, the banking industry, frontier technology companies and other stakeholders to continuously enhance the platform. This, in turn, will benefit residents and corporates from both places and support the development of the real economy."

The technology has been proven on the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Cross-boundary Data Validation Platform, a pilot launched in May 2024 and connected to the HKMA's commercial data interchange in April 2025. That platform has recorded more than 40,000 usages, serving over 10 banks across more than 10 business scenarios, the HKMA said.

The HKMA said it is committed to creating next-generation data infrastructure under the Fintech 2030 strategy, unveiled during Hong Kong Fintech Week 2025, to turn Hong Kong into a robust, future-ready international financial hub around four "DART" pillars: data infrastructure, artificial intelligence, resilience and tokenization.

content:
香港
环境生态局局长谢展云表示，香港正在审查狗只管制法，并计划于明年完成修订。继最近的行动之后，政府将在年底前咨询立法者，并研究增加对遗弃动物或未能控制狗的处罚

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 14 日 17:58 · 阅读时间 1 分钟

环境生态局局长谢展云表示，政府正在全面检讨现行的犬只管制法例，目标是明年完成法例修订。

谢表示，政府将在今年年底前就拟议修正案咨询立法会事务委员会。他在给立法者的书面答复中表示，政府对最近狗袭击人和动物的事件深感担忧。

他说，渔农自然护理署（渔护署）和警方正在调查事件原因，并已采取执法和管制措施。政府将研究是否加大对遗弃动物和未能妥善管理狗的处罚力度。

至于是否应更新“斗狗”的定义，谢表示，政府正在收集持份者的意见，并会参考其他司法管辖区的监管经验。
渔护署现正对曾发生事故或发现较多流浪狗的高风险地区加强巡逻及流浪狗捕捉行动，以减低公众安全风险。谢表示，该部门将对未能妥善控制其动物的狗主人采取严厉执法行动。

他还强调，现有立法没有规定“代表他人注册狗的微芯片”的任何安排。他说，登记的狗主人有法律责任妥善照顾和控制以其名下登记的狗。

遗弃狗或让它在公共场所不受控制地徘徊是违法行为。渔护署亦正研究修订狗只准照申请表，以使用更清晰的措辞，提醒业主其法律责任。

Hong Kong is reviewing dog-control legislation and aims to complete amendments next year, Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said. The government will consult lawmakers by year-end and study increasing penalties for abandoning animals or failing to control dogs, following recent atta

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 17:58 HKT · 1 min read

The government is conducting a comprehensive review of existing dog-control legislation and aims to complete the legislative amendments next year, Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said.

Tse said the government would consult the Legislative Council Panel on the proposed amendments by the end of this year. In a written reply to lawmakers, he said the government was deeply concerned about recent dog attacks on people and animals.

The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) and police are investigating the causes of the incidents and have taken enforcement and control measures, he said. The government will study whether to increase penalties for abandoning animals and failing to keep dogs under proper control.

On whether the definition of “fighting dogs” should be updated, Tse said the government was gathering views from stakeholders and would also refer to the regulatory experience of other jurisdictions.

The AFCD is stepping up patrols and stray dog capture operations in high-risk areas where incidents have occurred or where larger numbers of stray dogs are found, in a bid to reduce risks to public safety. Tse said the department would take strict enforcement action against dog owners found to have failed to keep their animals under proper control.

He also stressed that existing legislation does not provide for any arrangement for “registering a dog’s microchip on another person’s behalf.” Registered dog owners are legally responsible for properly caring for and controlling dogs registered in their names, he said.

Abandoning a dog or allowing it to wander uncontrolled in a public place is an offense. The AFCD is also studying revisions to the dog license application form to use clearer wording reminding owners of their legal responsibilities.

# Hong Kong customs seizes over 7,000 suspected counterfeit goods worth HK$7.6 million

Hong Kong customs has smashed 16 cases of cross-border transshipment of counterfeit watches and other goods, seizing over 7,000 items worth more than HK$7.6 million. A 65-year-old man was arrested and is out on bail pending investigation.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Share:

Hong Kong customs has seized more than 7,000 suspected counterfeit goods, including watches, apparel and mobile phones, with an estimated market value of over HK$7.6 million, following a two-week operation targeting the cross-border transshipment of fake watch-type items.

The operation, which ran over the past fortnight, resulted in the detection of 16 related cases, customs said on Wednesday. A 65-year-old man was arrested during the crackdown and is currently out on bail pending further investigation.

Through intelligence analysis and in-depth inquiries, customs officers uncovered the cases at several local logistics companies and express parcel centres. The department believes all of the seized suspected counterfeit goods were destined for transshipment to overseas regions.

In one instance, customs officers conducted a controlled delivery operation involving a batch of seized items. Last Wednesday, they arrested one person at an industrial unit in Kwai Chung and seized about 600 suspected counterfeit items, including watches and mobile phones, with an estimated market value of about HK$400,000.

The latest enforcement action is part of customs' ongoing efforts to combat the illegal trade in counterfeit goods passing through Hong Kong's logistics network.

title: UK prosecutor tells jury Russell Brand a 'sexual predator'
summary: **LONDON —**Comedian Russell Brand was a "sexual predator" who was "ruthless, calculated and manipulative" when targeting women for sex, a British prosecutor told a UK jury Wednesday at the start of his rape and sexual assault trial. The on
content:
**LONDON —**Comedian Russell Brand was a "sexual predator" who was "ruthless, calculated and manipulative" when targeting women for sex, a British prosecutor told a UK jury Wednesday at the start of his rape and sexual assault trial.

The one-time left-wing personality, 51, who shot to fame as a television and radio presenter, faces seven sexual offense charges involving six women. He denies all the alleged offenses.

Prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones said the alleged offenses took place between 1999 and 2009, when Brand's career was beginning to flourish.

*   [Marites Allen reveals fearless 2027 Fire Sheep forecast, pioneering ‘Destiny Is in Your Stars’ platform](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/entertainment-lifestyle/marites-allen-reveals-fearless-2027-fire-sheep-forecast-pioneering-destiny-is-in-your-stars-platform/2445260)

Addressing the jury, she gave graphic details of accusations by women, saying the youngest was 21 at the time of the alleged offenses.

They came forward to police after seeing media coverage about Brand in 2023 and after he was initially charged in 2025, the court heard.

Brand was "not deterred" when some of the women said no, she said, adding his desire for sexual contact was "indiscriminate and voracious."

He used charm and comic talents when he wanted something but would then be "demanding and entitled... childlike in his expectation that his every desire should be met," Karmy-Jones told the jury of eight men and four women.

**Bragging**

*   ![Image 1: Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258438.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/pangilinan-seeks-reversal-of-ruling-on-dutertes-dropped-charges/2445025)

"He was ruthless, calculated and manipulative, and the prosecution say — a sexual predator," she added.

The identities of the women will not be revealed during the trial.

Brand, dressed in a dark suit, black-and-white striped shirt and long white tie, arrived for the start of the case at London's Southwark Crown Court in a black Mercedes-Benz van accompanied by his wife Laura.

In each woman's case, Brand responded to police with a prepared statement saying he did not remember the women and any sexual activity was consensual.

*   ![Image 2: Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/13/1258203.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/opinion/columns/marcos-impeachment-plot-backfires/2444878)

Karmy-Jones said Brand's acquaintances recalled him bragging that he wanted to "bed 5,000 women in his lifetime", adding, "you have to tell them what they need to hear."

It was a clear indication of "how manipulative the defendant could be," she said.

Brand has in recent years reinvented himself as a conservative and faith-based guru for millions of social media followers.

He has pleaded not guilty to all seven of the charges — three counts of rape, three of sexual assault and one charge of indecent assault.

*   ![Image 3: 44% expect Sara Duterte’s conviction in impeachment trial — survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258812.jpeg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[44% expect Sara Duterte’s conviction in impeachment trial — survey](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/44-expect-sara-dutertes-conviction-in-impeachment-trial-survey/2445251)

[![Image 4: British comedian and actor Russell Brand arrives at Southwark Crown Court in south London on October 14, 2026, for the start of his trial. 51-year-old Brand faces seven sexual offense charges involving six women, relating to a period between 1999 and 2009. AFP PHOTO](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259663.jpg)](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259663.jpg)
British comedian and actor Russell Brand arrives at Southwark Crown Court in south London on October 14, 2026, for the start of his trial. 51-year-old Brand faces seven sexual offense charges involving six women, relating to a period between 1999 and 2009. AFP PHOTO

The first woman met Brand when he was performing at a Labour Party conference in Bournemouth in southern England in 1999.

She invited him to her hotel room where he pushed her onto the bed before raping her without using a condom, the prosecutor said.

One woman said Brand in 2001 tried to drag her into a toilet cubicle at MTV's office, but she resisted.

Another woman met Brand at a London bar in 2004 and said he grabbed her breasts and pulled her into a toilet cubicle, orally raping her, after telling her not to be a "spoilsport."

Yet another woman said Brand visited the radio station where she worked in 2004 or 2005, and kissed her "very aggressively" then grabbed her breasts and bottom.

One woman, who was 21 at the time, said she had consensual oral and then vaginal sex with Brand in 2009 at his house but he then forced her into anal sex without her consent "with full force" without a condom, the prosecutor said.

**Massage**

In the final charge, a woman employed by Channel 4 television said she was working with Brand in a record studio in 2009.

Members of his production team told her she must give him a massage and he then pressed his face into her groin.

The trial at London's Southwark Crown Court should last around six weeks but could stretch into December.

The trial is attracting intense media scrutiny, with numerous British outlets launching dedicated podcasts and US channels reporting from outside the court.

Born to working-class parents in Essex in eastern England, Brand launched a successful stand-up comedy career as a teenager.

He became a household name as a television presenter on MTV, Channel 4 and the BBC, also penning newspaper columns and two autobiographies.

He then made a foray into Hollywood, starring in several hit films, and was in a brief but high-profile marriage to US pop star Katy Perry.

Now remarried and living in Florida with his young family, he has gained a new following as an influencer, with six million subscribers on YouTube, 10.1 million on X and 4.9 million on Instagram.

title: Nobel winner Pillay blasts 'unlawful' Trump ICC sanctions
summary: **THE HAGUE —**Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay on Wednesday hit out at Donald Trump's "illegal" sanctions against the International Criminal Court, saying the US president needed a lesson in international law. In an interview with Agen
content:
**THE HAGUE —**Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay on Wednesday hit out at Donald Trump's "illegal" sanctions against the International Criminal Court, saying the US president needed a lesson in international law.

In an interview with Agence France-Presse, Pillay also said it was no coincidence the US sanctions on the ICC were announced just hours after her Nobel, as a "reaction to the fact that the award was not given to President Trump."

Asked what her message was for Trump, the 85-year-old judge told AFP: "Call in your legal advisors to explain to you what international law is."

*   [Pope Leo admitted to Rome hospital for lung operation](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/13/world/americas-emea/pope-leo-admitted-to-rome-hospital-for-lung-operation/2444638)

"He should call in his advisors to tell him why we say that it is unlawful for him to interfere with an independent international court."

On Friday, the US announced sanctions against the ICC aimed at crippling the day-to-day operations of the court, which tries individuals for war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide.

 delivered to your inbox

Sign up for The Manila Times newsletters

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

Trump's administration has vowed to dismantle the court "brick-by-brick," furious that judges have issued an arrest warrant for Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for alleged crimes in Gaza.

Pillay noted that previous US administrations had welcomed an ICC arrest warrant against Russian President Vladimir Putin, saying, "that's selective, that's double standards, and that's wrong."

The sanctions, which will hit the court's technology and banking operations, take effect in six months and Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten has urged talks with Washington during that time to discuss reforms to the court, based in The Hague.

*   ![Image 1: Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258438.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/pangilinan-seeks-reversal-of-ruling-on-dutertes-dropped-charges/2445025)

But Pillay said the idea of reforms to the ICC was "euphemistic", adding that what Trump wanted was "an undertaking that they won't pursue investigations of US citizens."

"You can't do that, because you can't have double standards. You can't selectively pursue one lot of people and not the other," Pillay told AFP.

"It will be such a bad, dangerous precedent."

**'Hurtful and insulting'**

*   ![Image 2: 44% expect Sara Duterte’s conviction in impeachment trial — survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258812.jpeg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[44% expect Sara Duterte’s conviction in impeachment trial — survey](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/44-expect-sara-dutertes-conviction-in-impeachment-trial-survey/2445251)

Pillay also hit back at Israeli officials who reacted with outrage to her Nobel, after she headed the UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry (COI), which found last year that genocide was occurring in Gaza.

Netanyahu called her a "bigot" while Israel's foreign ministry said Nazi propagandist Joseph Goebbels must be "applauding from hell" at her award.

"I think it's very hurtful and insulting," said Pillay.

*   ![Image 3: Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/13/1258203.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/opinion/columns/marcos-impeachment-plot-backfires/2444878)

[![Image 4: South African lawyer and champion of international law Navi Pillay addresses journalists after she was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, on October 9, 2026 at the historic Courtroom 600 of Nuremberg's Palace of Justice, venue of the 1945-1946 Nuremberg Trials against leaders of defeated Nazi Germany, in Nuremberg, southern Germany, where she was attending the Nuremberg Forum 2026 conference of the International Nuremberg Principles Academy. AFP PHOTO](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259668.jpg)](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259668.jpg)
South African lawyer and champion of international law Navi Pillay addresses journalists after she was awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, on October 9, 2026 at the historic Courtroom 600 of Nuremberg's Palace of Justice, venue of the 1945-1946 Nuremberg Trials against leaders of defeated Nazi Germany, in Nuremberg, southern Germany, where she was attending the Nuremberg Forum 2026 conference of the International Nuremberg Principles Academy. AFP PHOTO

"Goebbels had blood on his hands....responsible for the death of thousands of people. Not only Jews, but people of color like me," she added.

She acknowledged there was little political appetite to arrest Netanyahu to face the ICC accusations, which he furiously denies.

"But all my life I've seen people get around difficulties, so I'm confident that it will happen," she said, asked if Netanyahu was ever likely to appear in the ICC dock.

**'Age will constrain me'**

Pillay said she was still digesting the news that she had won. She found it difficult to believe at first "because they give their awards to very few women — gross inequality in the practice so far."

At 85, she frets she will be unable to travel far and wide to sing the praises of international justice with the amplified voice of a Nobel Peace Prize winner.

"I think that age will constrain me somewhat. I can't be as active as I used to," she said, noting that she visited 79 countries when she was UN High Commissioner for Human Rights.

She said she was consulting people about how best to spend the 12 million Swedish krone prize ($1.2 million) but hinted some of it might be invested in her native South Africa.

"Africa is suffering. South Africa is suffering. It's very difficult to raise funds there," she said.

"The University of KwaZulu-Natal has set up a unit in my name, so I'll begin to have discussions with them. I believe in education for children and the youth."

title: Congo-Kinshasa: What to Know About New Kabila-Led Movement in DR Congo
summary: Former DR Congo President Joseph Kabila and other signatories to [the newly established _Front pour la refondation de la nation_ (FRN)](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39623/news/africa/dr-congo-kabila-leads-new-movement-with-afcm23-lead
content:
Former DR Congo President Joseph Kabila and other signatories to [the newly established _Front pour la refondation de la nation_ (FRN)](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39623/news/africa/dr-congo-kabila-leads-new-movement-with-afcm23-leaders-as-deputies "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39623/news/africa/dr-congo-kabila-leads-new-movement-with-afcm23-leaders-as-deputies") said the country's deepening political, security, economic and social crises have made a fundamental change in its governance necessary, setting out a plan to unite resistance forces under a new politico-military movement.

**ALSO READ**: [Kabila faults Tshisekedi for 'choosing war' over peace in DR Congo](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39571/news/africa/kabila-faults-tshisekedi-for-choosing-war-over-peace-in-dr-congo "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39571/news/africa/kabila-faults-tshisekedi-for-choosing-war-over-peace-in-dr-congo")

Launched in Goma on Monday, October 12, the movement identifies failures by President Félix Tshisekedi's administration, including weakening state institutions, persistent insecurity, ethnic discrimination, corruption and deteriorating living conditions, as reasons for its formation.

Follow us on [WhatsApp](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K "https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K") | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/ "https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/") for the latest headlines

**ALSO READ**: [Kabila suspends his studies to 'deal with worsening situation' in eastern DR Congo](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/24676/news/africa/kabila-suspends-his-studies-to-deal-with-worsening-situation-in-eastern-dr-congo "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/24676/news/africa/kabila-suspends-his-studies-to-deal-with-worsening-situation-in-eastern-dr-congo")

In a declaration signed in Goma, the signatories highlighted the crisis as essentially internal, rooted in the decisions of the authorities in Kinshasa and what they described as the incumbent leadership's lack of legitimacy following the 2023 elections.

**ALSO READ**: [DR Congo: Kabila leads new movement with AFC/M23 leaders as deputies](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39623/news/africa/dr-congo-kabila-leads-new-movement-with-afcm23-leaders-as-deputies "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39623/news/africa/dr-congo-kabila-leads-new-movement-with-afcm23-leaders-as-deputies")

**Who are the leaders?**

The birth of the new movement saw the dissolution of the AFC/M23 alliance that has been fighting the Congolese government for years. Ex-AFC/M23 leaders were appointed as deputies to Kabila.

Kabila, who led DR Congo from 2001 to 2019, was appointed president of the FRN. Corneille Nangaa, the former head of the country's electoral commission, Bertrand Bisimwa, former M23 political leader, and Maj Gen Sultani Makenga were named vice-presidents. Makenga retained his position as chief of general staff of the Congolese Revolutionary Army (ARC).

**ALSO READ**: [Kabila speaks out on Goma drone attack, slams 'Tshisekedi's tyranny'](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/34297/news/africa/kabila-speaks-out-on-goma-drone-attack-slams-tshisekedis-tyranny "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/34297/news/africa/kabila-speaks-out-on-goma-drone-attack-slams-tshisekedis-tyranny")

Freddy Kaniki was appointed secretary-general and coordinator of the Executive Committee, while Benjamin Mbonimpa became deputy secretary-general and deputy coordinator. Désiré Rukomera Rwigema was named permanent secretary of the College of Founders.

The FRN will have five bodies: the College of Founders, the Council of the Revolution, the president and vice-presidents, and the Executive Committee.

Its establishment formally ended the existence of the Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC), with the signatories declaring that the new movement succeeds it by operation of law.

**ALSO READ**: [AFC/M23 leader Corneille Nangaa states four reasons why his movement is fighting Tshisekedi govt](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/26501/news/africa/afcm23-leader-corneille-nangaa-states-four-reasons-why-his-movement-is-fighting-tshisekedi-govt "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/26501/news/africa/afcm23-leader-corneille-nangaa-states-four-reasons-why-his-movement-is-fighting-tshisekedi-govt")

The signatories said the movement is not seeking positions within the existing political system but intends to transform the state. Its mission is to unite and coordinate resistance forces to end what it calls "tyranny." They vowed to end the system "by all means, including the use of force."

They invoke Article 64 of the Congolese Constitution, which stipulates that every Congolese citizen has a duty to oppose anyone who seizes power by force or exercises it in violation of the Constitution.

**ALSO READ**: [DR Congo crisis: Bisimwa criticises mediators for 'babysitting' Kinshasa](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/36668/news/africa/dr-congo-crisis-bisimwa-criticises-mediators-for-babysitting-kinshasa "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/36668/news/africa/dr-congo-crisis-bisimwa-criticises-mediators-for-babysitting-kinshasa")

**Political and institutional breakdown**

The FRN identifies the weakening of Congolese democratic institutions and disregard for constitutional provisions as central to the country's crisis.

Explaining the need for political change, the signatories said repeated violations of the Constitution and other laws had undermined the rule of law and weakened state institutions.

"The intolerant regime in power in Kinshasa is characterized by a regression of democracy, the establishment of tyranny, and the imposition of a single line of thought," the declaration states.

**ALSO READ**: [DR Congo must be violence-free, says AFC/M23 leader Nangaa](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/25771/news/africa/dr-congo-must-be-violence-free-says-afcm23-leader-nangaa "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/25771/news/africa/dr-congo-must-be-violence-free-says-afcm23-leader-nangaa")

The movement also observes the judiciary as an instrument of political repression, citing the detention and prosecution of military officers, political opponents, journalists, human rights activists and other citizens.

It says people who refuse to submit to the authorities face imprisonment, forced exile or death. Restoring constitutional governance and independent institutions is therefore central to its proposed reforms.

**Security crisis and weakened army**

Persistent insecurity is another major reason for establishing the FRN, its leaders said. The signatories argued that the government has failed to restore peace while pursuing a military approach that has deepened civilian suffering.

"Mr. Tshisekedi has chosen war over peace, a war he knows neither how to wage nor how to win," they stated.

The declaration accuses the Tshisekedi administration of indiscriminate attacks on civilians and the destruction of infrastructure, including schools, hospitals, bridges, churches and public markets.

**ALSO READ**: [AFC/M23 writes to UN Secretary-General over atrocities in eastern DR Congo](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/29975/news/africa/afcm23-writes-to-un-secretary-general-over-atrocities-in-eastern-dr-congo "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/29975/news/africa/afcm23-writes-to-un-secretary-general-over-atrocities-in-eastern-dr-congo")

It also highlighted the national defence apparatus as weakened by ethnically motivated recruitment, appointments and promotions, the empowerment of armed militias, and reliance on foreign troops and mercenaries.

The signatories further acknowledged that the government has supported or integrated members of the genocidal militia FDLR and the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) into its army.

**ALSO READ**: [FDLR continues killings, forced disappearances in eastern DR Congo, UN says](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39423/news/africa/fdlr-continues-killings-forced-disappearances-in-eastern-dr-congo-un-says "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39423/news/africa/fdlr-continues-killings-forced-disappearances-in-eastern-dr-congo-un-says")

They said these practices have undermined the country's ability to protect its population and restore security in Ituri, Beni, Lubero and other territories under its control.

The FRN presented reform of the security sector and the restoration of state authority as essential to resolving the crisis.

**Economic mismanagement and poverty**

Economic management also features prominently in the movement's case for a new political direction. The signatories described the prevailing model as predatory, citing corruption, embezzlement of public funds, the sale of mineral assets and financial mismanagement.

They said the concentration of wealth among a small ruling elite has come at the expense of the wider population, while public debt has exceeded $18 billion.

The declaration estimates that more than 80 per cent of the population lives below the poverty line, with millions facing chronic hunger, unemployment and inadequate access to basic services.

It points to shortages and poor-quality provision of clean water, electricity, education and primary healthcare, as well as high infant mortality.

The movement argues that national wealth should be distributed more equitably and public resources managed better to improve living conditions rather than sustain the ruling elite.

**ALSO READ**: [Outcry as DR Congo army spokesman spreads anti-Tutsi tropes](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/32263/news/crime/outcry-as-dr-congo-army-spokesman-spreads-anti-tutsi-tropes "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/32263/news/crime/outcry-as-dr-congo-army-spokesman-spreads-anti-tutsi-tropes")

**National cohesion and discrimination**

The FRN also identifies discrimination and the politicisation of identity as threats to national unity.

The signatories said efforts to consolidate national cohesion had been undermined by hate speech and the exploitation of ethnic and linguistic differences for political purposes.

**ALSO READ**: [Kinshasa made ethnic division 'a business opportunity', says governor](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/33133/news/africa/kinshasa-made-ethnic-division-a-business-opportunity-says-governor "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/33133/news/africa/kinshasa-made-ethnic-division-a-business-opportunity-says-governor")

They cited discrimination against the Tutsi and speakers of Kinyarwanda and Swahili, alongside the denial of nationality and the marginalisation of communities.

"The exploitation of identities for political ends and the denial of nationality have resurfaced," the declaration states.

It also points to tribalism, nepotism and cronyism, arguing that these practices deepen divisions, contribute to displacement and obstruct the return of refugees.

The movement says equal citizenship and national reconciliation are necessary to rebuild trust between communities and address the causes of displacement.

**ALSO READ**: [Banyamulenge group petitions Tshisekedi, UN boss over Ekenge's return as FARDC spokesperson](https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39343/news/africa/banyamulenge-group-petitions-tshisekedi-un-boss-over-ekenges-return-as-fardc-spokesperson "https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39343/news/africa/banyamulenge-group-petitions-tshisekedi-un-boss-over-ekenges-return-as-fardc-spokesperson")

**Doha negotiations and inclusive dialogue**

The signatories also cite the stalled peace process as evidence of the need for a different approach to resolving the crisis.

They said negotiations between the government and the AFC/M23 in Doha, Qatar had been hindered by a lack of political will from Kinshasa. They maintained that commitments relating to a ceasefire and the release of prisoners had not been honoured.

content:
近日，一则社会新闻在日本国内引起了不小的波澜：美国海军陆战队员巴拉德涉嫌于10月3日凌晨，在冲绳县那霸抢走一名39岁女性的钱包等物品，并将其杀害。10月5日，该名嫌犯被移送司法机关，但日本警方透露这名海军士兵否认所有指控。对此，日本首相高市在10月5日的临时国会施政演讲中还特别谈及了此事，她表示日本政府已就此事向美方提出了严正的谴责，并强烈要求美方配合调查。

本期节目，我们邀请到了台湾国立政治大学国际事务学院教授兼任日本研究硕博士学位学程主任的李世晖先生。李世晖先生同时也是安倍晋三研究所的所长，长期关注日本战略与印太趋势的发展。

李世晖先生将为我们深入解读冲绳的历史背景，以及此案会为高市早苗政府带来哪些政治压力，尤其是在推进她的防务政策方面。毕竟冲绳距离台湾只有110公里，中国频繁举行的海上军事演习以及高市发表的“台湾有事就是日本有事”的言论，让冲绳的战略重要性不言而喻。

**RFI：**日本国内对这件事作何反应呢？

**李世晖：**日本国内对这件事情的反应，其实还是有东京观点跟冲绳观点的。从东京的角度来看，这件事情必须妥善解决，解决的目的是要维持日美安保持续顺畅地运作，不会因为这件事情而让日本国民或者冲绳美军基地的角色出现变化。可是冲绳的观点比较接近“美军基地其实给冲绳带来的是更大的负担”，包含了治安、噪音、犯罪等等的问题。冲绳人长期以来就是希望至少能够降低冲绳美军基地的比例，能够跟日本国内相当，而不是绝大多数的美军部署都在冲绳。冲绳不是不愿意负担安全保障的责任，但是会希望逐年降低，不要全部都集中在冲绳。所以这件事情发生之后，会让更多的冲绳人认为冲绳已经负担了过去以来日本安全保障甚至区域安全保障的责任，但这个责任只由冲绳人来负担是不公平的。

**RFI：**其实想进一步请您向我们的听众解释一下关于冲绳的历史背景。冲绳就是经常我们说的以前的琉球，它以前是一个独立的琉球王国，是在1879年的时候被日本吞并，然后二战之后又被美国实际管制，直到1972年才重新回归日本。在冲绳回归日本后，它的行政和安全事务是怎么管理的呢？因为刚才您说的一切让我感觉它跟东京之间的立场其实有点对立或者是割裂的？

**李世晖：**对，第二次世界大战之后从1945年一直到1972年这段时间，其实冲绳是放在美军管辖之下的，它跟东京出现了大约十多年左右管理上面的割裂。虽然1972年冲绳归还日本，但是美军已经在那边建设了十多年，把冲绳视为稳定东亚地区的一个重要战略基地，也是美国在东亚的战略基地。所以虽然冲绳归还了日本，可是美国在短期之内或者说他已经投入了建设基地的投资，所以它持续就会使用冲绳上面的这些设施，来维持美军在这个区域的一些战略影响力。

比较大的一个变化其实是在1995年。1995年发生了三个美军对一个国中女生（12岁）施加暴行的事件。这件事情引发了冲绳居民的激烈抗议，很多人走上街头反对美军基地。这件事情直接影响了目前大家在讨论的普天间基地迁移问题（这一次犯罪的士兵其实就是普天间基地所属的美军）。普天间基地其实是在冲绳的市中心，所以发生了1995年事件之后，美国跟日本其实就已经同意了要将普天间基地移到现在的名护市这个地方。可是到现在为止还是没有移过去。原本也许可以顺利推动普天间基地迁移的问题，可能会因为这次的杀人事件，而让名护市的居民可能会有不一样的想法。毕竟普天间美军在那边犯下了非常严重的刑事罪行，如果这个基地签到新地方，新地方的居民也会担心这件事。所以这会为普天间基地迁移的问题投下一个重大的变数。

我们认为日本跟美国应该会为了这个问题进行比较密切的协商，应该会像1995年的时候出现一个类似的特别措施，来改善或消除冲绳人的不满，在今年或明年这边会出现一个双方同意的解决方针，给冲绳人一个交代。至于有关冲绳的管理问题，冲绳在第二次世界大战期间，已经在冲绳战役上面承受了非常重大的战争伤害，死了很多人。之后冲绳又被美军管理，承担了日本的安全责任。所以不少冲绳人对于美军基地或者东京的中央政府是相对比较不满的。过去在冲绳知事选举的时候，自民党都不太容易取得优势，但是这一次例外。上一次众议员选举冲绳地区全部都是自民党当选，而这一次知事也是自民党当选。所以我们看到从1995年以来的反基地力量在这几年似乎影响逐渐下滑，导致支持基地的自民党国会议员和知事当选，状况确实出现了改变。

**RFI：**美军在冲绳所谓的这些犯罪行为其实已经不是一次两次了，历史上多次引起很大的不满。为什么美军士兵会频繁出现这种事情？对美军士兵的管辖权是在美国还是在日本？是因为这个分歧导致美军士兵可以有点肆无忌惮吗？

**李世晖：**其实在1995年之前，《日美地位协定》中关于驻日美军基地人员的规范里，美军的司法管辖权是在美国。所以1995年犯下重大案件时，冲绳人要求把犯人交由冲绳地方裁判所审判，结果这个人被直接送回美国，没有留在冲绳审判。所以之后才进行了《日美地位协定》的修正。修正之后，驻日美军在执行非公务时如果犯罪，冲绳的地方裁判所是有司法审查权和管辖权的。

可是过去会有一个很大问题：如果这个人犯罪当时没有被日本司法机关抓到，他的人身安全就在美军这里。如果你第一阶段没有抓到他，除非他受审得出判决之后，才可能要接受日本司法的审判。这一次这个人比较特殊，他是直接被冲绳警方抓到了，所以他现在是在冲绳的拘留所。以前很多情况只要逃回美军基地，美军就不会把他抓出来了。当美军觉得判刑受美国司法管辖时，他就不会那么在意日本司法机关。但是至少在修正之后有一些先例，驻日美军纪律相比1995年前算是有所改善。美军基地也会定期派出巡逻队，在美军容易出没的酒吧等地区进行巡逻，以免美军休假时喝醉闹事。但每隔几年都还是会出现美军在冲绳出现重大犯罪的消息，毕竟官兵素质不一，美军人数很多，不免就会出现这个状况。

**RFI：**高市首相自上任以来发表了“台湾有事就是日本有事”的言论，引起了中日关系紧张。您觉得这会让冲绳当地的民众会对美军基地有更多的包容或理解吗？

**李世晖：**“台湾有事就是日本有事”之后，中国对日本展开各方面的施压（如减少观光客、在冲绳周边举行军事演习），冲绳人其实是有感受到的。受影响最大的也许是冲绳。冲绳人的想法在这个过程中蛮有意思，不再单方面认为全是东京或美军的错，也开始有人认为是北京的错。这与台湾的情况非常接近：面对施压，台湾人怪罪的是中国而非民进党。冲绳人在面对中国压力时会不会转换过去不满的对象，非常值得观察；本次选举某种程度上也反映了面对中国压力时，冲绳人选择支持更有能力抗衡中国的政权。

**RFI：**这个事件发生之后，会对高市防务政策的推进有什么影响吗？

**李世晖**：就长期而言影响不大，毕竟日美同盟是美国印太地区及日本防卫的重要基石，不会因为美军在冲绳的重大犯罪事件而有太大的偏离。但是短期内，高市就必须在此议题上展现强烈态度，否则容易变成她的政治危机。透过这件事情让美国重新坐上谈判桌谈论更为平等的日美同盟，也许是一个契机。发生这件事情并不会让日美关系变差，反而会让日美关系变好，因为双方坐下来谈如何避免此类事情发生，会让未来的双边合作更顺畅。高市现在要做的事情，就是要说服冲绳人：虽然日美紧密合作和美军基地有必要存在，但执政党会确保基地周边日本人的安全环境，照顾冲绳人的安全。这与其说是安全保障上的重要课题，我倒认为是高市早苗政治上的重要课题。

**RFI：**不过我觉得还有一种可能，如果把舆论往中国身上引的话，冲绳民众可能会觉得在现在这种环境下，美军存在的必要性其实跟中国的威胁直接相关。就看民意怎么发展以及高市怎么面对了。

_李世晖：_ 10月日美两国会在冲绳海域进行联合演习。中国的做法从他们角度来看是很正常的反应，但从日本或台湾的角度来看常产生反效果。中国军队出现的地点永远都是冲绳周边，如果日本执政党巧妙转移舆论报道方向，目前对高市政权形成的压力也许就会被转移到中国身上去。

# Taiwan's parties ramp up campaigning ahead of Nov. 28 local elections

Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (right) and DPP Taipei mayoral candidate Puma Shen (left) (CNA file photo)

Taipei, Oct. 14 (CNA) Taiwan's two major political parties and their mayoral candidates on Wednesday stepped up preparations for the Nov. 28 local elections, announcing campaign rallies and policy proposals while negotiations continued over a televised debate in Taipei.

Incumbent Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) of the Kuomintang (KMT) said at an event in the capital that broadcasters TVBS and SET TV would hold a second round of talks on Thursday with his campaign team and that of Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) challenger Puma Shen (沈伯洋) to discuss arrangements for the debate.

The two sides have agreed to include cross-questioning in the debate, but have yet to decide on a date.

Chiang urged Shen to send representatives authorized to make decisions to a meeting and expressed hope that all details could be finalized during the second round of talks.

Speaking to reporters before a radio interview, Shen said the timing of the meeting would depend on coordination between the two campaigns and reiterated his hope that the debate could take place as soon as possible.

KMT Taichung mayoral candidate Johnny Chiang (left) and DPP Ho Hsin-chun (right) (CNA file photo)

In central Taiwan, the KMT's Taichung mayoral candidate Johnny Chiang (江啟臣) unveiled a proposal to turn the city into a robotics manufacturing hub, citing its strong manufacturing base. He also pledged to establish a smart manufacturing park and cultivate talent through education.

His DPP rival Ho Hsin-chun (何欣純), meanwhile, announced plans for a campaign rally on Sunday with four DPP city councilors and a council candidate, where campaign ribbons will be distributed to supporters.

KMT Chairperson Cheng Li-wun. CNA file photo

Separately, KMT Chairperson Cheng Li-wun (鄭麗文) announced a series of large-scale rallies, beginning on Saturday in central Taiwan, with further events planned across the country. Each event is expected to draw around 20,000 supporters.

DPP Spokesperson Wu Cheng. CNA file photo

The DPP, meanwhile, urged caution over opinion polls and campaign crowd sizes. Spokesperson Wu Cheng (吳崢) said party leaders had stressed that neither necessarily translated into electoral victories.

Taiwan's 2026 local elections are also known as the "9-in-1" elections because voters in Taiwan's 22 cities and counties will cast ballots for candidates vying for nine different local government posts, including city mayors, county magistrates, and city and county councilors.

Also up for grabs are seats for township chiefs and chiefs of indigenous tribes' districts in municipalities, township councilors and indigenous councilors in municipalities, as well as ward chiefs.

In total, the elections will be held to fill 11,051 elected posts at all levels of local government.

(By Yeh Chen-yun, Liu Chien-pang, Tsai Meng-yu, Liu Kuan-ting, Wang Yang-yu and Sunny Lai)

SEOUL, Oct. 14 (Yonhap) -- Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul visited an air base in the southwestern city of Gwangju on Wednesday to inspect the readiness of a key Air Force unit as the government plans to relocate the base to support a major semiconductor cluster project, his office said.

Kang toured the Gwangju Air Base, home to the Air Force's 1st Fighter Wing, in the namesake city, about 270 kilometers south of Seoul, in a bid to urge troops to cooperate in completing the country's key strategic policy while maintaining a robust readiness posture.

The Gwangju Air Base has been picked as the site for the envisioned chip cluster in the Honam region and is expected to be moved to nearby Muan County.

"The military should coordinate closely with the defense ministry to follow through on the temporary rearrangement (of the 1st Fighter Wing) and the relocation of the Gwangju Air Base while maintaining a robust aerial defense posture," Kang said.

Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul (C) inspects a military airport in Gwangju, about 270 kilometers south of Seoul, home to the Air Force's 1st Fighter Wing, which has been handpicked as the site for an envisioned chip cluster, on Oct. 14, 2026, in this photo provided by his office. (PHOTO NOT FOR SALE) (Yonhap)

[](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261014007051315 "Opens in new web browser window")

The government plans to temporarily relocate three squadrons of the 1st Fighter Wing to three air bases, located in Yecheon, Seosan and Chungju, respectively, to minimize disruptions in their operational capabilities.

Initially, the government planned to complete the relocation of the fighter wing by mid-2028, but President Lee Jae Myung last month ordered officials to expedite the process, saying relevant regulations or guidelines should be revised if needed.

The defense chief also visited the Army's Ground Operations Command later in the day, where he was debriefed on operational updates at the command center, according to the ministry.

Kang ordered troops to respond sternly in the event of an enemy provocation under a "watertight" readiness posture while underscoring the importance of "discipline" in the military to commanders.

The Ground Operations Command oversees five subordinate corps, including the 1st Corps, responsible for the western front, which came under fire for conducting guard duties without live ammunition loaded.

The ministry has since reportedly found similar procedure breaches in other corps, including the 2nd and 3rd corps, through an internal audit.

content: 北京警方近日连续接报多起境外留学生被冒充公检法诈骗案件。诈骗分子冒充出入境工作人员，拨打留学生电话，以电话卡、银行卡涉案为由进行诈骗，造成留学生被骗大额资金。在国外读研的小张，就是在刚刚开学后不久被诈骗分子盯上的。 冒充出入境工作人员来电 专骗留学生 留学生 小张：那会儿我刚到国外学校报到，为了方便，就在当地买了一张手机卡。我记得特别清楚，卡片激活后的第三天，我收到一条运营商发来的短信，提醒我有一个未接电话，短信里还附带了一个录音文件，就是运营商给我的语音留言。 诈骗信息：用户你好，你的电话因使用异常，将在今天停止本地数据。 留学生 小张：这段语音留言特别逼真，还有“一中文、二英文”这种交互环节。在我印象中，一般官方客服就是这样的。然后我就按照短信上留的电话号码打了过去。 电话接通后，所谓的客服告知小张，他的名下有一张中国上海的手机卡，今年3月份向外发送了上千条骚扰短信。 留学生 小张：客服说，因为这个事情，我这张刚刚启用的境外手机卡会被停机。我当时第一反应是，我人在国外，怎么可能干这个事情呢？肯定是弄错了。 打电话向“警官”报案 通过视频做笔录 客服说，如果小张所说的情况属实，建议他向上海警方报案。随后小张拨打了对方提供的电话号码，向所谓的上海警方报案。在电话里一位自称“夏警官”的人让小张下载TEAMS软件，通过视频会议的方式做笔录。 留学生 小张：在视频里，我看到他穿着警服，坐在一个特别像公安局的房间里。他先给我出示了警官证，警号什么的也跟我说了，然后就开始给我做笔录，大概持续了三四个小时。快结束的时候，他跟我说接到上级通知，我的名字涉及一个重大犯罪嫌疑人案件。大概过了一个来小时，他跟我说，因为案情重大，这个案件已经被提级处理了。 “案情重大” 随时有可能被“逮捕” 因为“案情重大”，小张随后又被陆续转接到了所谓的“刑警队长”和“检察长”，他们说，根据已有的线索，小张名下的一张银行卡近期接收了570多万元诈骗赃款，他们怀疑小张从中收取了50万元的好处费。 留学生 小张：他不是说我拿了500多万的赃款吗？这些钱涉及数十个受害者。他说其中有一个受害者当天就跳楼自杀了，因此要立刻逮捕我，把我遣返回国。我当时害怕极了。 小张反复解释自己一直在国外留学，从未办理过那张银行卡。对方说鉴于他情况特殊，可以暂时让他在海外接受调查。但是在调查期间，要每天定时汇报自己的行踪。 留学生 小张：他说给我架设了一个红外监控系统，不只是家里，在任何地方，只要有电子设备，就能监控我的一举一动。我上网搜什么东西、打什么消息，他都能看见。并且让我每天早上8点、中午12点、下午4点、晚上8点，一天四次给他们汇报自己的位置、身边有几个人、安全情况，还有当时的时间等等，还要拍一张自己的照片发给他们。 同时对方反复强调，案件重大，必须严格保密，不能告诉任何人，包括父母和同学，否则会连累他们。 留学生 小张：他跟我说，这个案件非常复杂，涉及的人员特别多，银行里面很多工作人员也都在协助坏人。一旦说了就会泄密，就是谁都不能说。还警告我，如果我告诉别人，要判我3到7年有期徒刑。当时他还让我卸载了B站、小红书、知乎、微博，反正就是让我全都给删了，相当于切断了我跟外界所有人的联系。 “专案组成员”现身 当面出示“警官证” 小张告诉记者，在自己被监视的第二天，一名自称为专案组成员的男子来到了他租住的公寓楼下与他见面，当面向他出示了“警官证”，要求他配合调查。 留学生 小张：我的身份证、护照，我的所有信息他都有。他还跟我确认出行记录：你在几月几日，是不是飞到哪儿了？然后你是不是住在了哪个酒店？当他精准说出这些信息的时候，我更加相信自己确实正在被调查。 小张说，对方除了用这些有意无意抛出的细节说服他之外，也很善于从情感上操控他。 留学生 小张：他不是说有受害人跳楼了吗？他说这个的时候还表现得特别自责，说作为负责案件的警官，没有关心好受害人什么的。然后他又开始担心我，跟我说，你要是有任何心理上的问题，都要及时跟我说，千万别想不开。表现得特别有责任心的那种感觉。他们用了至少半个月的时间来陪我演这出戏，让我对这个剧本深信不疑。我当时认为自己就是嫌疑人，就必须配合他们这些调查，一点都没往我是被骗的方向想。 起初只配合调查 并未提及“保证金” 小张说，在这半个月里，对方只是让他配合调查，并没有提出过任何跟钱有关的要求。因此当后来对方提钱时，他也没有任何怀疑。 留学生 小张：后来那个检察长说，可以帮我争取一下优先调查，我就开始了漫长的等待。大概等了一周，他跟我说，经过审查，我不符合申请条件，因此要交保证金。这是第一次出现钱的事情，我到这会儿都没有任何怀疑。我跟他说，我没有这么多钱。他说，我帮你想办法，咱们一起想办法。 几天后，对方建议小张，可以用参与某学校交换项目需要验资的理由，向父母要钱交保证金。 留学生 小张：他还给我专门做了项目文件，让我发给我爸妈。他要求我跟我爸妈视频通话，他就在一旁监听着，就是单独架了一个设备，监听我跟我父母要钱的过程。钱要到之后，他就开始教我买虚拟币。他给我的解释是，因为银行里面全都是坏人，你必须通过这种加密货币的方式，这样才能不惊动别人。 在小张按照对方的要求，把从父母那里要来的大额资金全部购买了虚拟币后，对方还派人专程给他送来了一份资金封存证明，这让他更加相信警方正在为他争取优先调查。 留学生 小张：可能又过了半个月，他说这个案件的证据已经收集清楚了，同时你也非常配合我们的调查。我现在顶着各方面压力，替你申请了取保候审的名额，但是要再交一笔保证金。他就又帮助我完善了一个新的话术。第一次要钱，让我跟爸妈说是为了准备签证；第二次要钱，让我跟爸妈说面试通过了，但签证迟迟下不来，原因就是签证需要两份存款证明，一笔存款银行只能打印一份证明，必须得再存一笔钱，银行才能再开一份证明。就用这个借口糊弄我爸妈，我爸妈还真信了。 急于洗脱嫌疑 连夜飞回国内报案 就这样，小张的第二笔钱也通过购买虚拟币的方式交纳了所谓的取保候审保证金。之后对方告诉小张，案子已经调查清楚了，如果他现在回国报案，就可以从嫌疑人转为受害人。但骗子万万没想到的是，急于洗脱自己嫌疑的小张竟然真的连夜飞回了北京直奔派出所报案。 留学生 小张：在派出所，民警跟我说，没有查到我名下有任何案子。我以为是因为这个案子涉密程度高，基层民警权限不够，查不着什么的。我当时就一直给骗子打电话，电话他不接，但他给我回消息，他说，没有查到吗？那你先回家，我通报相关单位，然后跟你联系。这时我都还在相信他。直到后面他不理我了，而且好几个警察过来跟我说，你这就是被骗了，我才突然意识到有点儿不对劲了。 通过民警的耐心劝解，小张最终醒悟，避免了进一步的损失。 警惕！以境外学校验资为名的新型骗术 据北京市反诈中心发布的信息，近年来留学生群体遭遇的多是冒充公检法类诈骗。诈骗分子先是冒充公检法、移民管理、使领馆等机关单位工作人员，编造被害人出入境记录有问题、护照过期、涉嫌犯罪等理由，威胁被害人如不配合调查将会被通缉、拘捕，甚至注销护照、驱逐出境。随后通过心理施压和精神控制让被害人将钱款转入所谓“安全账户”，或者按照其指示自导自演“被绑架”场景，以骗取家属巨额资金。 除此之外，近期的电诈案件中，还出现了参加境外学校组织的游学、访问、实习等活动需要验资的骗术。 北京市公安局海淀分局刑侦支队反诈中心中队长 杨帆：跟大家做一个提示，作为家长，如果接到了孩子发来的需要缴纳学习相关费用的请求或者需求，最好的办法是直接要来对方收款的对公账户，由境内的家长直接缴费，这样避免中间出现疏漏。如果在国外留学期间，接到了自称国内或者国外相关执法部门的电话，说我们的同学涉及相关案件需要配合调查，你不要慌张，需要做的第一件事就是联系当地的我国驻外使领馆，核实相关信息。如果有任何相关执法机构要求我们的学生缴纳相关费用，都是诈骗。

title: FEHD launches second phase of Operation Skynet targeting public markets
zh_title: 食环署推出第二阶段天网行动，瞄准公众街市
summary: 香港食物环境卫生署继第一阶段针对超市和餐馆的“天网行动”结束后，启动了第二阶段的“天网行动”，为期两周，打击公共市场的害虫和卫生问题。第一阶段进行了 1,930 次检查，120 名工作人员 [![图 1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 10 月 14 日2026 香港时间 20:00 · 2 分钟阅读食物环境卫生署（食环署）周二公布
content:
香港
香港食物环境卫生署继针对超市和餐馆的第一阶段“天网行动”结束后，启动了第二阶段的“天网行动”，为期两周，打击公众街市的害虫和卫生问题。第一阶段共进行了 1,930 次检查、120 名工作人员

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 14 日 20:00 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

食物环境卫生署（食环署）周二宣布，继第一阶段以超级市场、食肆及其他食物业处所为重点的「天网行动」结束后，立即展开为期两周的特别巡查及执法行动，针对各区公众街市。

第一阶段从9月30日开始，共涉及1,930次检查。针对超级市场，执法人员进行了 1,177 次检查，发出 65 份法定消灭害虫通知书、25 份要求清洁和修缮食物场所的通知书以及两项警告，并提出了 14 项检控。
食肆方面，食肆进行了432次巡查，发出35份法定消灭害虫通知书、41份要求清洁及修葺食肆的通知书及六项警告，并提出检控65宗。当局又对其他食物业处所进行了321次巡查，发出20份法定消灭害虫通知书、17份要求清洁和修缮食物业处所通知书以及24项检控。

行动期间，食环署人员检讨这些处所的环境卫生和垃圾管理，以确保废物妥善处置，并检查货架、冰箱和食物储存区的清洁情况，并检查是否有虫鼠活动迹象，以找出根源和潜在风险。海关表示，会继续跟进调查结果，加强巡查，并在有需要时采取进一步执法行动。

食环署发言人提醒，任何售卖预制及预先包装熟食、寿司及刺身的处所，包括超级市场，均须取得食环署发出的相关牌照或限制性食物许可证，并遵守适用的发牌条件。
第二阶段，该署将严格要求摊位租户采取适当的食品卫生管理和灭鼠措施。市公安局表示，将根据群众投诉情况、检查结果、抓获鼠患数量、鼠患迹象以及各公共市场的实际风险情况，调整检查力度和灭鼠力度。

与此同时，食环署亦在辖下的熟食中心及公众街市进行代号为“清锋行动”的单独执法行动，通过突击巡查打击非法吸烟行为。自9月28日行动开始，截至10月12日，人员已就吸烟违法行为发出近50张定额罚款通知书。第二阶段的「天网行动」及「清刃行动」将同时进行，以确保公众街市的环境卫生。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong's Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has launched the second phase of Operation Skynet, a two-week crackdown on pest and hygiene problems at public markets, after the first phase targeting supermarkets and restaurants concluded. The first phase resulted in 1,930 inspections, 120 sta

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 20:00 HKT · 2 min read

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD) announced on Tuesday the immediate launch of the second phase of "Operation Skynet", a two-week special inspection and enforcement operation targeting public markets across all districts, following the conclusion of the first phase that focused on supermarkets, restaurants and other food premises.

The first phase, which ran from September 30, involved 1,930 inspections in total. Against supermarkets, officers conducted 1,177 inspections, issued 65 statutory Notices of Elimination of Vermin, 25 Notices of Requirement to Cleanse and Repair Food Premises and two warnings, and initiated 14 prosecutions.

For restaurants, the department carried out 432 inspections, issuing 35 statutory Notices of Elimination of Vermin, 41 Notices of Requirement to Cleanse and Repair Food Premises and six warnings, and initiating 65 prosecutions. A further 321 inspections were conducted against other food premises, resulting in 20 statutory Notices of Elimination of Vermin, 17 Notices of Requirement to Cleanse and Repair Food Premises, and 24 prosecutions.

During the operation, FEHD officers reviewed environmental hygiene and refuse management at these premises to ensure proper waste disposal, checked goods shelves, refrigerators and food storage areas for cleanliness, and inspected for signs of pest and rodent activity to identify root causes and potential risks. The department said it will continue to follow up on these findings, step up inspections and take further enforcement action where necessary.

A spokesman for the FEHD reminded that any premises, including supermarkets, selling pre-made and prepackaged cooked foods, sushi and sashimi must obtain the relevant licence or restricted food permit issued by the FEHD and comply with the applicable licensing conditions.

In the second phase, the department will strictly require stall tenants to take proper food hygiene management and rodent control measures. It said it will adjust the intensity of inspections and rodent control efforts based on public complaints, inspection results, the number of rodents caught, rodent signs and actual risks at various public markets.

Meanwhile, the FEHD is also conducting a separate enforcement operation codenamed "Operation Clear Edge" across its cooked food centres and public markets to combat illegal smoking through blitz inspections. Since the operation began on September 28, officers have issued nearly 50 fixed penalty notices for smoking offences as of October 12. The second phase of "Operation Skynet" and "Operation Clear Edge" will be carried out concurrently to ensure the environmental hygiene of public markets.

#香港中文大学（深圳）医学院院长李仁科在学术会议上去世，享年65岁
著名心脏再生科学家、香港中文大学（深圳）医学院副院长李人科于10月10日在西安举行的学术会议上逝世，享年65岁。香港中文大学（深圳）发布讣告，赞扬他在干细胞治疗领域的开创性工作。

# CUHK-Shenzhen medicine dean Li Renke dies aged 65 at academic conference

The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen) announced the death of Li Renke, a chair professor and vice dean of its medical school, who died on Saturday (10 October) while attending an academic conference in Xi'an. He was 65.

Li, born in Harbin, Heilongjiang, was an internationally renowned scientist in cardiac regenerative medicine, tissue engineering and stem cell therapy. He joined CUHK-Shenzhen full-time last year to lead research and translational work, the university said in an obituary posted on its official website.

The obituary described Li as a distinguished pioneer in cardiovascular regenerative medicine and biomedical engineering, and the first scientist globally to receive U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval for stem cell transplantation to treat heart failure. It noted his decades of dedication to scientific research, exploring the frontiers of life sciences, and advancing medical technology through outstanding academic achievements and innovative spirit.

According to the obituary, Li devoted his life to science, serving his country and mentoring younger scholars. He left an environment where he had worked for nearly 40 years to drive disruptive research in regenerative medicine and interdisciplinary fields. He served as a member of the State Council's Overseas Chinese Affairs Office expert advisory committee and as a project reviewer for the National Natural Science Foundation and the Ministry of Science and Technology. He also received national recognition for his work.

A farewell ceremony for Li will be held on Tuesday (14 October) morning in Xi'an, followed by a memorial service at CUHK-Shenzhen on Saturday (17 October).

SEOUL, Oct. 14 (Yonhap) -- South Korea's central bank chief met with his counterparts from China and Japan in Thailand on Wednesday to exchange views on recent economic and financial developments, the Bank of Korea (BOK) said.

BOK Gov. Shin Hyun-song exchanged views on economic and financial conditions in the three countries with People's Bank of China Gov. Pan Gongsheng and Bank of Japan Gov. Ueda Kazuo during the 15th Tripartite Governors' meeting in Bangkok.

The meeting provided a platform for the three central bank chiefs to share assessments of economic conditions and financial market developments amid evolving global economic uncertainties.

The three Asian countries have been hosting the event on a rotation basis since 2009 to strengthen communication and cooperation. This year's annual gathering was hosted by the BOK.

# Hong Kong's Central Kowloon Route to Open Fully on Dec 6 with HK$8 Toll

The Central Kowloon Route will open to traffic in full on December 6, 2026, with a toll of HK$8 for all vehicles. The route forms part of Route 6, cutting travel time between Tseung Kwan O and Yau Ma Tei from 65 to 12 minutes.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 14 Oct 2026 at 18:05 HKT · 1 min read

The Hong Kong government announced on Wednesday that the Central Kowloon Route will open to traffic in full on December 6, with a toll of HK$8 for all vehicles from that day.

The Legislative Council passed the arrangement to charge all vehicles using the route HK$8 last year. The Commencement Notice will be gazetted on October 16 and tabled before the legislature next Wednesday for the 'made after deliberation' procedure, according to the government.

The Central Kowloon Route comprises the already-operational Yau Ma Tei tunnel section and the Kowloon Bay tunnel section, which is scheduled to open on December 6. Together with the Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel, it forms Route 6, linking Tseung Kwan O, Kowloon East and Kowloon West.

Once Route 6 is fully operational, travel time between Tseung Kwan O and Yau Ma Tei during peak hours is expected to drop significantly from about 65 minutes to about 12 minutes, bringing great convenience to commuters, the government said.

A spokesman for the Transport and Logistics Bureau said that, taking full account of the public's ability to pay, the toll has been set at HK$8. It is expected to recover part of the operating costs while achieving the intended traffic diversion effect, thereby easing congestion on major roads in Kowloon.

The government has already launched promotional activities to help the public understand the specific toll arrangements and ensure the smooth implementation of the new charges.

title: UPACC chair faces arson complaint over burned Tarlac home
summary: A couple from Capas town in Tarlac asked the Department of Justice (DOJ) to investigate United Pilipino Against Crime and Corruption (UPACC) chairperson Pyra Nucum Lucas and three others over the burning of their newly-built home, which the
content:
A couple from Capas town in Tarlac asked the Department of Justice (DOJ) to investigate United Pilipino Against Crime and Corruption (UPACC) chairperson Pyra Nucum Lucas and three others over the burning of their newly-built home, which the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) classified as an intentional fire.

Emil and Analyn Cadiang accused Lucas, a social media personality; Arthur Aquino and two unidentified individuals of destructive arson in a complaint filed last month with the DOJ, according to documents, a copy of which was obtained by The Manila Times.

The BFP finding did not establish who was responsible for the June 28, 2025 blaze.

*   [Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/regions/laguna-mayors-rally-behind-aragones/2444954)

In a letter to Prosecutor General Richard Anthony Fadullon, the couple's lawyer sought the intervention of DOJ, citing safety concerns and difficulties participating in proceedings before the Tarlac provincial prosecutor's office.

In their joint affidavit, the Cadiangs said Emil saw Lucas and a heavyset man pulling down the roofing-sheet fence surrounding their property in Sitio Hotspring, Barangay Bueno, while a woman recorded the incident. Aquino was also allegedly present. Emil said another man chased him downhill after shouting, "May tao!" He later saw thick black smoke rising from the house.
